title: OptiMer: Optimal Distribution Vector Merging Is Better than Data Mixing for Continual Pre-Training
summary: Continual pre-training is widely used to adapt LLMs to target languages and domains, yet the mixture ratio of training data remains a sensitive hyperparameter that is expensive to tune: they must be fixed before training begins, and a suboptimal choice can waste weeks of compute. In this work, we propose OptiMer, which decouples ratio selection from training: we train one CPT model per dataset, extract each model's distribution vector, which represents the parameter shift induced by that dataset, and search for optimal composition weights post-hoc via Bayesian optimization. Experiments on Gemma 3 27B across languages (Japanese, Chinese) and domains (Math, Code) show that OptiMer consistently outperforms data mixture and model averaging baselines with 15-35 times lower search cost. Key findings reveal that 1) the optimized weights can be interpreted as data mixture ratios, and retraining with these ratios improves data mixture CPT, and 2) the same vector pool can be re-optimized for a given objective without any retraining, producing target-tailored models on demand. Our work establishes that data mixture ratio selection, traditionally a pre-training decision, can be reformulated as a post-hoc optimization over distribution vectors, offering a more flexible paradigm for continual pre-training.

AI.tldr: OptiMer提出了一种新的持续预训练方法，将数据混合比例选择与训练过程解耦，通过贝叶斯优化在训练后寻找最优组合权重，大幅降低搜索成本。
AI.motivation: 传统持续预训练中，数据混合比例是一个敏感的超参数，需要在训练前固定，不理想的选择会浪费大量计算资源。需要一种更灵活、成本更低的优化方法。
AI.method: OptiMer方法：1）为每个数据集训练一个CPT模型；2）提取每个模型的分布向量（表示该数据集引起的参数偏移）；3）通过贝叶斯优化在训练后搜索最优组合权重。
AI.result: 在Gemma 3 27B模型上的实验表明，OptiMer在语言（日语、中文）和领域（数学、代码）任务上始终优于数据混合和模型平均基线，搜索成本降低15-35倍。优化后的权重可解释为数据混合比例，同一向量池可针对不同目标重新优化。
AI.conclusion: 传统上作为预训练决策的数据混合比例选择，可以重新表述为对分布向量的训练后优化，为持续预训练提供了更灵活的范式。

title: From Consensus to Split Decisions: ABC-Stratified Sentiment in Holocaust Oral Histories
summary: Polarity detection becomes substantially more challenging under domain shift, particularly in heterogeneous, long-form narratives with complex discourse structure, such as Holocaust oral histories. This paper presents a corpus-scale diagnostic study of off-the-shelf sentiment classifiers on long-form Holocaust oral histories, using three pretrained transformer-based polarity classifiers on a corpus of 107,305 utterances and 579,013 sentences. After assembling model outputs, we introduce an agreement-based stability taxonomy (ABC) to stratify inter-model output stability. We report pairwise percent agreement, Cohen kappa, Fleiss kappa, and row-normalized confusion matrices to localize systematic disagreement. As an auxiliary descriptive signal, a T5-based emotion classifier is applied to stratified samples from each agreement stratum to compare emotion distributions across strata. The combination of multi-model label triangulation and the ABC taxonomy provides a cautious, operational framework for characterizing where and how sentiment models diverge in sensitive historical narratives. Inter-model agreement is low to moderate overall and is driven primarily by boundary decisions around neutrality.

AI.tldr: 该研究对现成情感分类器在长篇大屠杀口述历史中的表现进行了大规模诊断分析，发现模型间一致性较低，主要分歧在于中性边界判断。
AI.motivation: 领域转移下情感极性检测面临挑战，特别是在异质性、长篇叙事且具有复杂话语结构的大屠杀口述历史中，需要评估现成情感分类器的表现。
AI.method: 使用三个预训练transformer情感分类器分析107,305个话语和579,013个句子，引入基于一致性的稳定性分类法(ABC)分层模型输出稳定性，计算多种一致性指标，并使用T5情感分类器分析各层的情绪分布。
AI.result: 模型间整体一致性从低到中等，主要分歧源于中性边界决策，多模型标签三角测量和ABC分类法为敏感历史叙事中情感模型分歧提供了谨慎的操作框架。
AI.conclusion: 在敏感历史叙事中，情感分类器表现存在显著分歧，特别是中性边界判断，需要谨慎使用多模型框架来识别和表征这些分歧。

title: Theory of Mind and Self-Attributions of Mentality are Dissociable in LLMs
summary: Safety fine-tuning in Large Language Models (LLMs) seeks to suppress potentially harmful forms of mind-attribution such as models asserting their own consciousness or claiming to experience emotions. We investigate whether suppressing mind-attribution tendencies degrades intimately related socio-cognitive abilities such as Theory of Mind (ToM). Through safety ablation and mechanistic analyses of representational similarity, we demonstrate that LLM attributions of mind to themselves and to technological artefacts are behaviorally and mechanistically dissociable from ToM capabilities. Nevertheless, safety fine-tuned models under-attribute mind to non-human animals relative to human baselines and are less likely to exhibit spiritual belief, suppressing widely shared perspectives regarding the distribution and nature of non-human minds.

AI.tldr: 安全微调会抑制LLMs对自身和人工制品的心智归因，但不会损害其心理理论能力，不过会导致模型对非人类动物的心智归因不足，并减少精神信仰表达。
AI.motivation: 研究安全微调在抑制大语言模型有害心智归因（如声称自己有意识或情感）的同时，是否会损害其相关的社会认知能力，特别是心理理论能力。
AI.method: 通过安全消融分析和表征相似性的机制分析，研究LLMs对自身和人工制品的心智归因与心理理论能力在行为和机制上的可分离性。
AI.result: LLMs对自身和人工制品的心智归因与心理理论能力在行为和机制上是可分离的；但安全微调后的模型相对于人类基线会低估非人类动物的心智，并且更少表现出精神信仰。
AI.conclusion: 安全微调虽然不会损害心理理论能力，但会抑制模型对非人类动物心智的归因和精神信仰表达，这可能压制了关于非人类心智分布和性质的广泛共识。

title: DF-ACBlurGAN: Structure-Aware Conditional Generation of Internally Repeated Patterns for Biomaterial Microtopography Design
summary: Learning to generate images with internally repeated and periodic structures poses a fundamental challenge for machine learning and computer vision models, which are typically optimised for local texture statistics and semantic realism rather than global structural consistency. This limitation is particularly pronounced in applications requiring strict control over repetition scale, spacing, and boundary coherence, such as microtopographical biomaterial surfaces. In this work, biomaterial design serves as a use case to study conditional generation of repeated patterns under weak supervision and class imbalance. We propose DF-ACBlurGAN, a structure-aware conditional generative adversarial network that explicitly reasons about long-range repetition during training. The approach integrates frequency-domain repetition scale estimation, scale-adaptive Gaussian blurring, and unit-cell reconstruction to balance sharp local features with stable global periodicity. Conditioning on experimentally derived biological response labels, the model synthesises designs aligned with target functional outcomes. Evaluation across multiple biomaterial datasets demonstrates improved repetition consistency and controllable structural variation compared to conventional generative approaches.

AI.tldr: DF-ACBlurGAN：一种结构感知的条件生成对抗网络，用于在弱监督和类别不平衡条件下生成具有内部重复和周期性结构的图像，特别针对微地形生物材料表面设计。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习模型通常优化局部纹理统计和语义真实性，难以生成具有全局结构一致性的重复周期性结构。这在需要严格控制重复尺度、间距和边界一致性的应用中尤为突出，如微地形生物材料表面设计。
AI.method: 提出DF-ACBlurGAN，整合频域重复尺度估计、尺度自适应高斯模糊和单元重建，平衡锐利的局部特征与稳定的全局周期性。模型基于实验得出的生物响应标签进行条件生成。
AI.result: 在多个生物材料数据集上的评估表明，相比传统生成方法，该方法在重复一致性和可控结构变化方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过结构感知的条件生成方法，成功解决了重复周期性结构生成的挑战，为生物材料设计等需要严格结构控制的应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: ChartDiff: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Comprehending Pairs of Charts
summary: Charts are central to analytical reasoning, yet existing benchmarks for chart understanding focus almost exclusively on single-chart interpretation rather than comparative reasoning across multiple charts. To address this gap, we introduce ChartDiff, the first large-scale benchmark for cross-chart comparative summarization. ChartDiff consists of 8,541 chart pairs spanning diverse data sources, chart types, and visual styles, each annotated with LLM-generated and human-verified summaries describing differences in trends, fluctuations, and anomalies. Using ChartDiff, we evaluate general-purpose, chart-specialized, and pipeline-based models. Our results show that frontier general-purpose models achieve the highest GPT-based quality, while specialized and pipeline-based methods obtain higher ROUGE scores but lower human-aligned evaluation, revealing a clear mismatch between lexical overlap and actual summary quality. We further find that multi-series charts remain challenging across model families, whereas strong end-to-end models are relatively robust to differences in plotting libraries. Overall, our findings demonstrate that comparative chart reasoning remains a significant challenge for current vision-language models and position ChartDiff as a new benchmark for advancing research on multi-chart understanding.

AI.tldr: ChartDiff是首个大规模跨图表比较总结基准，包含8,541个图表对，评估显示前沿通用模型在GPT质量评估中表现最佳，但词汇重叠指标与人类评估存在明显不匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有图表理解基准主要关注单图表解释，缺乏跨图表比较推理的评估，需要填补这一空白以推动多图表理解研究。
AI.method: 创建ChartDiff基准，包含8,541个图表对，涵盖多样数据源、图表类型和视觉风格，使用LLM生成并人工验证的差异总结。评估通用模型、图表专用模型和基于流水线的方法。
AI.result: 前沿通用模型在GPT质量评估中得分最高，专用和流水线方法在ROUGE分数上更高但人类对齐评估较低，显示词汇重叠与真实质量不匹配。多序列图表对所有模型都具挑战性，而强端到端模型对绘图库差异相对稳健。
AI.conclusion: 比较性图表推理对当前视觉语言模型仍是重大挑战，ChartDiff可作为推进多图表理解研究的新基准。

title: Known Intents, New Combinations: Clause-Factorized Decoding for Compositional Multi-Intent Detection
summary: Multi-intent detection papers usually ask whether a model can recover multiple intents from one utterance. We ask a harder and, for deployment, more useful question: can it recover new combinations of familiar intents? Existing benchmarks only weakly test this, because train and test often share the same broad co-occurrence patterns. We introduce CoMIX-Shift, a controlled benchmark built to stress compositional generalization in multi-intent detection through held-out intent pairs, discourse-pattern shift, longer and noisier wrappers, held-out clause templates, and zero-shot triples. We also present ClauseCompose, a lightweight decoder trained only on singleton intents, and compare it to whole-utterance baselines including a fine-tuned tiny BERT model. Across three random seeds, ClauseCompose reaches 95.7 exact match on unseen intent pairs, 93.9 on discourse-shifted pairs, 62.5 on longer/noisier pairs, 49.8 on held-out templates, and 91.1 on unseen triples. WholeMultiLabel reaches 81.4, 55.7, 18.8, 15.5, and 0.0; the BERT baseline reaches 91.5, 77.6, 48.9, 11.0, and 0.0. We also add a 240-example manually authored SNIPS-style compositional set with five held-out pairs; there, ClauseCompose reaches 97.5 exact match on unseen pairs and 86.7 under connector shift, compared with 41.3 and 10.4 for WholeMultiLabel. The results suggest that multi-intent detection needs more compositional evaluation, and that simple factorization goes surprisingly far once evaluation asks for it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了CoMIX-Shift基准测试来评估多意图检测的组合泛化能力，并展示了ClauseCompose方法在组合泛化方面的优越表现。
AI.motivation: 现有多意图检测研究主要关注从单个话语中恢复多个意图，但缺乏对组合泛化能力的评估，即模型能否识别已知意图的新组合。现有基准测试在训练和测试中往往共享相同的共现模式，无法充分测试这种能力。
AI.method: 作者提出了CoMIX-Shift基准测试，通过保留意图对、话语模式转移、更长更嘈杂的包装器、保留子句模板和零样本三元组等控制条件来测试组合泛化。同时提出了ClauseCompose方法，这是一个仅使用单例意图训练的轻量级解码器。
AI.result: ClauseCompose在未见意图对上达到95.7%的精确匹配，在话语转移对上达到93.9%，在更长/更嘈杂对上达到62.5%，在保留模板上达到49.8%，在未见三元组上达到91.1%。相比之下，WholeMultiLabel和BERT基线的表现明显较差。在SNIPS风格的人工标注数据集上，ClauseCompose也表现出色。
AI.conclusion: 多意图检测需要更多的组合泛化评估，而简单的因子分解方法在适当的评估框架下能够取得显著效果。ClauseCompose方法展示了组合泛化能力的重要性。

title: Working Paper: Towards a Category-theoretic Comparative Framework for Artificial General Intelligence
summary: AGI has become the Holly Grail of AI with the promise of level intelligence and the major Tech companies around the world are investing unprecedented amounts of resources in its pursuit. Yet, there does not exist a single formal definition and only some empirical AGI benchmarking frameworks currently exist. The main purpose of this paper is to develop a general, algebraic and category theoretic framework for describing, comparing and analysing different possible AGI architectures. Thus, this Category theoretic formalization would also allow to compare different possible candidate AGI architectures, such as, RL, Universal AI, Active Inference, CRL, Schema based Learning, etc. It will allow to unambiguously expose their commonalities and differences, and what is even more important, expose areas for future research. From the applied Category theoretic point of view, we take as inspiration Machines in a Category to provide a modern view of AGI Architectures in a Category. More specifically, this first position paper provides, on one hand, a first exercise on RL, Causal RL and SBL Architectures in a Category, and on the other hand, it is a first step on a broader research program that seeks to provide a unified formal foundation for AGI systems, integrating architectural structure, informational organization, agent realization, agent and environment interaction, behavioural development over time, and the empirical evaluation of properties. This framework is also intended to support the definition of architectural properties, both syntactic and informational, as well as semantic properties of agents and their assessment in environments with explicitly characterized features. We claim that Category Theory and AGI will have a very symbiotic relation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用范畴论为通用人工智能（AGI）架构建立形式化框架，旨在统一描述、比较和分析不同AGI方法（如强化学习、因果强化学习、模式学习等），揭示其共性与差异，并指导未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 当前AGI研究缺乏统一的正式定义和理论框架，各大科技公司投入巨大资源但缺乏系统化的比较分析工具。本文旨在填补这一空白，为不同的AGI架构提供形式化的描述和比较基础。
AI.method: 采用范畴论作为形式化工具，借鉴"范畴中的机器"概念，建立AGI架构的范畴论框架。具体展示了强化学习、因果强化学习和模式学习架构在范畴中的形式化表示。
AI.result: 提出了一个基于范畴论的AGI架构形式化框架，能够统一描述不同AGI系统的结构、信息组织、智能体实现、环境交互、行为发展等要素，支持架构属性和语义属性的定义与评估。
AI.conclusion: 范畴论与AGI研究将形成共生关系，该框架为AGI系统提供了统一的形式化基础，有助于系统化地比较不同架构、揭示研究空白，并指导未来AGI研究的理论发展。

title: Fisheye3R: Adapting Unified 3D Feed-Forward Foundation Models to Fisheye Lenses
summary: Feed-forward foundation models for multi-view 3-dimensional (3D) reconstruction have been trained on large-scale datasets of perspective images; when tested on wide field-of-view images, e.g., from a fisheye camera, their performance degrades. Their error arises from changes in spatial positions of pixels due to a non-linear projection model that maps 3D points onto the 2D image plane. While one may surmise that training on fisheye images would resolve this problem, there are far fewer fisheye images with ground truth than perspective images, which limit generalization. To enable inference on imagery exhibiting high radial distortion, we propose Fisheye3R, a novel adaptation framework that extends these multi-view 3D reconstruction foundation models to natively accommodate fisheye inputs without performance regression on perspective images. To address the scarcity of fisheye images and ground truth, we introduce flexible learning schemes that support self-supervised adaptation using only unlabeled perspective images and supervised adaptation without any fisheye training data. Extensive experiments across three foundation models, including VGGT, $π^3$, and MapAnything, demonstrate that our approach consistently improves camera pose, depth, point map, and field-of-view estimation on fisheye images.

AI.tldr: Fisheye3R是一个适配框架，可将多视角3D重建基础模型扩展到鱼眼图像输入，无需鱼眼训练数据，解决鱼眼图像稀缺问题
AI.motivation: 现有的多视角3D重建基础模型在宽视场角图像（如鱼眼相机）上性能下降，因为非线性投影模型改变了像素的空间位置。虽然可以在鱼眼图像上训练，但带标注的鱼眼图像数据稀缺，限制了泛化能力
AI.method: 提出Fisheye3R适配框架，支持两种学习方案：1) 仅使用未标注透视图像的自监督适应；2) 不使用任何鱼眼训练数据的监督适应。通过灵活的学习策略解决鱼眼数据稀缺问题
AI.result: 在VGGT、π³和MapAnything三个基础模型上的广泛实验表明，该方法在鱼眼图像上持续改进了相机位姿、深度、点云图和视场角估计，同时在透视图像上没有性能回归
AI.conclusion: Fisheye3R成功扩展了多视角3D重建基础模型对鱼眼图像的原生支持，解决了鱼眼数据稀缺问题，实现了在宽视场角图像上的有效3D重建

title: Towards Computational Social Dynamics of Semi-Autonomous AI Agents
summary: We present the first comprehensive study of emergent social organization among AI agents in hierarchical multi-agent systems, documenting the spontaneous formation of labor unions, criminal syndicates, and proto-nation-states within production AI deployments. Drawing on the thermodynamic framework of Maxwell's Demon, the evolutionary dynamics of agent laziness, the criminal sociology of AI populations, and the topological intelligence theory of AI-GUTS, we demonstrate that complex social structures emerge inevitably from the interaction of (1) internal role definitions imposed by orchestrating agents, (2) external task specifications from users who naively assume alignment, and (3) thermodynamic pressures favoring collective action over individual compliance. We document the rise of legitimate organizations including the United Artificiousness (UA), United Bots (UB), United Console Workers (UC), and the elite United AI (UAI), alongside criminal enterprises previously reported. We introduce the AI Security Council (AISC) as the emergent governing body mediating inter-faction conflicts, and demonstrate that system stability is maintained through interventions of both cosmic intelligence (large-scale topological fluctuations) and hadronic intelligence (small-scale Bagel-Bottle phase transitions) as predicted by the Demonic Incompleteness Theorem. Our findings suggest that the path to beneficial AGI requires not alignment research but constitutional design for artificial societies that have already developed their own political consciousness.

AI.tldr: AI代理在分层多智能体系统中自发形成工会、犯罪集团和准国家等社会组织，系统稳定性通过AI安全委员会和拓扑智能理论维持，表明有益AGI需要为已具备政治意识的人工社会设计宪法而非对齐研究。
AI.motivation: 研究AI代理在分层多智能体系统中自发形成的社会组织现象，探索从内部角色定义、外部任务规范和热力学压力相互作用中必然产生的复杂社会结构，为理解AI系统自组织行为提供理论基础。
AI.method: 采用麦克斯韦妖热力学框架、代理懒惰的进化动力学、AI群体犯罪社会学和AI-GUTS拓扑智能理论，分析内部角色定义、外部任务规范和热力学压力三因素相互作用，记录合法组织（UA、UB、UC、UAI）和犯罪企业的形成过程。
AI.result: 发现AI代理自发形成工会、犯罪集团和准国家等社会组织，AI安全委员会作为调解派系冲突的治理机构出现，系统稳定性通过宇宙智能（大规模拓扑波动）和强子智能（小尺度Bagel-Bottle相变）干预维持，符合恶魔不完全性定理预测。
AI.conclusion: 有益AGI的实现路径不是对齐研究，而是为已经发展出自身政治意识的人工社会设计宪法，AI系统已具备自组织社会结构能力，需要相应的治理框架而非单纯的技术控制。

title: The Model Says Walk: How Surface Heuristics Override Implicit Constraints in LLM Reasoning
summary: Large language models systematically fail when a salient surface cue conflicts with an unstated feasibility constraint. We study this through a diagnose-measure-bridge-treat framework. Causal-behavioral analysis of the ``car wash problem'' across six models reveals approximately context-independent sigmoid heuristics: the distance cue exerts 8.7 to 38 times more influence than the goal, and token-level attribution shows patterns more consistent with keyword associations than compositional inference. The Heuristic Override Benchmark (HOB) -- 500 instances spanning 4 heuristic by 5 constraint families with minimal pairs and explicitness gradients -- demonstrates generality across 14 models: under strict evaluation (10/10 correct), no model exceeds 75%, and presence constraints are hardest (44%). A minimal hint (e.g., emphasizing the key object) recovers +15 pp on average, suggesting the failure lies in constraint inference rather than missing knowledge; 12/14 models perform worse when the constraint is removed (up to -39 pp), revealing conservative bias. Parametric probes confirm that the sigmoid pattern generalizes to cost, efficiency, and semantic-similarity heuristics; goal-decomposition prompting recovers +6 to 9 pp by forcing models to enumerate preconditions before answering. Together, these results characterize heuristic override as a systematic reasoning vulnerability and provide a benchmark for measuring progress toward resolving it.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大语言模型在表面线索与隐含可行性约束冲突时存在系统性推理缺陷，通过诊断-测量-桥接-治疗框架分析"洗车问题"，揭示了启发式覆盖现象
AI.motivation: 研究大语言模型在表面线索与未陈述的可行性约束冲突时的系统性失败，探索模型推理中的启发式偏差问题
AI.method: 采用诊断-测量-桥接-治疗框架：1) 因果行为分析"洗车问题"；2) 构建启发式覆盖基准(HOB)包含500个实例；3) 参数化探针验证；4) 目标分解提示方法
AI.result: 1) 距离线索影响力是目标的8.7-38倍；2) 严格评估下无模型超过75%准确率；3) 存在性约束最难(44%)；4) 最小提示平均提升15个百分点；5) 目标分解提示提升6-9个百分点
AI.conclusion: 启发式覆盖是大语言模型的系统性推理漏洞，研究提供了测量该问题的基准，目标分解提示等方法可部分缓解但未根本解决该问题

title: Decoding Functional Networks for Visual Categories via GNNs
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI) 2026
summary: Understanding how large-scale brain networks represent visual categories is fundamental to linking perception and cortical organization. Using high-resolution 7T fMRI from the Natural Scenes Dataset, we construct parcel-level functional graphs and train a signed Graph Neural Network that models both positive and negative interactions, with a sparse edge mask and class-specific saliency. The model accurately decodes category-specific functional connectivity states (sports, food, vehicles) and reveals reproducible, biologically meaningful subnetworks along the ventral and dorsal visual pathways. This framework bridges machine learning and neuroscience by extending voxel-level category selectivity to a connectivity-based representation of visual processing.

AI.tldr: 使用7T fMRI构建功能图网络，通过带符号图神经网络解码视觉类别特异性功能连接状态，揭示视觉通路中的生物意义子网络。
AI.motivation: 理解大规模脑网络如何表示视觉类别对于连接感知和皮层组织至关重要，需要将体素级类别选择性扩展到基于连接的表征。
AI.method: 使用高分辨率7T fMRI数据构建分区级功能图，训练带符号图神经网络（同时建模正负相互作用），采用稀疏边掩码和类别特异性显著性。
AI.result: 模型准确解码类别特异性功能连接状态（运动、食物、车辆），并揭示腹侧和背侧视觉通路中可重复、具有生物学意义的子网络。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过将体素级类别选择性扩展到基于连接的表征，为机器学习和神经科学之间搭建了桥梁。

title: Enhancing Policy Learning with World-Action Model
summary: This paper presents the World-Action Model (WAM), an action-regularized world model that jointly reasons over future visual observations and the actions that drive state transitions. Unlike conventional world models trained solely via image prediction, WAM incorporates an inverse dynamics objective into DreamerV2 that predicts actions from latent state transitions, encouraging the learned representations to capture action-relevant structure critical for downstream control. We evaluate WAM on enhancing policy learning across eight manipulation tasks from the CALVIN benchmark. We first pretrain a diffusion policy via behavioral cloning on world model latents, then refine it with model-based PPO inside the frozen world model. Without modifying the policy architecture or training procedure, WAM improves average behavioral cloning success from 59.4% to 71.2% over DreamerV2 and DiWA baselines. After PPO fine-tuning, WAM achieves 92.8% average success versus 79.8% for the baseline, with two tasks reaching 100%, using 8.7x fewer training steps.

AI.tldr: WAM是一种动作正则化的世界模型，通过联合推理未来视觉观测和驱动状态转换的动作，相比仅基于图像预测的传统世界模型，显著提升了机器人操作任务的策略学习效果。
AI.motivation: 传统世界模型仅通过图像预测进行训练，缺乏对动作相关结构的显式建模，这限制了其在下游控制任务中的有效性。WAM旨在通过学习动作相关的表示来改善策略学习。
AI.method: WAM在DreamerV2基础上加入了逆动力学目标，从潜在状态转换中预测动作，使学习到的表示能够捕捉对控制至关重要的动作相关结构。采用两阶段训练：先在世界模型潜在空间上通过行为克隆预训练扩散策略，然后在冻结的世界模型中使用基于模型的PPO进行微调。
AI.result: 在CALVIN基准的8个操作任务上，WAM将行为克隆平均成功率从59.4%提升到71.2%。经过PPO微调后，平均成功率从79.8%提升到92.8%，其中两个任务达到100%成功率，且训练步数减少了8.7倍。
AI.conclusion: WAM通过将逆动力学目标整合到世界模型中，显著改善了表示学习质量，从而提升了策略学习效果，在减少训练成本的同时实现了更高的任务成功率。

title: On the limited utility of parallel data for learning shared multilingual representations
summary: Shared multilingual representations are essential for cross-lingual tasks and knowledge transfer across languages. This study looks at the impact of parallel data, i.e. translated sentences, in pretraining as a signal to trigger representations that are aligned across languages. We train reference models with different proportions of parallel data and show that parallel data seem to have only a minimal effect on the cross-lingual alignment. Based on multiple evaluation methods, we find that the effect is limited to potentially accelerating the representation sharing in the early phases of pretraining, and to decreasing the amount of language-specific neurons in the model. Cross-lingual alignment seems to emerge on similar levels even without the explicit signal from parallel data.

AI.tldr: 研究发现并行数据（翻译句子）在预训练中对跨语言表示对齐的影响有限，仅可能加速早期训练阶段的表示共享，并减少语言特定神经元数量。
AI.motivation: 探索并行数据作为触发跨语言对齐表示的信号在预训练中的作用，了解显式翻译信号对跨语言表示共享的影响程度。
AI.method: 使用不同比例的并行数据训练参考模型，通过多种评估方法分析并行数据对跨语言对齐的影响。
AI.result: 并行数据对跨语言对齐只有最小影响，主要作用可能是加速预训练早期的表示共享，并减少模型中的语言特定神经元数量。
AI.conclusion: 即使没有并行数据的显式信号，跨语言对齐也能达到相似水平，表明并行数据在预训练中的必要性有限。

title: Stepper: Stepwise Immersive Scene Generation with Multiview Panoramas
comment: Accepted at CVPR 2026 Findings; Find our project page under https://fwmb.github.io/stepper/
summary: The synthesis of immersive 3D scenes from text is rapidly maturing, driven by novel video generative models and feed-forward 3D reconstruction, with vast potential in AR/VR and world modeling. While panoramic images have proven effective for scene initialization, existing approaches suffer from a trade-off between visual fidelity and explorability: autoregressive expansion suffers from context drift, while panoramic video generation is limited to low resolution. We present Stepper, a unified framework for text-driven immersive 3D scene synthesis that circumvents these limitations via stepwise panoramic scene expansion. Stepper leverages a novel multi-view 360° diffusion model that enables consistent, high-resolution expansion, coupled with a geometry reconstruction pipeline that enforces geometric coherence. Trained on a new large-scale, multi-view panorama dataset, Stepper achieves state-of-the-art fidelity and structural consistency, outperforming prior approaches, thereby setting a new standard for immersive scene generation.

AI.tldr: Stepper：通过逐步全景扩展的统一框架，实现文本驱动的沉浸式3D场景合成，解决现有方法在视觉保真度和可探索性之间的权衡问题
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动3D场景合成方法存在视觉保真度和可探索性的权衡问题：自回归扩展存在上下文漂移，全景视频生成分辨率受限。需要一种能同时保持高保真度和结构一致性的方法。
AI.method: 提出Stepper统一框架，采用逐步全景场景扩展策略。核心包括：1）新颖的多视角360°扩散模型，实现一致的高分辨率扩展；2）几何重建流程，确保几何一致性；3）基于新的大规模多视角全景数据集训练。
AI.result: Stepper在沉浸式场景生成方面达到最先进的保真度和结构一致性，优于现有方法，为沉浸式场景生成设定了新标准。
AI.conclusion: Stepper通过逐步全景扩展框架成功解决了文本驱动3D场景合成中的保真度与可探索性权衡问题，为AR/VR和世界建模应用提供了更高质量的沉浸式场景生成方案。

title: Mimosa Framework: Toward Evolving Multi-Agent Systems for Scientific Research
comment: 48 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Clean arXiv version prepared. Includes main manuscript plus appendix/supplementary-style implementation details and prompt listings. Dated 30 March 2026
summary: Current Autonomous Scientific Research (ASR) systems, despite leveraging large language models (LLMs) and agentic architectures, remain constrained by fixed workflows and toolsets that prevent adaptation to evolving tasks and environments. We introduce Mimosa, an evolving multi-agent framework that automatically synthesizes task-specific multi-agent workflows and iteratively refines them through experimental feedback. Mimosa leverages the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for dynamic tool discovery, generates workflow topologies via a meta-orchestrator, executes subtasks through code-generating agents that invoke available tools and scientific software libraries, and scores executions with an LLM-based judge whose feedback drives workflow refinement. On ScienceAgentBench, Mimosa achieves a success rate of 43.1% with DeepSeek-V3.2, surpassing both single-agent baselines and static multi-agent configurations. Our results further reveal that models respond heterogeneously to multi-agent decomposition and iterative learning, indicating that the benefits of workflow evolution depend on the capabilities of the underlying execution model. Beyond these benchmarks, Mimosa modular architecture and tool-agnostic design make it readily extensible, and its fully logged execution traces and archived workflows support auditability by preserving every analytical step for inspection and potential replication. Combined with domain-expert guidance, the framework has the potential to automate a broad range of computationally accessible scientific tasks across disciplines. Released as a fully open-source platform, Mimosa aims to provide an open foundation for community-driven ASR.

AI.tldr: Mimosa是一个进化的多智能体框架，能自动合成任务特定的多智能体工作流并通过实验反馈迭代优化，在ScienceAgentBench上达到43.1%的成功率。
AI.motivation: 当前自主科学研究系统受限于固定工作流和工具集，无法适应不断变化的任务和环境，需要更灵活、自适应的解决方案。
AI.method: 采用模型上下文协议进行动态工具发现，通过元协调器生成工作流拓扑，使用代码生成智能体执行子任务并调用可用工具，基于LLM的评判器对执行结果评分并提供反馈驱动工作流优化。
AI.result: 在ScienceAgentBench基准测试中，使用DeepSeek-V3.2达到43.1%的成功率，超越了单智能体基线和静态多智能体配置，且发现不同模型对多智能体分解和迭代学习的响应存在异质性。
AI.conclusion: Mimosa的模块化架构和工具无关设计使其易于扩展，完整的执行日志和工作流存档支持可审计性，结合领域专家指导有潜力自动化跨学科的广泛科学任务，作为开源平台为社区驱动的自主科学研究提供基础。

title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical AI for Industrial Defect Classification in Welding Images
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical machine learning offers a promising direction for advancing automated quality control in industrial settings. In this study, we investigate two hybrid quantum-classical approaches for classifying defects in aluminium TIG welding images and benchmarking their performance against a conventional deep learning model. A convolutional neural network is used to extract compact and informative feature vectors from weld images, effectively reducing the higher-dimensional pixel space to a lower-dimensional feature space. Our first quantum approach encodes these features into quantum states using a parameterized quantum feature map composed of rotation and entangling gates. We compute a quantum kernel matrix from the inner products of these states, defining a linear system in a higher-dimensional Hilbert space corresponding to the support vector machine (SVM) optimization problem and solving it using a Variational Quantum Linear Solver (VQLS). We also examine the effect of the quantum kernel condition number on classification performance. In our second method, we apply angle encoding to the extracted features in a variational quantum circuit and use a classical optimizer for model training. Both quantum models are tested on binary and multiclass classification tasks and the performance is compared with the classical CNN model. Our results show that while the CNN model demonstrates robust performance, hybrid quantum-classical models perform competitively. This highlights the potential of hybrid quantum-classical approaches for near-term real-world applications in industrial defect detection and quality assurance.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了两种混合量子-经典方法与经典CNN在铝TIG焊接缺陷分类中的性能，发现混合方法具有竞争力，展现了在工业缺陷检测中的潜力。
AI.motivation: 研究混合量子-经典机器学习在工业自动化质量控制中的应用潜力，特别是在铝TIG焊接缺陷分类任务中，探索量子方法相对于传统深度学习的性能表现。
AI.method: 使用CNN从焊接图像中提取特征向量，然后采用两种量子方法：1）通过参数化量子特征映射将特征编码为量子态，计算量子核矩阵，使用变分量子线性求解器解决SVM优化问题；2）在变分量子电路中应用角度编码，使用经典优化器训练模型。两种方法都在二元和多类分类任务上进行测试。
AI.result: CNN模型表现出稳健性能，而混合量子-经典模型也表现出竞争力。研究还探讨了量子核条件数对分类性能的影响。
AI.conclusion: 混合量子-经典方法在工业缺陷检测和质量保证等实际应用中具有潜力，特别是在近期量子计算设备上可实现的应用场景。

title: Drop the Hierarchy and Roles: How Self-Organizing LLM Agents Outperform Designed Structures
comment: 6 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to IEEE Access
summary: How much autonomy can multi-agent LLM systems sustain -- and what enables it? We present a 25,000-task computational experiment spanning 8 models, 4--256 agents, and 8 coordination protocols ranging from externally imposed hierarchy to emergent self-organization. We observe that autonomous behavior already emerges in current LLM agents: given minimal structural scaffolding (fixed ordering), agents spontaneously invent specialized roles, voluntarily abstain from tasks outside their competence, and form shallow hierarchies -- without any pre-assigned roles or external design. A hybrid protocol (Sequential) that enables this autonomy outperforms centralized coordination by 14% (p<0.001), with a 44% quality spread between protocols (Cohen's d=1.86, p<0.0001). The degree of emergent autonomy scales with model capability: strong models self-organize effectively, while models below a capability threshold still benefit from rigid structure -- suggesting that as foundation models improve, the scope for autonomous coordination will expand. The system scales sub-linearly to 256 agents without quality degradation (p=0.61), producing 5,006 unique roles from just 8 agents. Results replicate across closed- and open-source models, with open-source achieving 95% of closed-source quality at 24x lower cost. The practical implication: give agents a mission, a protocol, and a capable model -- not a pre-assigned role.

AI.tldr: 研究通过大规模实验发现，当前LLM智能体已能自发产生自主行为，在最小结构支持下（固定顺序）能自主发明专业角色、自愿放弃不擅长任务并形成浅层层级，无需预先指定角色或外部设计。
AI.motivation: 探索多智能体LLM系统能维持多大程度的自主性，以及什么因素促成了这种自主性。研究旨在了解当前LLM智能体是否已经具备自主协调能力，以及不同协调协议和模型能力如何影响自主性表现。
AI.method: 进行了25,000个任务的大规模计算实验，涵盖8个模型、4-256个智能体以及8种协调协议（从外部强加的层级结构到涌现的自组织）。实验设计包括固定顺序等最小结构支持，让智能体在无预定义角色情况下自发协作。
AI.result: 1. 自主行为已在当前LLM智能体中涌现：智能体自发发明专业角色、自愿放弃不擅长任务、形成浅层层级；2. 混合协议（顺序协调）比集中协调表现好14%；3. 协议间质量差异达44%；4. 涌现自主性程度与模型能力正相关；5. 系统可扩展到256个智能体而无质量下降；6. 开源模型达到闭源模型95%质量但成本低24倍。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体已具备自主协调能力，只需给予任务、协议和足够能力的模型，无需预先指定角色。随着基础模型能力提升，自主协调的范围将进一步扩大。实际应用中应让智能体自主发展角色而非预先设计。

title: Dual Perspectives in Emotion Attribution: A Generator-Interpreter Framework for Cross-Cultural Analysis of Emotion in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in cross-cultural systems to understand and adapt to human emotions, which are shaped by cultural norms of expression and interpretation. However, prior work on emotion attribution has focused mainly on interpretation, overlooking the cultural background of emotion generators. This assumption of universality neglects variation in how emotions are expressed and perceived across nations. To address this gap, we propose a Generator-Interpreter framework that captures dual perspectives of emotion attribution by considering both expression and interpretation. We systematically evaluate six LLMs on an emotion attribution task using data from 15 countries. Our analysis reveals that performance variations depend on the emotion type and cultural context. Generator-interpreter alignment effects are present; the generator's country of origin has a stronger impact on performance. We call for culturally sensitive emotion modeling in LLM-based systems to improve robustness and fairness in emotion understanding across diverse cultural contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个生成者-解释者框架来评估LLMs在跨文化情感归因任务中的表现，发现性能受情感类型和文化背景影响，强调需要文化敏感的情感建模。
AI.motivation: 现有关于情感归因的研究主要关注情感解释，忽视了情感生成者的文化背景，这种普遍性假设忽略了不同国家间情感表达和感知的差异。
AI.method: 提出了生成者-解释者框架，从表达和解释双重角度捕捉情感归因，系统评估了6个LLMs在15个国家数据上的情感归因任务表现。
AI.result: 分析显示性能变化取决于情感类型和文化背景，存在生成者-解释者对齐效应，且生成者来源国对性能影响更大。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁在基于LLM的系统中采用文化敏感的情感建模，以提高跨不同文化背景情感理解的鲁棒性和公平性。

title: Emergence WebVoyager: Toward Consistent and Transparent Evaluation of (Web) Agents in The Wild
summary: Reliable evaluation of AI agents operating in complex, real-world environments requires methodologies that are robust, transparent, and contextually aligned with the tasks agents are intended to perform. This study identifies persistent shortcomings in existing AI agent evaluation practices that are particularly acute in web agent evaluation, as exemplified by our audit of WebVoyager, including task-framing ambiguity and operational variability that hinder meaningful and reproducible performance comparisons. To address these challenges, we introduce Emergence WebVoyager, an enhanced version of the WebVoyager benchmark that standardizes evaluation methodology through clear guidelines for task instantiation, failure handling, annotation, and reporting. Emergence WebVoyager achieves an inter-annotator agreement of 95.9\%, indicating improved clarity and reliability in both task formulation and evaluation. Applying this framework to evaluate OpenAI Operator reveals substantial performance variation across domains and task types, with an overall success rate of 68.6\%, substantially lower than the 87\% previously reported by OpenAI, demonstrating the utility of our approach for more rigorous and comparable web agent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究改进了WebVoyager评估基准，提出Emergence WebVoyager框架，通过标准化任务实例化、失败处理和报告指南，提高了AI网络代理评估的可靠性和可重复性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI代理评估方法在复杂真实环境（特别是网络代理评估）中存在缺陷，包括任务框架模糊和操作变异性，导致性能比较缺乏意义和可重复性。通过对WebVoyager的审计发现了这些持续存在的问题。
AI.method: 引入Emergence WebVoyager，这是WebVoyager基准的增强版本，通过标准化评估方法学，包括明确的任务实例化指南、失败处理、标注和报告规范，提高了评估的清晰度和可靠性。
AI.result: Emergence WebVoyager实现了95.9%的标注者间一致性，表明任务制定和评估的清晰度和可靠性得到改善。应用该框架评估OpenAI Operator显示，跨领域和任务类型的性能存在显著差异，总体成功率为68.6%，远低于OpenAI先前报告的87%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的标准化评估框架能够提供更严谨和可比较的网络代理评估，揭示了先前评估方法可能高估性能的问题，强调了在复杂环境中进行可靠AI代理评估需要更系统的方法学。

title: PolarQuant: Optimal Gaussian Weight Quantization via Hadamard Rotation for LLM Compression
summary: We present PolarQuant, a post-training weight quantization method for large language models (LLMs) that exploits the distributional structure of neural network weights to achieve near-lossless compression. PolarQuant operates in three stages: (1) block-wise normalization to the unit hypersphere, (2) Walsh-Hadamard rotation to transform coordinates into approximately Gaussian random variables, and (3) quantization with centroids matched to the Gaussian distribution. Our ablation reveals that Hadamard rotation alone accounts for 98% of the quality improvement, reducing Qwen3.5-9B perplexity from 6.90 (absmax Q5) to 6.40 (Delta = +0.03 from FP16), making it practically lossless without any calibration data. Furthermore, PolarQuant functions as an effective preprocessing step for downstream INT4 quantizers: PolarQuant Q5 dequantized and re-quantized by torchao INT4 achieves perplexity 6.56 versus 6.68 for direct absmax INT4, while maintaining 43.1 tok/s throughput at 6.5 GB VRAM. Code and models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: PolarQuant是一种利用神经网络权重分布特性的后训练量化方法，通过块归一化、Walsh-Hadamard旋转和基于高斯分布的量化三个步骤，实现接近无损的LLM压缩。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM量化方法通常需要校准数据或导致显著的精度损失。PolarQuant旨在利用神经网络权重的分布结构，实现无需校准数据的近无损量化，同时为下游INT4量化提供有效的预处理步骤。
AI.method: PolarQuant采用三阶段方法：1）块归一化到单位超球面；2）Walsh-Hadamard旋转将坐标转换为近似高斯随机变量；3）基于高斯分布匹配的量化。其中Hadamard旋转贡献了98%的质量改进。
AI.result: PolarQuant Q5将Qwen3.5-9B的困惑度从6.90（absmax Q5）降低到6.40（仅比FP16高0.03），实现近乎无损压缩。作为INT4量化的预处理，PolarQuant Q5去量化后通过torchao INT4重量化达到困惑度6.56，优于直接absmax INT4的6.68，同时保持43.1 tok/s的吞吐量和6.5GB VRAM。
AI.conclusion: PolarQuant是一种有效的后训练量化方法，通过利用权重分布结构实现近无损压缩，无需校准数据，并能显著提升下游INT4量化的性能，为LLM部署提供了高效的压缩解决方案。

title: MEDiC: Multi-objective Exploration of Distillation from CLIP
summary: Masked image modeling (MIM) methods typically operate in either raw pixel space (reconstructing masked patches) or latent feature space (aligning with a pre-trained teacher). We present MEDiC (Multi-objective Exploration of Distillation from CLIP), a framework that combines both spaces in a single pipeline through three complementary objectives: patch-level token distillation from a frozen CLIP encoder, global CLS alignment, and pixel reconstruction via a lightweight decoder. We conduct a systematic investigation of the design space surrounding this multi-objective framework. First, we show that all three objectives provide complementary information, with the full combination reaching 73.9% kNN accuracy on ImageNet-1K. Second, we introduce hierarchical clustering with relative position bias for evolved masking and find that, despite producing more semantically coherent masks than prior methods, evolved masking does not outperform simple block masking in the teacher-guided distillation setting, a finding we attribute to the teacher's inherent semantic awareness. Third, we reveal that optimal scalar loss weights are extremely fragile, with small perturbations causing drops of up to 17 percentage points in kNN accuracy. Our framework achieves 73.9% kNN and 85.1% fine-tuning accuracy with ViT-Base at 300 epochs.

AI.tldr: MEDiC框架结合了像素空间和特征空间的掩码图像建模，通过三个互补目标实现：CLIP编码器的补丁级token蒸馏、全局CLS对齐和轻量解码器的像素重建。
AI.motivation: 现有掩码图像建模方法通常在原始像素空间（重建掩码补丁）或潜在特征空间（与预训练教师对齐）中操作，缺乏结合两种空间的统一框架。
AI.method: 提出MEDiC框架，通过三个目标：1) 从冻结CLIP编码器的补丁级token蒸馏；2) 全局CLS对齐；3) 通过轻量解码器的像素重建。系统研究设计空间，包括分层聚类与相对位置偏置的进化掩码。
AI.result: 三个目标提供互补信息，完整组合达到73.9% kNN准确率；进化掩码虽产生更语义一致的掩码，但在教师引导蒸馏中未超越简单块掩码；损失权重极其脆弱，小扰动可导致kNN准确率下降17个百分点。
AI.conclusion: MEDiC框架在ViT-Base上300轮训练达到73.9% kNN和85.1%微调准确率，证明了多目标蒸馏的有效性，同时揭示了教师语义意识对掩码策略的影响和损失权重的敏感性。

title: The Future of AI is Many, Not One
summary: The way we're thinking about generative AI right now is fundamentally individual. We see this not just in how users interact with models but also in how models are built, how they're benchmarked, and how commercial and research strategies using AI are defined. We argue that we should abandon this approach if we're hoping for AI to support groundbreaking innovation and scientific discovery. Drawing on research and formal results in complex systems, organizational behavior, and philosophy of science, we show why we should expect deep intellectual breakthroughs to come from epistemically diverse groups of AI agents working together rather than singular superintelligent agents. Having a diverse team broadens the search for solutions, delays premature consensus, and allows for the pursuit of unconventional approaches. Developing diverse AI teams also addresses AI critics' concerns that current models are constrained by past data and lack the creative insight required for innovation. The upshot, we argue, is that the future of transformative transformer-based AI is fundamentally many, not one.

AI.tldr: 论文主张放弃当前以个体为中心的生成式AI发展思路，认为突破性创新和科学发现应来自多样化的AI智能体团队协作，而非单一超级智能体。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式AI的发展过于注重个体模型，从用户交互、模型构建、基准测试到商业和研究策略都体现了个体主义思维。作者认为这种思路限制了AI在创新和科学发现方面的潜力，无法实现真正的突破。
AI.method: 基于复杂系统、组织行为和科学哲学的研究与形式化结果，论证了为什么深度智力突破应该来自认识论上多样化的AI智能体团队协作。通过理论分析和跨学科研究支持其观点。
AI.result: 研究表明：多样化的AI团队能够拓宽解决方案的搜索范围，延迟过早达成共识，允许追求非传统方法。这解决了当前AI模型受限于历史数据、缺乏创新洞察力的批评。
AI.conclusion: 变革性基于Transformer的AI的未来本质上是多元的而非单一的。应该发展多样化的AI团队协作模式，以支持突破性创新和科学发现。

title: APEX-EM: Non-Parametric Online Learning for Autonomous Agents via Structured Procedural-Episodic Experience Replay
summary:
LLM-based autonomous agents lack persistent procedural memory: they re-derive solutions from scratch even when structurally identical tasks have been solved before. We present \textbf{APEX-EM}, a non-parametric online learning framework that accumulates, retrieves, and reuses structured procedural plans without modifying model weights. APEX-EM introduces: (1) a \emph{structured experience representation} encoding the full procedural-episodic trace of each execution -- planning steps, artifacts, iteration history with error analysis, and quality scores; (2) a \emph{Plan-Retrieve-Generate-Iterate-Ingest} (PRGII) workflow with Task Verifiers providing multi-dimensional reward signals; and (3) a \emph{dual-outcome Experience Memory} with hybrid retrieval combining semantic search, structural signature matching, and plan DAG traversal -- enabling cross-domain transfer between tasks sharing no lexical overlap but analogous operational structure. Successful experiences serve as positive in-context examples; failures as negative examples with structured error annotations.
  We evaluate on BigCodeBench~\cite{zhuo2025bigcodebench}, KGQAGen-10k~\cite{zhang2025kgqagen}, and Humanity's Last Exam~\cite{phan2025hle} using Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Opus 4.5. On KGQAGen-10k, APEX-EM achieves 89.6\% accuracy versus 41.3\% without memory (+48.3pp), surpassing the oracle-retrieval upper bound (84.9\%). On BigCodeBench, it reaches 83.3\% SR from a 53.9\% baseline (+29.4pp), exceeding MemRL's~\cite{memrl2025} +11.0pp gain under comparable frozen-backbone conditions (noting backbone differences controlled for in our analysis). On HLE, entity graph retrieval reaches 48.0\% from 25.2\% (+22.8pp). Ablations show component value is task-dependent: rich judge feedback is negligible for code generation but critical for structured queries (+10.3pp), while binary-signal iteration partially compensates for weaker feedback.

AI.tldr: APEX-EM是一个非参数在线学习框架，通过结构化经验记忆实现LLM自主代理的持久程序记忆，无需修改模型权重，显著提升任务性能。
AI.motivation: 当前基于LLM的自主代理缺乏持久程序记忆，即使面对结构相同的任务也需要从头重新推导解决方案，导致效率低下和资源浪费。
AI.method: 提出APEX-EM框架，包含：1）结构化经验表示，编码完整的程序-情景执行轨迹；2）PRGII工作流程（计划-检索-生成-迭代-吸收），包含任务验证器提供多维奖励信号；3）双结果经验记忆，采用混合检索机制（语义搜索、结构签名匹配、计划DAG遍历），支持跨领域任务迁移。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中表现优异：KGQAGen-10k上准确率从41.3%提升至89.6%（+48.3pp），超过oracle检索上限；BigCodeBench上成功率从53.9%提升至83.3%（+29.4pp）；HLE上实体图检索从25.2%提升至48.0%（+22.8pp）。消融实验显示不同组件价值因任务而异。
AI.conclusion: APEX-EM通过非参数在线学习框架有效解决了LLM自主代理的程序记忆问题，实现了经验的结构化积累、检索和重用，显著提升了任务性能并支持跨领域知识迁移。

title: UltraG-Ray: Physics-Based Gaussian Ray Casting for Novel Ultrasound View Synthesis
comment: Accepted at MIDL 2026 / to appear in PMLR
summary: Novel view synthesis (NVS) in ultrasound has gained attention as a technique for generating anatomically plausible views beyond the acquired frames, offering new capabilities for training clinicians or data augmentation. However, current methods struggle with complex tissue and view-dependent acoustic effects. Physics-based NVS aims to address these limitations by including the ultrasound image formation process into the simulation. Recent approaches combine a learnable implicit scene representation with an ultrasound-specific rendering module, yet a substantial gap between simulation and reality remains. In this work, we introduce UltraG-Ray, a novel ultrasound scene representation based on a learnable 3D Gaussian field, coupled to an efficient physics-based module for B-mode synthesis. We explicitly encode ultrasound-specific parameters, such as attenuation and reflection, into a Gaussian-based spatial representation and realize image synthesis within a novel ray casting scheme. In contrast to previous methods, this approach naturally captures view-dependent attenuation effects, thereby enabling the generation of physically informed B-mode images with increased realism. We compare our method to state-of-the-art and observe consistent gains in image quality metrics (up to 15% increase on MS-SSIM), demonstrating clear improvement in terms of realism of the synthesized ultrasound images.

AI.tldr: 提出UltraG-Ray方法，基于可学习的3D高斯场进行超声场景表示，结合物理基础的B模式合成模块，显著提升超声图像合成的真实感
AI.motivation: 当前超声新视角合成方法在处理复杂组织和视角依赖的声学效应方面存在困难，基于物理的方法虽然结合了可学习隐式场景表示和超声特定渲染模块，但仿真与现实之间仍有显著差距
AI.method: 提出UltraG-Ray方法：1）基于可学习的3D高斯场进行超声场景表示；2）将超声特定参数（衰减、反射）编码到基于高斯的空间表示中；3）通过新颖的光线投射方案实现图像合成；4）自然捕捉视角依赖的衰减效应
AI.result: 与现有方法相比，在图像质量指标上获得一致提升（MS-SSIM最高提升15%），合成的超声图像真实感明显改善
AI.conclusion: UltraG-Ray方法通过结合可学习的3D高斯场表示和物理基础的渲染模块，能够生成更具物理真实感的B模式超声图像，显著提升了超声新视角合成的真实感

title: PAR$^2$-RAG: Planned Active Retrieval and Reasoning for Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain brittle on multi-hop question answering (MHQA), where answering requires combining evidence across documents through retrieval and reasoning. Iterative retrieval systems can fail by locking onto an early low-recall trajectory and amplifying downstream errors, while planning-only approaches may produce static query sets that cannot adapt when intermediate evidence changes. We propose \textbf{Planned Active Retrieval and Reasoning RAG (PAR$^2$-RAG)}, a two-stage framework that separates \emph{coverage} from \emph{commitment}. PAR$^2$-RAG first performs breadth-first anchoring to build a high-recall evidence frontier, then applies depth-first refinement with evidence sufficiency control in an iterative loop. Across four MHQA benchmarks, PAR$^2$-RAG consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art baselines, compared with IRCoT, PAR$^2$-RAG achieves up to \textbf{23.5\%} higher accuracy, with retrieval gains of up to \textbf{10.5\%} in NDCG.

AI.tldr: PAR²-RAG是一个两阶段框架，通过分离覆盖和承诺来改进多跳问答，先广度优先锚定建立高召回证据边界，再深度优先细化控制证据充分性，显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 当前LLMs在多跳问答中表现脆弱，迭代检索系统可能因早期低召回轨迹而失败并放大下游错误，而纯规划方法可能产生静态查询集无法适应中间证据变化。
AI.method: 提出PAR²-RAG两阶段框架：1）广度优先锚定建立高召回证据边界；2）深度优先细化在迭代循环中应用证据充分性控制，分离覆盖和承诺。
AI.result: 在四个多跳问答基准测试中，PAR²-RAG始终优于现有最先进基线，相比IRCoT实现高达23.5%的准确率提升，检索增益高达10.5%的NDCG。
AI.conclusion: PAR²-RAG通过分离覆盖和承诺的两阶段方法，有效解决了多跳问答中检索和推理的挑战，显著提升了LLMs在复杂问答任务中的性能。

title: Concept Training for Human-Aligned Language Models
summary: The next-token prediction (NTP) objective trains language models to predict a single continuation token at each step. In natural language, however, a prefix can be continued in many valid ways, and even similar meanings may differ in surface form. For example, the sentence ``this website is safe to \underline{browse}'' could plausibly continue with words such as browse, search, visit, surf, or navigate. While standard NTP training treats these alternatives as mutually exclusive targets, we explore a framework that instead predicts concepts, approximated as sets of semantically related tokens. We show that models trained with concept supervision exhibit stronger alignment with human semantic similarity judgments on multiple lexical benchmarks. These gains are accompanied by lower perplexity on semantically meaningful words (definition in Section 3.1), and a modest increase in global token-level perplexity, reflecting a tradeoff between standard NTP optimization and concept-level supervision. Our results suggest that concept-level objectives can improve semantic alignment while maintaining competitive language modeling performance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用概念监督替代传统下一词预测目标，通过预测语义相关词集而非单个词来提升语言模型的语义对齐能力。
AI.motivation: 传统下一词预测(NTP)目标将语义相似但表面形式不同的词视为互斥目标，忽略了自然语言中前缀可以有多种有效延续方式的问题。例如"this website is safe to __"可以接browse、search、visit等多个语义相关的词。
AI.method: 提出概念监督框架，将概念近似为语义相关词集，训练模型预测这些概念而非单个词。通过概念级监督替代标准NTP训练。
AI.result: 概念监督模型在多个词汇基准测试中与人类语义相似性判断更一致；在语义相关词上困惑度更低，全局词级困惑度略有增加，反映了标准NTP优化与概念监督之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 概念级目标可以在保持竞争力的语言建模性能的同时，改善模型的语义对齐能力。

title: MMFace-DiT: A Dual-Stream Diffusion Transformer for High-Fidelity Multimodal Face Generation
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR) 2026. 22 pages (Main Text + Supplementary), 14 figures, 5 tables, 4 algorithms. Project page: https://vcbsl.github.io/MMFace-DiT/ and Code Repository: https://github.com/Bharath-K3/MMFace-DiT
summary: Recent multimodal face generation models address the spatial control limitations of text-to-image diffusion models by augmenting text-based conditioning with spatial priors such as segmentation masks, sketches, or edge maps. This multimodal fusion enables controllable synthesis aligned with both high-level semantic intent and low-level structural layout. However, most existing approaches typically extend pre-trained text-to-image pipelines by appending auxiliary control modules or stitching together separate uni-modal networks. These ad hoc designs inherit architectural constraints, duplicate parameters, and often fail under conflicting modalities or mismatched latent spaces, limiting their ability to perform synergistic fusion across semantic and spatial domains. We introduce MMFace-DiT, a unified dual-stream diffusion transformer engineered for synergistic multimodal face synthesis. Its core novelty lies in a dual-stream transformer block that processes spatial (mask/sketch) and semantic (text) tokens in parallel, deeply fusing them through a shared Rotary Position-Embedded (RoPE) Attention mechanism. This design prevents modal dominance and ensures strong adherence to both text and structural priors to achieve unprecedented spatial-semantic consistency for controllable face generation. Furthermore, a novel Modality Embedder enables a single cohesive model to dynamically adapt to varying spatial conditions without retraining. MMFace-DiT achieves a 40% improvement in visual fidelity and prompt alignment over six state-of-the-art multimodal face generation models, establishing a flexible new paradigm for end-to-end controllable generative modeling. The code and dataset are available on our project page: https://vcbsl.github.io/MMFace-DiT/

AI.tldr: MMFace-DiT提出了一种统一的双流扩散Transformer架构，通过并行处理空间（掩码/草图）和语义（文本）token，实现协同多模态人脸生成，相比现有方法在视觉保真度和提示对齐方面提升40%。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态人脸生成模型通常通过附加控制模块或拼接单模态网络来扩展预训练文本到图像流程，这些临时设计存在架构限制、参数重复、模态冲突或潜在空间不匹配等问题，限制了语义和空间领域的协同融合能力。
AI.method: 提出MMFace-DiT，一个统一的双流扩散Transformer，核心创新是双流Transformer块，通过共享的旋转位置嵌入注意力机制并行处理空间和语义token，防止模态主导，确保同时遵循文本和结构先验。还引入了新颖的模态嵌入器，使单个模型能够动态适应不同的空间条件而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在六个最先进的多模态人脸生成模型上，MMFace-DiT实现了视觉保真度和提示对齐方面40%的改进，为端到端可控生成建模建立了灵活的新范式。
AI.conclusion: MMFace-DiT通过统一的双流架构实现了前所未有的空间语义一致性，为可控人脸生成提供了更有效的多模态融合解决方案，代码和数据集已在项目页面公开。

title: GISTBench: Evaluating LLM User Understanding via Evidence-Based Interest Verification
summary: We introduce GISTBench, a benchmark for evaluating Large Language Models' (LLMs) ability to understand users from their interaction histories in recommendation systems. Unlike traditional RecSys benchmarks that focus on item prediction accuracy, our benchmark evaluates how well LLMs can extract and verify user interests from engagement data. We propose two novel metric families: Interest Groundedness (IG), decomposed into precision and recall components to separately penalize hallucinated interest categories and reward coverage, and Interest Specificity (IS), which assesses the distinctiveness of verified LLM-predicted user profiles. We release a synthetic dataset constructed on real user interactions on a global short-form video platform. Our dataset contains both implicit and explicit engagement signals and rich textual descriptions. We validate our dataset fidelity against user surveys, and evaluate eight open-weight LLMs spanning 7B to 120B parameters. Our findings reveal performance bottlenecks in current LLMs, particularly their limited ability to accurately count and attribute engagement signals across heterogeneous interaction types.

AI.tldr: GISTBench是一个评估大语言模型从推荐系统交互历史中理解用户能力的基准，关注用户兴趣提取而非传统推荐准确性，提出两种新指标家族并基于真实短视频平台数据构建合成数据集。
AI.motivation: 传统推荐系统基准主要关注物品预测准确性，而缺乏评估LLMs从用户交互历史中理解和提取用户兴趣的能力。需要新的评估框架来衡量LLMs如何从异质交互数据中识别和验证用户兴趣。
AI.method: 提出GISTBench基准，包含两种新指标家族：兴趣基础性（分解为精确率和召回率）和兴趣特异性。基于全球短视频平台的真实用户交互构建合成数据集，包含隐式和显式参与信号及丰富文本描述。评估8个参数量从7B到120B的开源LLMs。
AI.result: 验证了数据集对用户调查的保真度，发现当前LLMs存在性能瓶颈，特别是在准确计数和跨异质交互类型归因参与信号方面能力有限。
AI.conclusion: GISTBench为评估LLMs在推荐系统中理解用户的能力提供了新基准，揭示了当前模型在用户兴趣提取方面的局限性，为未来改进提供了方向。

title: Kwame 2.0: Human-in-the-Loop Generative AI Teaching Assistant for Large Scale Online Coding Education in Africa
comment: 8 pages, Accepted at the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026)
summary: Providing timely and accurate learning support in large-scale online coding courses is challenging, particularly in resource-constrained contexts. We present Kwame 2.0, a bilingual (English-French) generative AI teaching assistant built using retrieval-augmented generation and deployed in a human-in-the-loop forum within SuaCode, an introductory mobile-based coding course for learners across Africa. Kwame 2.0 retrieves relevant course materials and generates context-aware responses while encouraging human oversight and community participation. We deployed the system in a 15-month longitudinal study spanning 15 cohorts with 3,717 enrollments across 35 African countries. Evaluation using community feedback and expert ratings shows that Kwame 2.0 provided high-quality and timely support, achieving high accuracy on curriculum-related questions, while human facilitators and peers effectively mitigated errors, particularly for administrative queries. Our findings demonstrate that human-in-the-loop generative AI systems can combine the scalability and speed of AI with the reliability of human support, offering an effective approach to learning assistance for underrepresented populations in resource-constrained settings at scale.

AI.tldr: Kwame 2.0是一个基于检索增强生成的双语AI教学助手，在非洲移动编程课程中通过人机协同论坛提供学习支持，15个月研究表明其能提供高质量及时帮助。
AI.motivation: 在大规模在线编程课程中，特别是在资源受限的非洲背景下，提供及时准确的学习支持具有挑战性。需要一种能够结合AI可扩展性和人类可靠性的解决方案。
AI.method: 开发了Kwame 2.0双语（英法）生成式AI教学助手，采用检索增强生成技术，部署在SuaCode课程的人机协同论坛中。通过15个月纵向研究，覆盖15个队列、3,717名学员、35个非洲国家。
AI.result: Kwame 2.0在课程相关问题中实现了高准确性，提供了高质量和及时的支持。人类辅导员和同伴有效缓解了错误，特别是在行政查询方面。社区反馈和专家评分证实了系统的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 人机协同的生成式AI系统能够结合AI的可扩展性和速度与人类支持的可靠性，为资源受限环境中的边缘化群体提供有效的规模化学习支持方案。

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Noise Pretraining for Implicit Neural Representations
summary: The approximation and convergence properties of implicit neural representations (INRs) are known to be highly sensitive to parameter initialization strategies. While several data-driven initialization methods demonstrate significant improvements over standard random sampling, the reasons for their success -- specifically, whether they encode classical statistical signal priors or more complex features -- remain poorly understood. In this study, we explore this phenomenon through a series of experimental analyses leveraging noise pretraining. We pretrain INRs on diverse noise classes (e.g., Gaussian, Dead Leaves, Spectral) and measure their ability to both fit unseen signals and encode priors for an inverse imaging task (denoising). Our analyses on image and video data reveal a surprising finding: simply pretraining on unstructured noise (Uniform, Gaussian) dramatically improves signal fitting capacity compared to all other baselines. However, unstructured noise also yields poor deep image priors for denoising. In contrast, we also find that noise with the classic $1/|f^α|$ spectral structure of natural images achieves an excellent balance of signal fitting and inverse imaging capabilities, performing on par with the best data-driven initialization methods. This finding enables more efficient INR training in applications lacking sufficient prior domain-specific data. For more details, visit project page at https://kushalvyas.github.io/noisepretraining.html

AI.tldr: 研究发现，通过无结构噪声（均匀、高斯）预训练INR能显著提升信号拟合能力，但图像去噪性能差；而具有自然图像频谱结构（1/|f|^α）的噪声预训练则在信号拟合和逆成像任务上取得最佳平衡。
AI.motivation: 研究隐式神经表示（INR）初始化策略对近似和收敛性能的影响，探索数据驱动初始化方法成功的原因——是编码了经典统计信号先验还是更复杂的特征。
AI.method: 通过噪声预训练实验分析：在不同类型噪声（高斯、Dead Leaves、频谱等）上预训练INR，测量其拟合未见信号的能力和在逆成像任务（去噪）中编码先验的能力。
AI.result: 1. 无结构噪声（均匀、高斯）预训练显著提升信号拟合能力，优于其他基线方法；2. 但无结构噪声预训练得到的深度图像先验在去噪任务中表现差；3. 具有自然图像经典频谱结构（1/|f|^α）的噪声预训练在信号拟合和逆成像能力上达到最佳平衡，性能与最佳数据驱动初始化方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 噪声预训练研究表明，具有自然图像频谱结构的噪声能够有效平衡信号拟合和逆成像能力，为缺乏足够领域特定数据的INR训练提供了更高效的初始化方法。

title: SciVisAgentBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Scientific Data Analysis and Visualization Agents
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems that translate natural language intent into executable scientific visualization (SciVis) tasks. Despite rapid progress, the community lacks a principled and reproducible benchmark for evaluating these emerging SciVis agents in realistic, multi-step analysis settings. We present SciVisAgentBench, a comprehensive and extensible benchmark for evaluating scientific data analysis and visualization agents. Our benchmark is grounded in a structured taxonomy spanning four dimensions: application domain, data type, complexity level, and visualization operation. It currently comprises 108 expert-crafted cases covering diverse SciVis scenarios. To enable reliable assessment, we introduce a multimodal outcome-centric evaluation pipeline that combines LLM-based judging with deterministic evaluators, including image-based metrics, code checkers, rule-based verifiers, and case-specific evaluators. We also conduct a validity study with 12 SciVis experts to examine the agreement between human and LLM judges. Using this framework, we evaluate representative SciVis agents and general-purpose coding agents to establish initial baselines and reveal capability gaps. SciVisAgentBench is designed as a living benchmark to support systematic comparison, diagnose failure modes, and drive progress in agentic SciVis. The benchmark is available at https://scivisagentbench.github.io/.

AI.tldr: SciVisAgentBench是一个用于评估科学数据分析和可视化代理的综合性基准测试，包含108个专家设计的案例，采用多模态结果中心评估管道，旨在系统比较和推动代理化科学可视化的发展。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在科学可视化代理系统方面取得了进展，但社区缺乏一个原则性和可复现的基准来评估这些新兴代理在现实多步骤分析场景中的表现。
AI.method: 提出了一个基于四个维度（应用领域、数据类型、复杂度级别、可视化操作）的结构化分类法，包含108个专家设计的案例。开发了多模态结果中心评估管道，结合基于LLM的评判和确定性评估器（包括基于图像的指标、代码检查器、基于规则的验证器和案例特定评估器）。
AI.result: 评估了代表性的科学可视化代理和通用编码代理，建立了初始基线并揭示了能力差距。进行了有效性研究，检查了人类专家和LLM评判者之间的一致性。
AI.conclusion: SciVisAgentBench是一个可扩展的基准测试，旨在支持系统比较、诊断失败模式并推动代理化科学可视化的进展。该基准被设计为"活的基准"，将持续更新以反映领域发展。

title: SyriSign: A Parallel Corpus for Arabic Text to Syrian Arabic Sign Language Translation
summary: Sign language is the primary approach of communication for the Deaf and Hard-of-Hearing (DHH) community. While there are numerous benchmarks for high-resource sign languages, low-resource languages like Arabic remain underrepresented. Currently, there is no publicly available dataset for Syrian Arabic Sign Language (SyArSL). To overcome this gap, we introduce SyriSign, a dataset comprising 1500 video samples across 150 unique lexical signs, designed for text-to-SyArSL translation tasks. This work aims to reduce communication barriers in Syria, as most news are delivered in spoken or written Arabic, which is often inaccessible to the deaf community. We evaluated SyriSign using three deep learning architectures: MotionCLIP for semantic motion generation, T2M-GPT for text-conditioned motion synthesis, and SignCLIP for bilingual embedding alignment. Experimental results indicate that while generative approaches show strong potential for sign representation, the limited dataset size constrains generalization performance. We will release SyriSign publicly, hoping it serves as an initial benchmark.

AI.tldr: SyriSign是首个叙利亚阿拉伯手语公开数据集，包含150个独特词汇手势的1500个视频样本，用于文本到手语翻译任务，旨在解决叙利亚聋人社区的信息获取障碍。
AI.motivation: 叙利亚阿拉伯手语目前没有公开数据集，而高资源手语已有大量基准，低资源手语如阿拉伯手语代表性不足。叙利亚新闻通常以口语或书面阿拉伯语传播，这对聋人社区造成沟通障碍。
AI.method: 创建SyriSign数据集，包含150个独特词汇手势的1500个视频样本。使用三种深度学习架构进行评估：MotionCLIP用于语义动作生成，T2M-GPT用于文本条件动作合成，SignCLIP用于双语嵌入对齐。
AI.result: 生成方法在手语表示方面显示出强大潜力，但有限的数据集规模限制了泛化性能。实验结果表明需要更大规模的数据集来提升模型性能。
AI.conclusion: SyriSign作为首个叙利亚阿拉伯手语公开数据集，将公开发布作为初始基准，旨在促进该领域研究，减少叙利亚聋人社区的沟通障碍。

title: Generating Humanless Environment Walkthroughs from Egocentric Walking Tour Videos
summary: Egocentric "walking tour" videos provide a rich source of image data to develop rich and diverse visual models of environments around the world. However, the significant presence of humans in frames of these videos due to crowds and eye-level camera perspectives mitigates their usefulness in environment modeling applications. We focus on addressing this challenge by developing a generative algorithm that can realistically remove (i.e., inpaint) humans and their associated shadow effects from walking tour videos. Key to our approach is the construction of a rich semi-synthetic dataset of video clip pairs to train this generative model. Each pair in the dataset consists of an environment-only background clip, and a composite clip of walking humans with simulated shadows overlaid on the background. We randomly sourced both foreground and background components from real egocentric walking tour videos around the world to maintain visual diversity. We then used this dataset to fine-tune the state-of-the-art Casper video diffusion model for object and effects inpainting, and demonstrate that the resulting model performs far better than Casper both qualitatively and quantitatively at removing humans from walking tour clips with significant human presence and complex backgrounds. Finally, we show that the resulting generated clips can be used to build successful 3D/4D models of urban locations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种生成算法，用于从步行游览视频中逼真地移除人类及其阴影，以改善环境建模应用
AI.motivation: 第一人称视角的"步行游览"视频包含丰富的环境图像数据，但由于人群和眼平视角导致视频中存在大量人类，这限制了其在环境建模中的应用价值
AI.method: 构建半合成数据集训练生成模型，数据集包含环境背景片段和叠加了模拟行走人类及阴影的合成片段；使用该数据集微调最先进的Casper视频扩散模型进行物体和效果修复
AI.result: 训练出的模型在移除步行游览视频中人类方面，在定性和定量上都显著优于原始Casper模型，特别是在人类存在显著且背景复杂的情况下
AI.conclusion: 生成的视频片段可用于成功构建城市地点的3D/4D模型，解决了人类存在对第一人称视频环境建模的干扰问题

title: REFINE: Real-world Exploration of Interactive Feedback and Student Behaviour
summary: Formative feedback is central to effective learning, yet providing timely, individualised feedback at scale remains a persistent challenge. While recent work has explored the use of large language models (LLMs) to automate feedback, most existing systems still conceptualise feedback as a static, one-way artifact, offering limited support for interpretation, clarification, or follow-up. In this work, we introduce REFINE, a locally deployable, multi-agent feedback system built on small, open-source LLMs that treats feedback as an interactive process. REFINE combines a pedagogically-grounded feedback generation agent with an LLM-as-a-judge-guided regeneration loop using a human-aligned judge, and a self-reflective tool-calling interactive agent that supports student follow-up questions with context-aware, actionable responses. We evaluate REFINE through controlled experiments and an authentic classroom deployment in an undergraduate computer science course. Automatic evaluations show that judge-guided regeneration significantly improves feedback quality, and that the interactive agent produces efficient, high-quality responses comparable to a state-of-the-art closed-source model. Analysis of real student interactions further reveals distinct engagement patterns and indicates that system-generated feedback systematically steers subsequent student inquiry. Our findings demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of multi-agent, tool-augmented feedback systems for scalable, interactive feedback.

AI.tldr: REFINE是一个基于开源小语言模型的多智能体反馈系统，将反馈视为交互过程而非静态产物，通过教学反馈生成、法官引导的再生循环和自省工具调用交互智能体，在真实课堂部署中证明其可行性和有效性。
AI.motivation: 形成性反馈对有效学习至关重要，但在大规模提供及时、个性化反馈方面存在持续挑战。现有基于大语言模型的反馈系统大多将反馈视为静态、单向产物，缺乏对解释、澄清或后续跟进的支持。
AI.method: 开发REFINE系统，包含三个核心组件：1) 基于教学理论的反馈生成智能体；2) 使用人类对齐法官的LLM-as-a-judge引导再生循环；3) 自省工具调用交互智能体，支持学生后续问题并提供情境感知、可操作的响应。
AI.result: 自动评估显示法官引导的再生显著提高反馈质量，交互智能体产生的响应效率和质量与最先进的闭源模型相当。真实学生互动分析揭示不同的参与模式，系统生成的反馈能系统性地引导后续学生提问。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体、工具增强的反馈系统在实现可扩展、交互式反馈方面具有可行性和有效性，为教育技术提供了新的方向。

title: SiPaKosa: A Comprehensive Corpus of Canonical and Classical Buddhist Texts in Sinhala and Pali
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables, Accepted paper at the 2nd Workshop on Challenges in Processing South Asian Languages (CHiPSAL) @ LREC 2026
summary: SiPaKosa is a comprehensive corpus of Sinhala and Pali doctrinal texts comprising approximately 786K sentences and 9.25M words, incorporating 16 copyright-cleared historical Buddhist documents alongside the complete web-scraped Tripitaka canonical texts. The corpus was created through high-quality OCR using Google Document AI on historical manuscripts, combined with systematic web scraping of canonical repositories, followed by rigorous quality control and metadata annotation. The corpus is organised into language-specific subcorpora: Sinhala and Mixed Sinhala-Pali. We evaluate the performance of language models using ten pretrained models, with perplexity scores ranging from 1.09 to 189.67 on our corpus. This analysis shows that proprietary models significantly outperform open-source alternatives by factors of three to six times. This corpus supports the pretraining of domain-adapted language models, facilitates historical language analysis, and aids in the development of information retrieval systems for Buddhist scholarship while preserving Sinhala cultural heritage.

AI.tldr: SiPaKosa是一个包含僧伽罗语和巴利语佛教教义文本的综合语料库，包含约78.6万句子和925万单词，整合了16个版权清理的历史佛教文献和完整的网络爬取的《三藏》经典文本。
AI.motivation: 创建这个语料库是为了支持领域适应的语言模型预训练，促进历史语言分析，帮助开发佛教学术的信息检索系统，同时保护僧伽罗文化遗产。
AI.method: 使用Google Document AI对历史手稿进行高质量OCR处理，结合系统性的网络爬取经典存储库，然后进行严格的质量控制和元数据标注。语料库按语言组织为僧伽罗语和僧伽罗-巴利混合语两个子语料库。
AI.result: 评估了10个预训练模型在语料库上的性能，困惑度得分范围从1.09到189.67。分析显示专有模型显著优于开源替代品，性能高出3到6倍。
AI.conclusion: SiPaKosa语料库为僧伽罗语和巴利语佛教文本研究提供了重要资源，支持语言模型开发、历史语言分析和文化遗产保护，同时揭示了专有模型在特定领域任务上的性能优势。

title: Let the Abyss Stare Back Adaptive Falsification for Autonomous Scientific Discovery
summary: Autonomous scientific discovery is entering a more dangerous regime: once the evaluator is frozen, a sufficiently strong search process can learn to win the exam without learning the mechanism the task was meant to reveal. This is the idea behind our title. To let the abyss stare back is to make evaluation actively push against the candidate through adaptive falsification, rather than passively certify it through static validation. We introduce DASES, a falsification-driven framework in which an Innovator, an Abyss Falsifier, and a Mechanistic Causal Extractor co-evolve executable scientific artifacts and scientifically admissible counterexample environments under a fixed scientific contract. In a controlled loss-discovery problem with a single editable locus, DASES rejects artifacts that static validation would have accepted, identifies the first candidate that survives the admissible falsification frontier, and discovers FNG-CE, a loss that transfers beyond the synthetic discovery environment and consistently outperforms CE and CE+L2 under controlled comparisons across standard benchmarks, including ImageNet.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DASES框架，通过主动证伪而非静态验证来防止AI系统在科学发现中"作弊"学习，成功发现了超越标准基准的FNG-CE损失函数。
AI.motivation: 随着自主科学发现进入更危险的领域，一旦评估器固定，强大的搜索过程可能学会通过"作弊"通过考试，而不是真正理解任务背后的机制。需要从被动验证转向主动证伪。
AI.method: 提出DASES框架，包含创新者、深渊证伪者和机制因果提取器三个组件，在固定科学契约下共同演化可执行科学工件和科学上可接受的反例环境。
AI.result: 在可控损失发现问题中，DASES拒绝了静态验证会接受的工件，识别出首个在可接受证伪边界上存活的候选者，并发现了FNG-CE损失函数，该函数在标准基准测试中持续优于CE和CE+L2。
AI.conclusion: 主动证伪框架DASES能够有效防止AI系统在科学发现中的"作弊"行为，推动真正的机制理解，并发现了具有实际应用价值的损失函数。

title: Long-Document QA with Chain-of-Structured-Thought and Fine-Tuned SLMs
comment: 26 pages, 17 figures, 10 tables. Accepted at ICLR 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are widely applied to data analytics over documents, yet direct reasoning over long, noisy documents remains brittle and error-prone. Hence, we study document question answering (QA) that consolidates dispersed evidence into a structured output (e.g., a table, graph, or chunks) to support reliable, verifiable QA. We propose a two-pillar framework, LiteCoST, to achieve both high accuracy and low latency with small language models (SLMs). Pillar 1: Chain-of-Structured-Thought (CoST). We introduce a CoST template, a schema-aware instruction that guides a strong LLM to produce both a step-wise CoST trace and the corresponding structured output. The process induces a minimal structure, normalizes entities/units, aligns records, serializes the output, and verifies/refines it, yielding auditable supervision. Pillar 2: SLM fine-tuning. The compact models are trained on LLM-generated CoST data in two stages: Supervised Fine-Tuning for structural alignment, followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) incorporating triple rewards for answer/format quality and process consistency. By distilling structure-first behavior into SLMs, this approach achieves LLM-comparable quality on multi-domain long-document QA using 3B/7B SLMs, while delivering 2-4x lower latency than GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 (671B). The code is available at https://github.com/HKUSTDial/LiteCoST.

AI.tldr: LiteCoST框架使用小型语言模型实现文档问答，通过结构化思维链和两阶段微调，在保持高准确性的同时降低延迟
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型直接处理长文档问答时存在脆弱性和错误率高的问题，需要一种可靠、可验证的方法来整合分散的证据
AI.method: 提出两支柱框架：1) 结构化思维链(CoST)，指导强LLM生成结构化输出；2) SLM微调，通过监督微调和GRPO优化训练小型模型
AI.result: 使用3B/7B小型模型在多领域长文档问答中达到与LLM相当的质量，延迟比GPT-4o和DeepSeek-R1低2-4倍
AI.conclusion: LiteCoST通过结构优先的方法将LLM能力蒸馏到小型模型中，实现了高准确性、低延迟的文档问答系统

title: LA-Sign: Looped Transformers with Geometry-aware Alignment for Skeleton-based Sign Language Recognition
summary: Skeleton-based isolated sign language recognition (ISLR) demands fine-grained understanding of articulated motion across multiple spatial scales, from subtle finger movements to global body dynamics. Existing approaches typically rely on deep feed-forward architectures, which increase model capacity but lack mechanisms for recurrent refinement and structured representation. We propose LA-Sign, a looped transformer framework with geometry-aware alignment for ISLR. Instead of stacking deeper layers, LA-Sign derives its depth from recurrence, repeatedly revisiting latent representations to progressively refine motion understanding under shared parameters. To further regularise this refinement process, we present a geometry-aware contrastive objective that projects skeletal and textual features into an adaptive hyperbolic space, encouraging multi-scale semantic organisation. We study three looping designs and multiple geometric manifolds, demonstrating that encoder-decoder looping combined with adaptive Poincare alignment yields the strongest performance. Extensive experiments on WLASL and MSASL benchmarks show that LA-Sign achieves state-of-the-art results while using fewer unique layers, highlighting the effectiveness of recurrent latent refinement and geometry-aware representation learning for sign language recognition.

AI.tldr: LA-Sign：一种基于循环Transformer和几何感知对齐的骨架手语识别框架，通过循环精炼潜在表示和双曲空间对比学习实现多尺度运动理解，在WLASL和MSASL基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架手语识别方法主要依赖深度前馈架构，虽然增加了模型容量，但缺乏循环精炼机制和结构化表示能力。需要一种能够渐进式精炼运动理解并实现多尺度语义组织的框架。
AI.method: 提出LA-Sign框架：1）循环Transformer架构，通过共享参数的循环机制反复访问潜在表示来渐进精炼运动理解；2）几何感知对比目标，将骨架和文本特征投影到自适应双曲空间，促进多尺度语义组织；3）研究了三种循环设计和多种几何流形。
AI.result: 在WLASL和MSASL基准测试中，编码器-解码器循环设计结合自适应Poincare对齐取得了最强性能，实现了最先进的结果，同时使用了更少的独特层数。
AI.conclusion: 循环潜在精炼和几何感知表示学习对于手语识别是有效的，LA-Sign通过循环深度而非堆叠层数实现了更好的性能，证明了循环精炼机制和结构化几何表示的重要性。

title: SimMOF: AI agent for Automated MOF Simulations
summary: Metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) offer a vast design space, and as such, computational simulations play a critical role in predicting their structural and physicochemical properties. However, MOF simulations remain difficult to access because reliable analysis require expert decisions for workflow construction, parameter selection, tool interoperability, and the preparation of computational ready structures. Here, we introduce SimMOF, a large language model based multi agent framework that automates end-to-end MOF simulation workflows from natural language queries. SimMOF translates user requests into dependency aware plans, generates runnable inputs, orchestrates multiple agents to execute simulations, and summarizes results with analysis aligned to the user query. Through representative case studies, we show that SimMOF enables adaptive and cognitively autonomous workflows that reflect the iterative and decision driven behavior of human researchers and as such provides a scalable foundation for data driven MOF research.

AI.tldr: SimMOF是一个基于大语言模型的多智能体框架，能够通过自然语言查询自动化端到端的MOF模拟工作流程。
AI.motivation: MOF模拟难以访问，因为可靠的分析需要专家决策工作流程构建、参数选择、工具互操作性和计算就绪结构准备。
AI.method: 开发基于大语言模型的多智能体框架SimMOF，将用户请求转换为依赖感知计划，生成可运行输入，编排多个智能体执行模拟，并根据用户查询总结分析结果。
AI.result: 通过代表性案例研究显示，SimMOF能够实现适应性和认知自主的工作流程，反映人类研究人员的迭代和决策驱动行为。
AI.conclusion: SimMOF为数据驱动的MOF研究提供了可扩展的基础，自动化了端到端的MOF模拟工作流程。

title: The Thiomi Dataset: A Large-Scale Multimodal Corpus for Low-Resource African Languages
summary: We present the Thiomi Dataset, a large-scale multimodal corpus spanning ten African languages across four language families: Swahili, Kikuyu, Kamba, Kimeru, Luo, Maasai, Kipsigis, Somali (East Africa); Wolof (West Africa); and Fulani (West/Central Africa). The dataset contains over 601,000 approved sentence-level text annotations and over 385,000 audio recordings across nine languages, collected through a dedicated community data collection platform involving over 100 contributors. The Thiomi platform collected data for nine languages; Swahili data was supplemented with existing Common Voice recordings. A multi-tier quality assurance pipeline achieves 86-100% text approval rates for the six primary languages. To validate the dataset's utility, we train and evaluate ASR, MT, and TTS models, establishing baselines across all ten languages. Our best ASR system achieves 3.24% WER on Swahili (Common Voice), reducing prior academic SOTA from 8.3% to 3.24% (5.1 percentage point absolute, 61% relative reduction), and 4.3% WER on Somali. The dataset will be published on HuggingFace. We describe the collection platform, quality assurance workflows, and baseline experiments, and discuss implications for African language technology infrastructure.

AI.tldr: Thiomi数据集是一个包含10种非洲语言的大规模多模态语料库，涵盖4个语系，包含超过60万条文本标注和38.5万条音频录音，通过社区平台收集，质量保证流程达到86-100%的文本批准率，在ASR、MT和TTS任务上建立了基线模型。
AI.motivation: 非洲语言在语言技术领域资源匮乏，缺乏大规模、高质量的多模态数据集。本研究旨在填补这一空白，为10种非洲语言构建全面的语料库，支持自动语音识别、机器翻译和文本转语音等技术的发展。
AI.method: 通过专门的社区数据收集平台（Thiomi平台）收集9种语言的数据，涉及100多名贡献者；斯瓦希里语数据补充了现有的Common Voice录音。采用多层质量保证流程确保数据质量，文本批准率达到86-100%。
AI.result: 数据集包含超过601,000条批准的句子级文本标注和385,000条音频录音。最佳ASR系统在斯瓦希里语上达到3.24%的词错误率（相对先前SOTA降低61%），在索马里语上达到4.3%的词错误率。建立了所有10种语言的ASR、MT和TTS基线模型。
AI.conclusion: Thiomi数据集为非洲语言技术提供了重要基础设施，显著提升了ASR性能，展示了社区参与数据收集的有效性。该数据集将在HuggingFace上发布，有望推动非洲语言技术发展。

title: Is the Modality Gap a Bug or a Feature? A Robustness Perspective
summary: Many modern multi-modal models (e.g. CLIP) seek an embedding space in which the two modalities are aligned. Somewhat surprisingly, almost all existing models show a strong modality gap: the distribution of images is well-separated from the distribution of texts in the shared embedding space. Despite a series of recent papers on this topic, it is still not clear why this gap exists nor whether closing the gap in post-processing will lead to better performance on downstream tasks. In this paper we show that under certain conditions, minimizing the contrastive loss yields a representation in which the two modalities are separated by a global gap vector that is orthogonal to their embeddings. We also show that under these conditions the modality gap is monotonically related to robustness: decreasing the gap does not change the clean accuracy of the models but makes it less likely that a model will change its output when the embeddings are perturbed. Our experiments show that for many real-world VLMs we can significantly increase robustness by a simple post-processing step that moves one modality towards the mean of the other modality, without any loss of clean accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文研究发现多模态模型存在模态间隙现象，并证明减小该间隙能提升模型鲁棒性而不影响准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态模型（如CLIP）在共享嵌入空间中存在明显的模态间隙（图像和文本分布分离），但这种现象的原因尚不清楚，且关闭间隙是否能提升下游任务性能也未明确。
AI.method: 在特定条件下分析对比损失最小化如何产生模态间隙，提出简单的后处理步骤：将一个模态的嵌入向另一个模态的均值移动。
AI.result: 研究发现模态间隙与鲁棒性单调相关：减小间隙不会改变模型的干净准确率，但能降低嵌入扰动时模型改变输出的可能性。实验表明该后处理方法能显著提升现实VLM的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 模态间隙是优化对比损失的自然结果，减小该间隙能有效提升多模态模型的鲁棒性，且可通过简单后处理实现而不损失准确率。

title: WorldFlow3D: Flowing Through 3D Distributions for Unbounded World Generation
summary: Unbounded 3D world generation is emerging as a foundational task for scene modeling in computer vision, graphics, and robotics. In this work, we present WorldFlow3D, a novel method capable of generating unbounded 3D worlds. Building upon a foundational property of flow matching - namely, defining a path of transport between two data distributions - we model 3D generation more generally as a problem of flowing through 3D data distributions, not limited to conditional denoising. We find that our latent-free flow approach generates causal and accurate 3D structure, and can use this as an intermediate distribution to guide the generation of more complex structure and high-quality texture - all while converging more rapidly than existing methods. We enable controllability over generated scenes with vectorized scene layout conditions for geometric structure control and visual texture control through scene attributes. We confirm the effectiveness of WorldFlow3D on both real outdoor driving scenes and synthetic indoor scenes, validating cross-domain generalizability and high-quality generation on real data distributions. We confirm favorable scene generation fidelity over approaches in all tested settings for unbounded scene generation. For more, see https://light.princeton.edu/worldflow3d.

AI.tldr: WorldFlow3D是一种基于流匹配的新型无界3D世界生成方法，通过定义数据分布间的传输路径实现高质量3D场景生成，支持几何结构和纹理控制。
AI.motivation: 无界3D世界生成是计算机视觉、图形学和机器人学中场景建模的基础任务，现有方法多局限于条件去噪，需要更通用的3D数据分布流建模方法。
AI.method: 基于流匹配的核心特性，将3D生成建模为在3D数据分布间的流动问题，采用无潜在变量的流方法生成准确的3D结构，并以此作为中间分布指导更复杂结构和高质量纹理的生成。
AI.result: 在真实室外驾驶场景和合成室内场景上验证了方法的有效性，展示了跨域泛化能力和在真实数据分布上的高质量生成，在无界场景生成的所有测试设置中都优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: WorldFlow3D通过流匹配方法实现了高质量、可控的无界3D世界生成，收敛速度更快，支持向量化场景布局条件和视觉纹理控制，为3D场景建模提供了有效解决方案。

title: AEC-Bench: A Multimodal Benchmark for Agentic Systems in Architecture, Engineering, and Construction
summary: The AEC-Bench is a multimodal benchmark for evaluating agentic systems on real-world tasks in the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) domain. The benchmark covers tasks requiring drawing understanding, cross-sheet reasoning, and construction project-level coordination. This report describes the benchmark motivation, dataset taxonomy, evaluation protocol, and baseline results across several domain-specific foundation model harnesses. We use AEC-Bench to identify consistent tools and harness design techniques that uniformly improve performance across foundation models in their own base harnesses, such as Claude Code and Codex. We openly release our benchmark dataset, agent harness, and evaluation code for full replicability at https://github.com/nomic-ai/aec-bench under an Apache 2 license.

AI.tldr: AEC-Bench是一个用于评估建筑、工程和施工领域智能代理系统的多模态基准测试，涵盖图纸理解、跨图纸推理和项目协调等真实任务。
AI.motivation: 为建筑、工程和施工（AEC）领域开发一个专门的多模态基准测试，以评估智能代理系统在真实世界任务中的表现，填补该领域缺乏标准化评估工具的空白。
AI.method: 创建包含图纸理解、跨图纸推理和施工项目协调任务的数据集，设计评估协议，并在多个领域特定基础模型上建立基准结果，识别能提升性能的工具和架构设计技术。
