AI.result: 开发了完整的基准测试套件，识别出能一致提升不同基础模型性能的工具和架构设计技术，如Claude Code和Codex等模型在其基础架构中表现出的改进。
AI.conclusion: AEC-Bench为AEC领域的智能代理系统评估提供了标准化工具，通过开源数据集、代理架构和评估代码确保可复现性，有助于推动该领域AI技术的发展。

title: CADEL: A Corpus of Administrative Web Documents for Japanese Entity Linking
summary: Entity linking is the task of associating linguistic expressions with entries in a knowledge base that represent real-world entities and concepts. Language resources for this task have primarily been developed for English, and the resources available for evaluating Japanese systems remain limited. In this study, we develop a corpus design policy for the entity linking task and construct an annotated corpus for training and evaluating Japanese entity linking systems, with rich coverage of linguistic expressions referring to entities that are specific to Japan. Evaluation of inter-annotator agreement confirms the high consistency of the annotations in the corpus, and a preliminary experiment on entity disambiguation based on string matching suggests that the corpus contains a substantial number of non-trivial cases, supporting its potential usefulness as an evaluation benchmark.

AI.tldr: 构建了一个用于训练和评估日语实体链接系统的标注语料库，覆盖了日本特有的实体表达，验证了标注一致性和语料库的实用性。
AI.motivation: 实体链接任务的语言资源主要针对英语开发，日语系统的评估资源有限，需要构建专门针对日语的实体链接语料库。
AI.method: 制定了实体链接任务的语料库设计策略，构建了包含日本特有实体表达的标注语料库，并通过标注者间一致性评估和基于字符串匹配的实体消歧初步实验来验证语料质量。
AI.result: 标注者间一致性评估确认了语料库标注的高一致性，初步实验表明语料库包含大量非平凡案例，支持其作为评估基准的潜在有用性。
AI.conclusion: 成功构建了用于日语实体链接系统的训练和评估语料库，该语料库具有高质量的标注和实际应用价值，填补了日语实体链接资源的空白。

title: TrajectoryMover: Generative Movement of Object Trajectories in Videos
summary: Generative video editing has enabled several intuitive editing operations for short video clips that would previously have been difficult to achieve, especially for non-expert editors. Existing methods focus on prescribing an object's 3D or 2D motion trajectory in a video, or on altering the appearance of an object or a scene, while preserving both the video's plausibility and identity. Yet a method to move an object's 3D motion trajectory in a video, i.e., moving an object while preserving its relative 3D motion, is currently still missing. The main challenge lies in obtaining paired video data for this scenario. Previous methods typically rely on clever data generation approaches to construct plausible paired data from unpaired videos, but this approach fails if one of the videos in a pair can not easily be constructed from the other. Instead, we introduce TrajectoryAtlas, a new data generation pipeline for large-scale synthetic paired video data and a video generator TrajectoryMover fine-tuned with this data. We show that this successfully enables generative movement of object trajectories. Project page: https://chhatrekiran.github.io/trajectorymover

AI.tldr: 提出TrajectoryAtlas数据生成流水线和TrajectoryMover视频生成器，用于在保持物体相对3D运动的同时移动其轨迹，解决了现有方法无法处理物体3D运动轨迹移动的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式视频编辑方法主要关注规定物体的3D或2D运动轨迹，或改变物体/场景外观，但缺乏在保持物体相对3D运动的同时移动其轨迹的方法。主要挑战在于难以获得这种场景的配对视频数据。
AI.method: 提出TrajectoryAtlas大规模合成配对视频数据生成流水线，并基于此数据微调视频生成器TrajectoryMover。通过合成数据解决配对数据获取难题，而非依赖现有视频的巧妙构造。
AI.result: TrajectoryAtlas成功实现了物体轨迹的生成式移动，能够保持物体的相对3D运动，解决了现有方法无法处理的物体3D运动轨迹移动问题。
AI.conclusion: 通过创新的数据生成流水线和相应的视频生成器，成功实现了在保持物体相对3D运动的同时移动其轨迹的生成式视频编辑能力，填补了现有方法的空白。

title: Route-Induced Density and Stability (RIDE): Controlled Intervention and Mechanism Analysis of Routing-Style Meta Prompts on LLM Internal States
summary: Routing is widely used to scale large language models, from Mixture-of-Experts gating to multi-model/tool selection. A common belief is that routing to a task ``expert'' activates sparser internal computation and thus yields more certain and stable outputs (the Sparsity--Certainty Hypothesis). We test this belief by injecting routing-style meta prompts as a textual proxy for routing signals in front of frozen instruction-tuned LLMs. We quantify (C1) internal density via activation sparsity, (C2) domain-keyword attention, and (C3) output stability via predictive entropy and semantic variation. On a RouterEval subset with three instruction-tuned models (Qwen3-8B, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2), meta prompts consistently densify early/middle-layer representations rather than increasing sparsity; natural-language expert instructions are often stronger than structured tags. Attention responses are heterogeneous: Qwen/Llama reduce keyword attention, while Mistral reinforces it. Finally, the densification--stability link is weak and appears only in Qwen, with near-zero correlations in Llama and Mistral. We present RIDE as a diagnostic probe for calibrating routing design and uncertainty estimation.

AI.tldr: 研究测试了路由机制中稀疏性与确定性假设，发现元提示反而使早期/中间层表示更密集而非稀疏，自然语言指令比结构化标签更有效，不同模型对关键词注意力的响应各异，密度与稳定性关联较弱。
AI.motivation: 检验路由机制中的"稀疏性-确定性假设"——即路由到任务"专家"会激活更稀疏的内部计算，从而产生更确定和稳定的输出。通过元提示作为路由信号的文本代理来验证这一假设。
AI.method: 在冻结的指令调优LLMs前注入路由风格的元提示作为文本代理。量化三个指标：(C1)通过激活稀疏性衡量内部密度，(C2)领域关键词注意力，(C3)通过预测熵和语义变化衡量输出稳定性。在RouterEval子集上测试三个指令调优模型。
AI.result: 元提示一致地使早期/中间层表示更密集而非增加稀疏性；自然语言专家指令通常比结构化标签更强。注意力响应存在异质性：Qwen/Llama减少关键词注意力，而Mistral增强它。密度-稳定性关联较弱，仅在Qwen中出现，Llama和Mistral中相关性接近零。
AI.conclusion: 提出了RIDE作为诊断探针，用于校准路由设计和不确定性估计。研究发现路由机制的实际效果与稀疏性-确定性假设不符，需要更细致的路由设计方法。

title: Open Machine Translation for Esperanto
summary: Esperanto is a widespread constructed language, known for its regular grammar and productive word formation. Besides having substantial resources available thanks to its online community, it remains relatively underexplored in the context of modern machine translation (MT) approaches. In this work, we present the first comprehensive evaluation of open-source MT systems for Esperanto, comparing rule-based systems, encoder-decoder models, and LLMs across model sizes. We evaluate translation quality across six language directions involving English, Spanish, Catalan, and Esperanto using multiple automatic metrics as well as human evaluation. Our results show that the NLLB family achieves the best performance in all language pairs, followed closely by our trained compact models and a fine-tuned general-purpose LLM. Human evaluation confirms this trend, with NLLB translations preferred in approximately half of the comparisons, although noticeable errors remain. In line with Esperanto's tradition of openness and international collaboration, we release our code and best-performing models publicly.

AI.tldr: 该研究首次对开源机器翻译系统在Esperanto语言上进行了全面评估，比较了规则系统、编码器-解码器模型和LLM，发现NLLB系列在所有语言对中表现最佳。
AI.motivation: Esperanto作为一种广泛使用的人工构造语言，虽然拥有丰富的在线社区资源，但在现代机器翻译方法中仍相对未被充分探索。研究者希望填补这一空白，评估不同MT系统在Esperanto翻译中的表现。
AI.method: 研究比较了规则系统、编码器-解码器模型和不同规模的LLM，评估了涉及英语、西班牙语、加泰罗尼亚语和Esperanto的六个语言方向的翻译质量，使用了多种自动评估指标和人工评估。
AI.result: NLLB系列在所有语言对中表现最佳，紧随其后的是研究者训练的紧凑模型和微调的通用LLM。人工评估证实了这一趋势，约一半的比较中NLLB翻译更受青睐，但仍存在明显错误。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为Esperanto机器翻译提供了首个全面评估，展示了现代MT系统在该语言上的潜力。遵循Esperanto的开放性和国际合作传统，研究者公开了代码和最佳性能模型。

title: L-ReLF: A Framework for Lexical Dataset Creation
comment: Accepted to the 2026 International Conference on Natural Language Processing (ICNLP). 6 pages, 1 figure
summary: This paper introduces the L-ReLF (Low-Resource Lexical Framework), a novel, reproducible methodology for creating high-quality, structured lexical datasets for underserved languages. The lack of standardized terminology, exemplified by Moroccan Darija, poses a critical barrier to knowledge equity in platforms like Wikipedia, often forcing editors to rely on inconsistent, ad-hoc methods to create new words in their language. Our research details the technical pipeline developed to overcome these challenges. We systematically address the difficulties of working with low-resource data, including source identification, utilizing Optical Character Recognition (OCR) despite its bias towards Modern Standard Arabic, and rigorous post-processing to correct errors and standardize the data model. The resulting structured dataset is fully compatible with Wikidata Lexemes, serving as a vital technical resource. The L-ReLF methodology is designed for generalizability, offering other language communities a clear path to build foundational lexical data for downstream NLP applications, such as Machine Translation and morphological analysis.

AI.tldr: L-ReLF是一种为资源匮乏语言创建高质量结构化词汇数据集的可重复方法，特别针对像摩洛哥达里贾语这样的语言，解决了维基百科等平台中术语标准化缺失的问题。
AI.motivation: 资源匮乏语言缺乏标准化术语（如摩洛哥达里贾语），这在维基百科等平台中构成了知识公平的关键障碍，编辑们通常只能依赖不一致的临时方法来创建新词汇。
AI.method: 开发了一个技术流程，包括源识别、使用光学字符识别（尽管偏向现代标准阿拉伯语）、严格的后期处理以纠正错误并标准化数据模型，最终生成与Wikidata Lexemes完全兼容的结构化数据集。
AI.result: 创建了高质量、结构化的词汇数据集，完全兼容Wikidata Lexemes，为下游NLP应用（如机器翻译和形态分析）提供了重要的技术资源。
AI.conclusion: L-ReLF方法具有普适性，为其他语言社区提供了清晰的路径来构建基础词汇数据，促进资源匮乏语言在NLP应用中的发展。

title: Dual-Imbalance Continual Learning for Real-World Food Recognition
comment: Accepted to 3rd MetaFood at CVPR 2026. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaoyanzhang1/DIME
summary: Visual food recognition in real-world dietary logging scenarios naturally exhibits severe data imbalance, where a small number of food categories appear frequently while many others occur rarely, resulting in long-tailed class distributions. In practice, food recognition systems often operate in a continual learning setting, where new categories are introduced sequentially over time. However, existing studies typically assume that each incremental step introduces a similar number of new food classes, which rarely happens in real world where the number of newly observed categories can vary significantly across steps, leading to highly uneven learning dynamics. As a result, continual food recognition exhibits a dual imbalance: imbalanced samples within each food class and imbalanced numbers of new food classes to learn at each incremental learning step. In this work, we introduce DIME, a Dual-Imbalance-aware Adapter Merging framework for continual food recognition. DIME learns lightweight adapters for each task using parameter-efficient fine-tuning and progressively integrates them through a class-count guided spectral merging strategy. A rank-wise threshold modulation mechanism further stabilizes the merging process by preserving dominant knowledge while allowing adaptive updates. The resulting model maintains a single merged adapter for inference, enabling efficient deployment without accumulating task-specific modules. Experiments on realistic long-tailed food benchmarks under our step-imbalanced setup show that the proposed method consistently improves by more than 3% over the strongest existing continual learning baselines. Code is available at https://github.com/xiaoyanzhang1/DIME.

AI.tldr: DIME提出了一种双不平衡感知的适配器融合框架，用于解决持续食物识别中的样本不平衡和步骤不平衡问题，通过参数高效微调和谱融合策略提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的食物识别存在严重的数据不平衡问题：少数食物类别频繁出现而多数类别罕见，形成长尾分布。同时，持续学习场景中新增类别数量在不同步骤间差异很大，导致学习动态高度不均衡。现有研究通常假设每个增量步骤引入相似数量的新类别，这与实际情况不符。
AI.method: DIME采用双不平衡感知的适配器融合框架：1）为每个任务学习轻量级适配器（参数高效微调）；2）通过类数量引导的谱融合策略逐步整合适配器；3）引入秩阈值调制机制，在保留主导知识的同时允许自适应更新；4）最终维护单个融合适配器进行推理，无需积累任务特定模块。
AI.result: 在现实长尾食物基准测试中，在步骤不平衡设置下，DIME相比现有最强的持续学习基线方法持续提升超过3%的性能。
AI.conclusion: DIME框架有效解决了持续食物识别中的双不平衡问题，通过适配器融合策略实现了高效部署和稳定性能提升，为现实世界的食物识别系统提供了实用解决方案。

title: Beyond pass@1: A Reliability Science Framework for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary:
Existing benchmarks measure capability -- whether a model succeeds on a single attempt -- but production deployments
  require reliability -- consistent success across repeated attempts on tasks of varying duration. We show these
  properties diverge systematically as task duration grows, and that pass@1 on short tasks is structurally blind to
  this divergence.
  We introduce a reliability science framework for long-horizon LLM agents with four metrics: Reliability Decay Curve
  (RDC), Variance Amplification Factor (VAF), Graceful Degradation Score (GDS), and Meltdown Onset Point (MOP). We
  evaluate 10 models across 23,392 episodes on a 396-task benchmark spanning four duration buckets and three domains.
  Key findings: (1) reliability decay is domain-stratified -- SE GDS drops from 0.90 to 0.44 while document processing
  is nearly flat (0.74 to 0.71); (2) VAF bifurcates by capability tier -- high VAF is a capability signature, not an
  instability signal; (3) capability and reliability rankings diverge substantially, with multi-rank inversions at long
  horizons; (4) frontier models have the highest meltdown rates (up to 19%) because they attempt ambitious multi-step
  strategies that sometimes spiral; and (5) memory scaffolds universally hurt long-horizon performance across all 10
  models. These results motivate reliability as a first-class evaluation dimension alongside capability.

AI.tldr: 现有基准主要衡量模型单次任务成功率（能力），但生产部署需要可靠性——在重复尝试和不同时长任务上的一致成功率。研究发现能力与可靠性随任务时长增长而系统性地分化，短任务pass@1指标无法捕捉这种差异。作者提出了可靠性科学框架和四个新指标，评估10个模型在23,392次任务上的表现，发现可靠性在不同领域分层、能力与可靠性排名显著分化等关键现象。
AI.motivation: 现有评估基准主要关注模型在单次尝试中的成功率（能力），但实际生产部署需要模型在重复尝试和不同时长任务上保持一致的可靠性。研究发现随着任务时长增长，能力与可靠性会系统性地分化，而传统的短任务pass@1指标无法检测这种差异，因此需要新的评估框架来专门衡量长期任务中的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出了一个用于长期LLM代理的可靠性科学框架，包含四个核心指标：可靠性衰减曲线(RDC)、方差放大因子(VAF)、优雅退化分数(GDS)和崩溃起始点(MOP)。在包含396个任务的基准上评估了10个模型，涵盖23,392个任务片段，任务按四个时长区间和三个领域进行划分。
AI.result: 主要发现：1）可靠性衰减具有领域分层性——软件工程GDS从0.90降至0.44，而文档处理几乎持平（0.74到0.71）；2）VAF按能力层级分叉——高VAF是能力特征而非不稳定信号；3）能力与可靠性排名显著分化，长期任务中出现多重排名反转；4）前沿模型崩溃率最高（达19%），因为它们尝试雄心勃勃的多步策略有时会失控；5）记忆支架在所有10个模型中普遍损害长期性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，可靠性应该与能力并列成为模型评估的一级维度。传统的短任务评估指标无法捕捉长期任务中的可靠性问题，需要专门的可靠性评估框架来确保模型在生产环境中的稳定表现。

title: Developing a Guideline for the Labovian-Structural Analysis of Oral Narratives in Japanese
comment: Accepted at The Fifteenth biennial Language Resources and Evaluation Conference (LREC) 2026
summary: Narrative analysis is a cornerstone of qualitative research. One leading approach is the Labovian model, but its application is labor-intensive, requiring a holistic, recursive interpretive process that moves back and forth between individual parts of the transcript and the transcript as a whole. Existing Labovian datasets are available only in English, which differs markedly from Japanese in terms of grammar and discourse conventions. To address this gap, we introduce the first systematic guidelines for Labovian narrative analysis of Japanese narrative data. Our guidelines retain all six Labovian categories and extend the framework by providing explicit rules for clause segmentation tailored to Japanese constructions. In addition, our guidelines cover a broader range of clause types and narrative types. Using these guidelines, annotators achieved high agreement in clause segmentation (Fleiss' kappa = 0.80) and moderate agreement in two structural classification tasks (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.41 and 0.45, respectively), one of which is slightly higher than that found in prior work despite the use of finer-grained distinctions. This paper describes the Labovian model, the proposed guidelines, the annotation process, and their utility. It concludes by discussing the challenges encountered during the annotation process and the prospects for developing a larger dataset for structural narrative analysis in Japanese qualitative research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了首个针对日语叙事数据的Labovian叙事分析系统指南，解决了日语与英语在语法和话语惯例上的差异问题，并在标注任务中获得了较高的标注者一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有Labovian叙事分析模型主要针对英语数据，而日语在语法和话语惯例上与英语存在显著差异。目前缺乏适用于日语叙事数据的系统分析指南，这限制了日语定性研究中叙事分析的发展。
AI.method: 提出了首个针对日语叙事数据的Labovian叙事分析系统指南，保留了所有六个Labovian类别，并扩展了框架，为日语结构提供了明确的从句分割规则。指南涵盖了更广泛的从句类型和叙事类型。
AI.result: 使用该指南，标注者在从句分割任务中获得了高度一致性（Fleiss' kappa = 0.80），在两个结构分类任务中获得了中等一致性（Krippendorff's alpha = 0.41和0.45）。其中一个任务的标注一致性略高于先前研究，尽管使用了更细粒度的区分。
AI.conclusion: 本文描述了Labovian模型、提出的指南、标注过程及其效用。最后讨论了标注过程中遇到的挑战，以及开发更大规模日语结构叙事分析数据集的前景，为日语定性研究中的叙事分析提供了重要工具。

title: SparseDriveV2: Scoring is All You Need for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end multi-modal planning has been widely adopted to model the uncertainty of driving behavior, typically by scoring candidate trajectories and selecting the optimal one. Existing approaches generally fall into two categories: scoring a large static trajectory vocabulary, or scoring a small set of dynamically generated proposals. While static vocabularies often suffer from coarse discretization of the action space, dynamic proposals provide finer-grained precision and have shown stronger empirical performance on existing benchmarks. However, it remains unclear whether dynamic generation is fundamentally necessary, or whether static vocabularies can already achieve comparable performance when they are sufficiently dense to cover the action space. In this work, we start with a systematic scaling study of Hydra-MDP, a representative scoring-based method, revealing that performance consistently improves as trajectory anchors become denser, without exhibiting saturation before computational constraints are reached. Motivated by this observation, we propose SparseDriveV2 to push the performance boundary of scoring-based planning through two complementary innovations: (1) a scalable vocabulary representation with a factorized structure that decomposes trajectories into geometric paths and velocity profiles, enabling combinatorial coverage of the action space, and (2) a scalable scoring strategy with coarse factorized scoring over paths and velocity profiles followed by fine-grained scoring on a small set of composed trajectories. By combining these two techniques, SparseDriveV2 achieves 92.0 PDMS and 90.1 EPDMS on NAVSIM, with 89.15 Driving Score and 70.00 Success Rate on Bench2Drive with a lightweight ResNet-34 as backbone. Code and model are released at https://github.com/swc-17/SparseDriveV2.

AI.tldr: SparseDriveV2通过可扩展的词汇表示和评分策略，在基于评分的规划方法中取得了最先进的性能，证明了静态词汇表在足够密集时可以达到与动态生成相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端多模态规划方法主要分为两类：评分大型静态轨迹词汇表或评分小型动态生成提案。静态词汇表通常存在动作空间离散化粗糙的问题，而动态提案提供更精细的精度并在现有基准测试中表现出更强的经验性能。然而，尚不清楚动态生成是否从根本上必要，或者当静态词汇表足够密集以覆盖动作空间时是否已经可以达到相当的性能。
AI.method: 提出了SparseDriveV2，包含两个互补的创新：(1) 可扩展的词汇表示，采用因子化结构将轨迹分解为几何路径和速度剖面，实现对动作空间的组合覆盖；(2) 可扩展的评分策略，首先对路径和速度剖面进行粗略的因子化评分，然后对少量组合轨迹进行细粒度评分。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM上达到92.0 PDMS和90.1 EPDMS，在Bench2Drive上以轻量级ResNet-34作为骨干网络达到89.15驾驶分数和70.00%成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性的缩放研究发现，随着轨迹锚点变得更密集，性能持续提升，在达到计算约束之前没有表现出饱和现象。SparseDriveV2通过可扩展的词汇表示和评分策略，在基于评分的规划方法中取得了最先进的性能，证明了静态词汇表在足够密集时可以达到与动态生成相当的性能。

title: Grokking From Abstraction to Intelligence
comment: 22page and 5 figures,In this paper, we analyze the grokking phenomenon from the perspective of Singular Learning Theory (SLT). This work is currently under review for ICML 2026
summary: Grokking in modular arithmetic has established itself as the quintessential fruit fly experiment, serving as a critical domain for investigating the mechanistic origins of model generalization. Despite its significance, existing research remains narrowly focused on specific local circuits or optimization tuning, largely overlooking the global structural evolution that fundamentally drives this phenomenon. We propose that grokking originates from a spontaneous simplification of internal model structures governed by the principle of parsimony. We integrate causal, spectral, and algorithmic complexity measures alongside Singular Learning Theory to reveal that the transition from memorization to generalization corresponds to the physical collapse of redundant manifolds and deep information compression, offering a novel perspective for understanding the mechanisms of model overfitting and generalization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出模块算术中的"顿悟"现象源于模型内部结构的自发简化，受简约性原则驱动，从记忆到泛化的转变对应冗余流形的物理坍缩和深度信息压缩。
AI.motivation: 模块算术中的"顿悟"现象已成为研究模型泛化机制的关键实验领域，但现有研究过于关注局部电路或优化调参，忽略了驱动这一现象的全局结构演化。
AI.method: 整合因果、谱和算法复杂性度量，结合奇异学习理论，分析模型内部结构演化，揭示从记忆到泛化的转变机制。
AI.result: 研究发现"顿悟"现象对应冗余流形的物理坍缩和深度信息压缩，为理解模型过拟合和泛化机制提供了新视角。
AI.conclusion: "顿悟"源于模型内部结构的自发简化，受简约性原则支配，这一发现为理解深度学习中的泛化机制提供了理论基础。

title: LatentPilot: Scene-Aware Vision-and-Language Navigation by Dreaming Ahead with Latent Visual Reasoning
summary: Existing vision-and-language navigation (VLN) models primarily reason over past and current visual observations, while largely ignoring the future visual dynamics induced by actions. As a result, they often lack an effective understanding of the causal relationship between actions and how the visual world changes, limiting robust decision-making. Humans, in contrast, can imagine the near future by leveraging action-dynamics causality, which improves both environmental understanding and navigation choices. Inspired by this capability, we propose LatentPilot, a new paradigm that exploits future observations during training as a valuable data source to learn action-conditioned visual dynamics, while requiring no access to future frames at inference. Concretely, we propose a flywheel-style training mechanism that iteratively collects on-policy trajectories and retrains the model to better match the agent's behavior distribution, with an expert takeover triggered when the agent deviates excessively. LatentPilot further learns visual latent tokens without explicit supervision; these latent tokens attend globally in a continuous latent space and are carried across steps, serving as both the current output and the next input, thereby enabling the agent to dream ahead and reason about how actions will affect subsequent observations. Experiments on R2R-CE, RxR-CE, and R2R-PE benchmarks achieve new SOTA results, and real-robot tests across diverse environments demonstrate LatentPilot's superior understanding of environment-action dynamics in scene. Project page:https://abdd.top/latentpilot/

AI.tldr: LatentPilot提出了一种新的视觉语言导航范式，通过利用训练时的未来观测来学习动作条件化的视觉动态，无需在推理时访问未来帧，实现了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN模型主要基于过去和当前的视觉观察进行推理，而忽略了动作引发的未来视觉动态。这导致它们缺乏对动作与视觉世界变化之间因果关系的有效理解，限制了鲁棒决策能力。人类能够利用动作动态因果关系想象近未来，从而改善环境理解和导航选择。
AI.method: 提出LatentPilot范式，采用飞轮式训练机制：迭代收集在线策略轨迹并重新训练模型以更好地匹配智能体行为分布，当智能体偏离过多时触发专家接管。学习无显式监督的视觉潜在标记，这些标记在连续潜在空间中全局关注并在步骤间传递，既作为当前输出又作为下一输入，使智能体能够"向前梦想"并推理动作如何影响后续观察。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE、RxR-CE和R2R-PE基准测试中取得了新的SOTA结果，跨多样化环境的真实机器人测试展示了LatentPilot在环境-动作动态理解方面的优越性。
AI.conclusion: LatentPilot通过利用训练时的未来观测学习动作条件化的视觉动态，无需推理时访问未来帧，显著提升了视觉语言导航模型的性能和对环境-动作动态的理解能力。

title: PSPA-Bench: A Personalized Benchmark for Smartphone GUI Agent
summary: Smartphone GUI agents execute tasks by operating directly on app interfaces, offering a path to broad capability without deep system integration. However, real-world smartphone use is highly personalized: users adopt diverse workflows and preferences, challenging agents to deliver customized assistance rather than generic solutions. Existing GUI agent benchmarks cannot adequately capture this personalization dimension due to sparse user-specific data and the lack of fine-grained evaluation metrics. To address this gap, we present PSPA-Bench, the benchmark dedicated to evaluating personalization in smartphone GUI agents. PSPA-Bench comprises over 12,855 personalized instructions aligned with real-world user behaviors across 10 representative daily-use scenarios and 22 mobile apps, and introduces a structure-aware process evaluation method that measures agents' personalized capabilities at a fine-grained level. Through PSPA-Bench, we benchmark 11 state-of-the-art GUI agents. Results reveal that current methods perform poorly under personalized settings, with even the strongest agent achieving limited success. Our analysis further highlights three directions for advancing personalized GUI agents: (1) reasoning-oriented models consistently outperform general LLMs, (2) perception remains a simple yet critical capability, and (3) reflection and long-term memory mechanisms are key to improving adaptation. Together, these findings establish PSPA-Bench as a foundation for systematic study and future progress in personalized GUI agents.

AI.tldr: PSPA-Bench是一个专门评估智能手机GUI代理个性化能力的基准测试，包含12,855个个性化指令，覆盖10个日常使用场景和22个移动应用，揭示了当前方法在个性化设置下表现不佳的问题。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的智能手机使用高度个性化，用户采用多样化的工作流程和偏好，这挑战了代理提供定制化协助而非通用解决方案的能力。现有的GUI代理基准测试由于用户特定数据稀疏和缺乏细粒度评估指标，无法充分捕捉个性化维度。
AI.method: 提出了PSPA-Bench基准测试，包含超过12,855个与真实用户行为对齐的个性化指令，覆盖10个代表性日常使用场景和22个移动应用。引入了结构感知的过程评估方法，在细粒度层面测量代理的个性化能力。
AI.result: 对11个最先进的GUI代理进行基准测试，结果显示当前方法在个性化设置下表现不佳，即使最强的代理也只取得有限的成功。分析发现：(1) 推理导向模型始终优于通用LLM；(2) 感知仍然是简单但关键的能力；(3) 反思和长期记忆机制是改进适应的关键。
AI.conclusion: PSPA-Bench为个性化GUI代理的系统性研究和未来进展奠定了基础，揭示了当前方法的局限性并指出了三个关键改进方向。

title: Is my model perplexed for the right reason? Contrasting LLMs' Benchmark Behavior with Token-Level Perplexity
summary: Standard evaluations of Large language models (LLMs) focus on task performance, offering limited insight into whether correct behavior reflects appropriate underlying mechanisms and risking confirmation bias. We introduce a simple, principled interpretability framework based on token-level perplexity to test whether models rely on linguistically relevant cues. By comparing perplexity distributions over minimal sentence pairs differing in one or a few `pivotal' tokens, our method enables precise, hypothesis-driven analysis without relying on unstable feature-attribution techniques. Experiments on controlled linguistic benchmarks with several open-weight LLMs show that, while linguistically important tokens influence model behavior, they never fully explain perplexity shifts, revealing that models rely on heuristics other than the expected linguistic ones.

AI.tldr: 提出基于词元级困惑度的可解释性框架，通过最小句子对比较测试大语言模型是否依赖语言相关线索，发现模型除预期语言线索外还依赖其他启发式方法
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型评估主要关注任务性能，无法判断正确行为是否反映适当的内在机制，存在确认偏误风险，需要更精确的可解释性方法
AI.method: 基于词元级困惑度的可解释性框架，通过比较仅差一个或几个"关键"词元的最小句子对的困惑度分布，进行精确的假设驱动分析
AI.result: 在多个开源大语言模型的受控语言基准测试中，虽然语言重要词元影响模型行为，但从未完全解释困惑度变化，表明模型依赖预期语言线索之外的其他启发式方法
AI.conclusion: 需要超越传统评估方法的可解释性框架来理解大语言模型的内在机制，模型行为由多种启发式方法共同决定，而不仅仅是预期的语言线索

title: CT-to-X-ray Distillation Under Tiny Paired Cohorts: An Evidence-Bounded Reproducible Pilot Study
summary: Chest X-ray and computed tomography (CT) provide complementary views of thoracic disease, yet most computer-aided diagnosis models are trained and deployed within a single imaging modality. The concrete question studied here is narrower and deployment-oriented: on a patient-level paired chest cohort, can CT act as training-only supervision for a binary disease versus non-disease X-ray classifier without requiring CT at inference time? We study this setting as a cross-modality teacher--student distillation problem and use JDCNet as an executable pilot scaffold rather than as a validated superior architecture. On the original patient-level paired split from a public paired chest imaging cohort, a stripped-down plain cross-modal logit-KD control attains the highest mean result on the four-image validation subset (0.875 accuracy and 0.714 macro-F1), whereas the full module-augmented JDCNet variant remains at 0.750 accuracy and 0.429 macro-F1. To test whether that ranking is a split artifact, we additionally run eight patient-level Monte Carlo resamples with same-case comparisons, stronger mechanism controls based on attention transfer and feature hints, and imbalance-sensitive analyses. Under this resampled protocol, late fusion attains the highest mean accuracy (0.885), same-modality distillation attains the highest mean macro-F1 (0.554) and balanced accuracy (0.660), the plain cross-modal control drops to 0.500 mean balanced accuracy, and neither attention transfer nor feature hints recover a robust cross-modality advantage. The contribution of this study is therefore not a validated CT-to-X-ray architecture, but a reproducible and evidence-bounded pilot protocol that makes the exact task definition, failure modes, ranking instability, and the minimum requirements for future credible CT-to-X-ray transfer claims explicit.

AI.tldr: 研究探索CT能否作为训练监督来提升X光疾病分类器性能，发现跨模态知识蒸馏效果不稳定，需谨慎评估
AI.motivation: 研究CT和X光在胸科疾病诊断中的互补性，探索CT仅作为训练监督（无需推理时使用）能否提升X光二分类器性能
AI.method: 采用跨模态师生知识蒸馏框架，使用JDCNet作为实验架构，进行患者级配对数据分割，比较不同蒸馏策略（logit-KD、注意力转移、特征提示等）
AI.result: 在原始分割中，简单跨模态logit-KD效果最佳（准确率0.875，macro-F1 0.714）；但在蒙特卡洛重采样后，跨模态优势消失，同模态蒸馏表现更好
AI.conclusion: 研究未验证出有效的CT到X光架构，但建立了可复现的评估协议，明确了任务定义、失败模式、排名不稳定性，为未来可信的跨模态转移研究设定了最低要求

title: Nomad: Autonomous Exploration and Discovery
summary:
We introduce Nomad, a system for autonomous data exploration and insight discovery. Given a corpus of documents, databases, or other data sources, users rarely know the full set of questions, hypotheses, or connections that could be explored. As a result, query-driven question answering and prompt-driven deep-research systems remain limited by human framing and often fail to cover the broader insight space.
  Nomad addresses this problem with an exploration-first architecture. It constructs an explicit Exploration Map over the domain and systematically traverses it to balance breadth and depth. It generates and selects hypotheses and investigates them with an explorer agent that can use document search, web search, and database tools. Candidate insights are then checked by an independent verifier before entering a reporting pipeline that produces cited reports and higher-level meta-reports.
  We also present a comprehensive evaluation framework for autonomous discovery systems that measures trustworthiness, report quality, and diversity. Using a corpus of selected UN and WHO reports, we show that \nomad{} produces more trustworthy and higher-quality reports than baselines, while also producing more diverse insights over several runs.
  Nomad is a step toward autonomous systems that not only answer user questions or conduct directed research, but also discover which questions, research directions, and insights are worth surfacing in the first place.

AI.tldr: Nomad是一个自主数据探索和洞察发现系统，通过构建探索地图并系统遍历来发现数据中的问题和连接，超越传统查询驱动系统的限制。
AI.motivation: 传统查询驱动问答和提示驱动研究系统受限于人类框架，无法覆盖更广泛的洞察空间。用户通常不知道数据中所有可能的问题、假设或连接，需要系统能够自主探索和发现。
AI.method: 采用探索优先架构，构建明确的探索地图并系统遍历以平衡广度和深度。使用探索代理生成和选择假设，通过文档搜索、网络搜索和数据库工具进行调查。候选洞察由独立验证器检查，然后进入报告管道生成引用报告和高级元报告。
AI.result: 在选定的联合国和世界卫生组织报告语料库上，Nomad比基线方法产生更可信、更高质量的报告，同时在多次运行中产生更多样化的洞察。
AI.conclusion: Nomad是迈向自主系统的一步，不仅能够回答用户问题或进行定向研究，还能首先发现哪些问题、研究方向和洞察值得呈现。

title: CounselReflect: A Toolkit for Auditing Mental-Health Dialogues
summary: Mental-health support is increasingly mediated by conversational systems (e.g., LLM-based tools), but users often lack structured ways to audit the quality and potential risks of the support they receive. We introduce CounselReflect, an end-to-end toolkit for auditing mental-health support dialogues. Rather than producing a single opaque quality score, CounselReflect provides structured, multi-dimensional reports with session-level summaries, turn-level scores, and evidence-linked excerpts to support transparent inspection. The system integrates two families of evaluation signals: (i) 12 model-based metrics produced by task-specific predictors, and (ii) rubric-based metrics that extend coverage via a literature-derived library (69 metrics) and user-defined custom metrics, operationalized with configurable LLM judges. CounselReflect is available as a web application, browser extension, and command-line interface (CLI), enabling use in real-time settings as well as at scale. Human evaluation includes a user study with 20 participants and an expert review with 6 mental-health professionals, suggesting that CounselReflect supports understandable, usable, and trustworthy auditing. A demo video and full source code are also provided.

AI.tldr: CounselReflect是一个端到端的工具包，用于审计心理健康支持对话，提供结构化多维报告而非单一质量分数，支持实时和大规模使用。
AI.motivation: 心理健康支持越来越多地由对话系统（如基于LLM的工具）提供，但用户缺乏结构化方法来审计所获得支持的质量和潜在风险。
AI.method: 整合两种评估信号：1) 12个由任务特定预测器生成的模型指标；2) 基于文献库（69个指标）和用户自定义指标的量规指标，通过可配置的LLM评估器操作化。提供Web应用、浏览器扩展和CLI三种形式。
AI.result: 包含20名参与者的用户研究和6名心理健康专家的专家评审表明，CounselReflect支持可理解、可用且可信赖的审计。提供了演示视频和完整源代码。
AI.conclusion: CounselReflect为心理健康支持对话提供了透明、结构化的审计工具，通过多维报告支持用户评估对话质量，填补了当前缺乏系统化评估方法的空白。

title: BenchScope: How Many Independent Signals Does Your Benchmark Provide?
summary: AI evaluation suites often report many scores without checking whether those scores carry independent information. We introduce Effective Dimensionality (ED), the participation ratio of a centered benchmark-score spectrum, as a fast, population-conditional upper-bound diagnostic of measurement breadth. Applied at per-instance granularity to 22 benchmarks across 8 domains and more than 8,400 model evaluations, ED reveals substantial redundancy: the six-score Open LLM Leaderboard behaves like roughly two effective measurement axes (ED = 1.7), BBH and MMLU-Pro are near-interchangeable (rho = 0.96, stable across seven subpopulations), and measurement breadth varies more than 20x across current benchmarks. We show that relative ED rankings are stable under matched-dimension controls and that ED can flag redundant suite components, monitor performance-conditional compression, and guide benchmark maintenance. Because binary spectra overestimate absolute latent dimensionality, we interpret ED as a screening statistic rather than a literal factor count and complement it with null, reliability, and saturation analyses. We provide a 22-benchmark reference atlas and a four-step diagnostic workflow that benchmark maintainers can run with a score matrix and a few lines of code.

AI.tldr: 提出"有效维度"(ED)作为评估套件冗余度的诊断指标，发现当前AI基准测试存在大量冗余，如Open LLM Leaderboard的6个分数实际上只有约1.7个有效测量轴。
AI.motivation: 当前AI评估套件通常报告大量分数，但未检查这些分数是否携带独立信息，存在测量冗余问题，需要一种快速诊断方法来评估测量广度。
AI.method: 引入有效维度(ED)——中心化基准分数谱的参与比，作为测量广度的快速、种群条件上界诊断。应用于22个基准测试、8个领域、超过8400个模型评估，进行冗余分析。
AI.result: 发现显著冗余：Open LLM Leaderboard的6个分数行为类似约2个有效测量轴(ED=1.7)；BBH和MMLU-Pro近乎可互换(相关系数ρ=0.96)；不同基准测试的测量广度差异超过20倍。
AI.conclusion: ED可作为筛选统计量而非字面因子计数，用于标记冗余套件组件、监控性能条件压缩、指导基准维护。提供22基准参考图谱和四步诊断工作流程。

title: Authorship Impersonation via LLM Prompting does not Evade Authorship Verification Methods
summary: Authorship verification (AV), the task of determining whether a questioned text was written by a specific individual, is a critical part of forensic linguistics. While manual authorial impersonation by perpetrators has long been a recognized threat in historical forensic cases, recent advances in large language models (LLMs) raise new challenges, as adversaries may exploit these tools to impersonate another's writing. This study investigates whether prompted LLMs can generate convincing authorial impersonations and whether such outputs can evade existing forensic AV systems. Using GPT-4o as the adversary model, we generated impersonation texts under four prompting conditions across three genres: emails, text messages, and social media posts. We then evaluated these outputs against both non-neural AV methods (n-gram tracing, Ranking-Based Impostors Method, LambdaG) and neural approaches (AdHominem, LUAR, STAR) within a likelihood-ratio framework. Results show that LLM-generated texts failed to sufficiently replicate authorial individuality to bypass established AV systems. We also observed that some methods achieved even higher accuracy when rejecting impersonation texts compared to genuine negative samples. Overall, these findings indicate that, despite the accessibility of LLMs, current AV systems remain robust against entry-level impersonation attempts across multiple genres. Furthermore, we demonstrate that this counter-intuitive resilience stems, at least in part, from the higher lexical diversity and entropy inherent in LLM-generated texts.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了GPT-4o生成的文本能否冒充特定作者的写作风格并逃过现有作者验证系统的检测，结果显示当前AV系统对初级LLM模仿攻击具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型的快速发展，攻击者可能利用这些工具进行作者身份冒充，这对法证语言学中的作者验证系统构成了新的安全挑战。研究旨在评估LLM生成的模仿文本能否成功欺骗现有的作者验证方法。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4o作为攻击模型，在四种提示条件下生成三种体裁（电子邮件、短信、社交媒体帖子）的模仿文本。然后使用非神经方法（n-gram追踪、基于排名的冒名顶替方法、LambdaG）和神经方法（AdHominem、LUAR、STAR）在似然比框架下评估这些输出。
AI.result: LLM生成的文本未能充分复制作者个体特征以绕过成熟的AV系统。某些方法在拒绝模仿文本时甚至比对真实负样本获得了更高的准确率。AV系统对跨多个体裁的初级模仿尝试保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 尽管LLM易于获取，但当前作者验证系统对初级模仿攻击具有鲁棒性。这种反直觉的韧性部分源于LLM生成文本固有的更高词汇多样性和熵。

title: Hierarchical Visual Relocalization with Nearest View Synthesis from Feature Gaussian Splatting
summary: Visual relocalization is a fundamental task in the field of 3D computer vision, estimating a camera's pose when it revisits a previously known scene. While point-based hierarchical relocalization methods have shown strong scalability and efficiency, they are often limited by sparse image observations and weak feature matching. In this work, we propose SplatHLoc, a novel hierarchical visual relocalization framework that uses Feature Gaussian Splatting as the scene representation. To address the sparsity of database images, we propose an adaptive viewpoint retrieval method that synthesizes virtual candidates with viewpoints more closely aligned with the query, thereby improving the accuracy of initial pose estimation. For feature matching, we observe that Gaussian-rendered features and those extracted directly from images exhibit different strengths across the two-stage matching process: the former performs better in the coarse stage, while the latter proves more effective in the fine stage. Therefore, we introduce a hybrid feature matching strategy, enabling more accurate and efficient pose estimation. Extensive experiments on both indoor and outdoor datasets show that SplatHLoc enhances the robustness of visual relocalization, setting a new state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: SplatHLoc：基于特征高斯泼溅的新型分层视觉重定位框架，通过自适应视角检索和混合特征匹配策略提升重定位鲁棒性
AI.motivation: 传统基于点的分层重定位方法受限于稀疏图像观测和弱特征匹配，需要更鲁棒的场景表示和匹配策略来提升视觉重定位性能
AI.method: 1) 使用特征高斯泼溅作为场景表示；2) 提出自适应视角检索方法，合成与查询更对齐的虚拟候选视角；3) 引入混合特征匹配策略，在粗匹配阶段使用高斯渲染特征，在精细匹配阶段使用图像直接提取特征
AI.result: 在室内外数据集上的大量实验表明，SplatHLoc提升了视觉重定位的鲁棒性，达到了新的最先进水平
AI.conclusion: SplatHLoc通过特征高斯泼溅表示、自适应视角检索和混合特征匹配策略，有效解决了传统方法在稀疏观测和特征匹配方面的限制，为视觉重定位提供了更鲁棒的解决方案

title: Rigorous Explanations for Tree Ensembles
summary: Tree ensembles (TEs) find a multitude of practical applications. They represent one of the most general and accurate classes of machine learning methods. While they are typically quite concise in representation, their operation remains inscrutable to human decision makers. One solution to build trust in the operation of TEs is to automatically identify explanations for the predictions made. Evidently, we can only achieve trust using explanations, if those explanations are rigorous, that is truly reflect properties of the underlying predictor they explain This paper investigates the computation of rigorously-defined, logically-sound explanations for the concrete case of two well-known examples of tree ensembles, namely random forests and boosted trees.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何为树集成模型（随机森林和提升树）计算严格定义、逻辑上合理的解释，以建立对这些模型预测的信任。
AI.motivation: 树集成模型虽然准确且应用广泛，但其决策过程对人类决策者来说是不透明的。为了建立对这些模型预测的信任，需要能够自动识别解释。但只有当这些解释是严格的、真正反映底层预测器属性时，才能实现这种信任。
AI.method: 该论文研究为两种著名的树集成模型（随机森林和提升树）计算严格定义、逻辑上合理的解释的方法。虽然摘要中没有详细说明具体方法，但强调了"严格定义"和"逻辑上合理"这两个核心要求。
AI.result: 摘要中没有提供具体的研究结果，但提出了一个研究框架：为树集成模型开发能够真正反映模型属性的严格解释方法。
AI.conclusion: 需要为树集成模型开发严格定义、逻辑上合理的解释方法，这样才能建立对这些模型预测的信任，因为只有真正反映模型属性的解释才能实现可信度。

title: M-MiniGPT4: Multilingual VLLM Alignment via Translated Data
comment: 6 pages, ACL 2026, Proceedings of the 7th Workshop on African Natural Language Processing (AfricaNLP 2026)
summary: This paper presents a Multilingual Vision Large Language Model, named M-MiniGPT4. Our model exhibits strong vision-language understanding (VLU) capabilities across 11 languages. We utilize a mixture of native multilingual and translated data to push the multilingual VLU performance of the MiniGPT4 architecture. In addition, we propose a multilingual alignment training stage that uses parallel text corpora to further enhance the multilingual capabilities of our model. M-MiniGPT4 achieves 36% accuracy on the multilingual MMMU benchmark, outperforming state-of-the-art models in the same weight class, including foundation models released after the majority of this work was completed. We open-source our models, code, and translated datasets to facilitate future research in low-resource and multilingual settings.

AI.tldr: M-MiniGPT4是一个多语言视觉大语言模型，在11种语言上展现出强大的视觉语言理解能力，通过混合原生多语言和翻译数据提升性能，并在MMMU基准测试中取得36%准确率，优于同类模型。
AI.motivation: 开发一个能够在多种语言上理解视觉内容的大语言模型，解决多语言视觉语言理解（VLU）的挑战，特别是在低资源语言环境下。
AI.method: 1. 基于MiniGPT4架构构建多语言模型；2. 使用混合原生多语言数据和翻译数据训练；3. 提出多语言对齐训练阶段，利用平行文本语料库增强多语言能力。
AI.result: 在11种语言上展现出强大的视觉语言理解能力，在多语言MMMU基准测试中达到36%准确率，优于同类最先进模型，包括在大部分工作完成后发布的基础模型。
AI.conclusion: M-MiniGPT4是一个有效的多语言视觉大语言模型，通过创新的数据混合和多语言对齐训练方法，在多语言视觉语言理解任务上表现出色，为低资源和多语言环境的研究提供了有价值的开源资源。

title: SLVMEval: Synthetic Meta Evaluation Benchmark for Text-to-Long Video Generation
summary: This paper proposes the synthetic long-video meta-evaluation (SLVMEval), a benchmark for meta-evaluating text-to-video (T2V) evaluation systems. The proposed SLVMEval benchmark focuses on assessing these systems on videos of up to 10,486 s (approximately 3 h). The benchmark targets a fundamental requirement, namely, whether the systems can accurately assess video quality in settings that are easy for humans to assess. We adopt a pairwise comparison-based meta-evaluation framework. Building on dense video-captioning datasets, we synthetically degrade source videos to create controlled "high-quality versus low-quality" pairs across 10 distinct aspects. Then, we employ crowdsourcing to filter and retain only those pairs in which the degradation is clearly perceptible, thereby establishing an effective final testbed. Using this testbed, we assess the reliability of existing evaluation systems in ranking these pairs. Experimental results demonstrate that human evaluators can identify the better long video with 84.7%-96.8% accuracy, and in nine of the 10 aspects, the accuracy of these systems falls short of human assessment, revealing weaknesses in text-to-long-video evaluation.

AI.tldr: SLVMEval是一个用于元评估文本到视频评估系统的基准测试，专注于评估长达3小时的长视频质量评估能力，通过合成退化视频对和众包筛选构建测试集。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到视频评估系统在长视频质量评估方面存在不足，需要建立一个专门的基准来测试这些系统在人类容易判断的场景下的准确性。
AI.method: 基于密集视频描述数据集，合成退化源视频创建10个不同方面的"高质量vs低质量"视频对，通过众包筛选保留明显可感知的退化对，采用成对比较的元评估框架。
AI.result: 人类评估者识别更好长视频的准确率为84.7%-96.8%，在10个方面中有9个方面，现有评估系统的准确性低于人类评估，揭示了文本到长视频评估的弱点。
AI.conclusion: SLVMEval基准揭示了现有文本到视频评估系统在长视频质量评估方面的局限性，为改进评估系统提供了重要参考。

title: 3D Architect: An Automated Approach to Three-Dimensional Modeling
summary: The aim of our paper is to render an object in 3-dimension using a set of its orthographic views. Corner detector (Harris Detector) is applied on the input views to obtain control points. These control points are projected perpendicular to respective views, in order to construct an envelope. A set of points describing the object in 3-dimension, are obtained from the intersection of these mutually perpendicular envelopes. These set of points are used to regenerate the surfaces of the object using computational geometry. At the end, the object in 3-dimension is rendered using OpenGL

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于正交视图的3D物体重建方法，通过Harris角点检测器获取控制点，构建垂直投影包络，通过包络相交得到3D点集，最后使用计算几何和OpenGL进行表面重建和渲染。
AI.motivation: 从物体的正交视图（如前视图、侧视图、俯视图）重建其3D模型，这是计算机图形学和计算机视觉中的一个重要问题。传统方法可能复杂或精度不足，需要一种更直接有效的从2D正交视图生成3D模型的方法。
AI.method: 1. 使用Harris角点检测器在输入的正交视图上提取控制点；2. 将这些控制点垂直投影到各自视图方向，构建3D包络；3. 通过相互垂直的包络相交得到描述物体的3D点集；4. 使用计算几何方法从点集重建物体表面；5. 最后用OpenGL进行3D渲染。
AI.result: 该方法能够从一组正交视图成功重建出物体的3D模型。通过角点检测和包络相交技术，可以有效地从2D视图生成3D点云，进而重建出完整的3D表面模型。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种有效的基于正交视图的3D重建方法，结合了计算机视觉（角点检测）和计算几何技术，能够从简单的2D正交视图生成完整的3D模型，为3D建模提供了一种实用的解决方案。

title: ELT-Bench-Verified: Benchmark Quality Issues Underestimate AI Agent Capabilities
summary:
Constructing Extract-Load-Transform (ELT) pipelines is a labor-intensive data engineering task and a high-impact target for AI automation. On ELT-Bench, the first benchmark for end-to-end ELT pipeline construction, AI agents initially showed low success rates, suggesting they lacked practical utility.
  We revisit these results and identify two factors causing a substantial underestimation of agent capabilities. First, re-evaluating ELT-Bench with upgraded large language models reveals that the extraction and loading stage is largely solved, while transformation performance improves significantly. Second, we develop an Auditor-Corrector methodology that combines scalable LLM-driven root-cause analysis with rigorous human validation (inter-annotator agreement Fleiss' kappa = 0.85) to audit benchmark quality. Applying this to ELT-Bench uncovers that most failed transformation tasks contain benchmark-attributable errors -- including rigid evaluation scripts, ambiguous specifications, and incorrect ground truth -- that penalize correct agent outputs.
  Based on these findings, we construct ELT-Bench-Verified, a revised benchmark with refined evaluation logic and corrected ground truth. Re-evaluating on this version yields significant improvement attributable entirely to benchmark correction. Our results show that both rapid model improvement and benchmark quality issues contributed to underestimating agent capabilities. More broadly, our findings echo observations of pervasive annotation errors in text-to-SQL benchmarks, suggesting quality issues are systemic in data engineering evaluation. Systematic quality auditing should be standard practice for complex agentic tasks. We release ELT-Bench-Verified to provide a more reliable foundation for progress in AI-driven data engineering automation.

AI.tldr: 研究发现ELT-Bench基准测试严重低估了AI代理能力，主要原因是模型快速进步和基准测试质量问题。通过审计发现多数失败任务包含基准测试错误，修正后性能显著提升。
AI.motivation: ELT管道构建是劳动密集型的数据工程任务，是AI自动化的重要目标。但现有基准测试ELT-Bench显示AI代理成功率低，作者怀疑这可能低估了实际能力。
AI.method: 1. 使用升级后的大型语言模型重新评估ELT-Bench；2. 开发Auditor-Corrector方法，结合可扩展的LLM驱动根因分析和严格人工验证（Fleiss' kappa = 0.85）来审计基准质量；3. 构建修正后的ELT-Bench-Verified基准。
AI.result: 重新评估发现提取和加载阶段基本解决，转换性能显著提升。审计发现大多数失败的转换任务包含基准测试可归因的错误（包括僵化的评估脚本、模糊的规范和错误的基准真值）。在修正后的ELT-Bench-Verified上重新评估，性能显著提升完全归因于基准修正。
AI.conclusion: 模型快速进步和基准测试质量问题共同导致了对AI代理能力的低估。数据工程评估中存在系统性的质量问题，与文本到SQL基准测试中的普遍标注错误现象相似。系统性的质量审计应成为复杂代理任务的标准实践。

title: MemFactory: Unified Inference & Training Framework for Agent Memory
summary: Memory-augmented Large Language Models (LLMs) are essential for developing capable, long-term AI agents. Recently, applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to optimize memory operations, such as extraction, updating, and retrieval, has emerged as a highly promising research direction. However, existing implementations remain highly fragmented and task-specific, lacking a unified infrastructure to streamline the integration, training, and evaluation of these complex pipelines. To address this gap, we present MemFactory, the first unified, highly modular training and inference framework specifically designed for memory-augmented agents. Inspired by the success of unified fine-tuning frameworks like LLaMA-Factory, MemFactory abstracts the memory lifecycle into atomic, plug-and-play components, enabling researchers to seamlessly construct custom memory agents via a "Lego-like" architecture. Furthermore, the framework natively integrates Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to fine-tune internal memory management policies driven by multi-dimensional environmental rewards. MemFactory provides out-of-the-box support for recent cutting-edge paradigms, including Memory-R1, RMM, and MemAgent. We empirically validate MemFactory on the open-source MemAgent architecture using its publicly available training and evaluation data. Across both in-domain and out-of-distribution evaluation sets, MemFactory consistently improves performance over the corresponding base models, with relative gains of up to 14.8%. By providing a standardized, extensible, and easy-to-use infrastructure, MemFactory significantly lowers the barrier to entry, paving the way for future innovations in memory-driven AI agents.

AI.tldr: MemFactory是一个专门为记忆增强智能体设计的统一、模块化训练和推理框架，通过抽象记忆生命周期为可插拔组件，简化了记忆操作优化流程。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习优化记忆操作（提取、更新、检索）的方法高度碎片化和任务特定化，缺乏统一的基础设施来简化这些复杂流程的集成、训练和评估。
AI.method: MemFactory将记忆生命周期抽象为原子化的即插即用组件，采用"乐高式"架构让研究者构建自定义记忆智能体，并原生集成Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）来微调由多维环境奖励驱动的内部记忆管理策略。
AI.result: 在开源MemAgent架构上使用公开训练和评估数据进行验证，在领域内和分布外评估集上，MemFactory始终优于相应基础模型，相对增益高达14.8%。
AI.conclusion: MemFactory通过提供标准化、可扩展且易用的基础设施，显著降低了记忆驱动AI智能体的入门门槛，为未来创新铺平了道路。

title: Developing Adaptive Context Compression Techniques for Large Language Models (LLMs) in Long-Running Interactions
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often experience performance degradation during long-running interactions due to increasing context length, memory saturation, and computational overhead. This paper presents an adaptive context compression framework that integrates importance-aware memory selection, coherence-sensitive filtering, and dynamic budget allocation to retain essential conversational information while controlling context growth. The approach is evaluated on LOCOMO, LOCCO, and LongBench benchmarks to assess answer quality, retrieval accuracy, coherence preservation, and efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves consistent improvements in conversational stability and retrieval performance while reducing token usage and inference latency compared with existing memory and compression-based approaches. These findings indicate that adaptive context compression provides an effective balance between long-term memory preservation and computational efficiency in persistent LLM interactions

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应上下文压缩框架，通过重要性感知内存选择、连贯性敏感过滤和动态预算分配，在控制上下文增长的同时保留关键对话信息，从而解决LLM在长对话中因上下文长度增加导致的性能下降问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在长时间交互中经常因上下文长度增加、内存饱和和计算开销而导致性能下降。现有方法难以在长期记忆保留和计算效率之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 提出自适应上下文压缩框架，包含三个核心组件：重要性感知内存选择（识别关键对话信息）、连贯性敏感过滤（确保上下文连贯性）、动态预算分配（根据需求调整压缩程度）。
AI.result: 在LOCOMO、LOCCO和LongBench基准测试中，该方法在答案质量、检索准确性、连贯性保持和效率方面表现优异，相比现有内存和压缩方法，减少了token使用和推理延迟，提升了对话稳定性和检索性能。
AI.conclusion: 自适应上下文压缩为持久性LLM交互提供了长期记忆保留与计算效率之间的有效平衡，能够显著改善长对话中的模型性能。

title: Structural Compactness as a Complementary Criterion for Explanation Quality
summary: In the evaluation of attribution quality, the quantitative assessment of explanation legibility is particularly difficult, as it is influenced by varying shapes and internal organization of attributions not captured by simple statistics. To address this issue, we introduce Minimum Spanning Tree Compactness (MST-C), a graph-based structural metric that captures higher-order geometric properties of attributions, such as spread and cohesion. These components are combined into a single score that evaluates compactness, favoring attributions with salient points spread across a small area and spatially organized into few but cohesive clusters. We show that MST-C reliably distinguishes between explanation methods, exposes fundamental structural differences between models, and provides a robust, self-contained diagnostic for explanation compactness that complements existing notions of attribution complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出MST-C指标，基于最小生成树评估归因解释的可读性，衡量归因点的紧凑性和空间组织性
AI.motivation: 当前归因解释质量评估中，解释可读性的量化评估特别困难，因为归因的形状和内部组织变化多样，简单的统计方法无法捕捉这些特征
AI.method: 引入最小生成树紧凑度（MST-C），这是一种基于图的结构化指标，能够捕捉归因的高阶几何特性，如分布范围和内聚性。将这两个组成部分结合成一个单一分数，评估归因的紧凑性
AI.result: MST-C能够可靠地区分不同的解释方法，揭示模型之间的基本结构差异，并为解释紧凑性提供鲁棒、自包含的诊断工具
AI.conclusion: MST-C作为补充现有归因复杂性概念的指标，能够有效评估归因解释的紧凑性，为解释质量评估提供了新的结构化度量方法

title: Distilling Human-Aligned Privacy Sensitivity Assessment from Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to the LREC CALD-pseudo 2026 Workshop
summary: Accurate privacy evaluation of textual data remains a critical challenge in privacy-preserving natural language processing. Recent work has shown that large language models (LLMs) can serve as reliable privacy evaluators, achieving strong agreement with human judgments; however, their computational cost and impracticality for processing sensitive data at scale limit real-world deployment. We address this gap by distilling the privacy assessment capabilities of Mistral Large 3 (675B) into lightweight encoder models with as few as 150M parameters. Leveraging a large-scale dataset of privacy-annotated texts spanning 10 diverse domains, we train efficient classifiers that preserve strong agreement with human annotations while dramatically reducing computational requirements. We validate our approach on human-annotated test data and demonstrate its practical utility as an evaluation metric for de-identification systems.

AI.tldr: 将大型语言模型的隐私评估能力蒸馏到轻量级编码器模型中，实现高效文本隐私评估
AI.motivation: 当前文本隐私评估面临两大挑战：1）人工评估成本高且难以规模化；2）大型语言模型虽然评估准确但计算成本高昂，且处理敏感数据存在实际部署限制
AI.method: 通过知识蒸馏方法，将Mistral Large 3（675B参数）的隐私评估能力转移到轻量级编码器模型（仅150M参数）。使用包含10个不同领域的大规模隐私标注文本数据集进行训练
AI.result: 训练出的高效分类器在保持与人工标注高度一致性的同时，显著降低了计算需求。在人工标注的测试数据上验证了方法的有效性，并展示了其作为去标识化系统评估指标的实用价值
AI.conclusion: 通过知识蒸馏技术，成功实现了高效、准确的文本隐私评估，解决了大型语言模型在实际部署中的计算成本和隐私保护限制问题，为隐私保护自然语言处理提供了实用的评估工具

title: Multi-Layered Memory Architectures for LLM Agents: An Experimental Evaluation of Long-Term Context Retention
summary: Long-horizon dialogue systems suffer from semanticdrift and unstable memory retention across extended sessions. This paper presents a Multi-Layer Memory Framework that decomposes dialogue history into working, episodic, and semantic layers with adaptive retrieval gating and retention regularization. The architecture controls cross-session drift while maintaining bounded context growth and computational efficiency. Experiments on LOCOMO, LOCCO, and LoCoMo show improved performance, achieving 46.85 Success Rate, 0.618 overall F1 with 0.594 multi-hop F1, and 56.90% six-period retention while reducing false memory rate to 5.1% and context usage to 58.40%. Results confirm enhanced long-term retention and reasoning stability under constrained context budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种多层记忆框架来解决长对话系统中的语义漂移和记忆保持问题，通过工作记忆、情景记忆和语义记忆三层分解，结合自适应检索门控和保持正则化，在有限上下文预算下提升长期记忆保持和推理稳定性。
AI.motivation: 长对话系统面临语义漂移和跨会话记忆保持不稳定的问题，需要一种能够控制语义漂移、保持有限上下文增长并维持计算效率的架构。
AI.method: 提出多层记忆框架，将对话历史分解为工作记忆、情景记忆和语义记忆三层，采用自适应检索门控机制和保持正则化技术来控制跨会话漂移。
AI.result: 在LOCOMO、LOCCO和LoCoMo数据集上实验，达到46.85%成功率、0.618总体F1（0.594多跳F1）、56.90%六周期保持率，同时将错误记忆率降至5.1%，上下文使用率降至58.40%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在有限上下文预算下显著增强了长期记忆保持和推理稳定性，有效解决了长对话系统中的语义漂移问题。

title: Metriplector: From Field Theory to Neural Architecture
summary: We present Metriplector, a neural architecture primitive in which the input configures an abstract physical system--fields, sources, and operators--and the dynamics of that system is the computation. Multiple fields evolve via coupled metriplectic dynamics, and the stress-energy tensor T^{μν}, derived from Noether's theorem, provides the readout. The metriplectic formulation admits a natural spectrum of instantiations: the dissipative branch alone yields a screened Poisson equation solved exactly via conjugate gradient; activating the full structure--including the antisymmetric Poisson bracket--gives field dynamics for image recognition and language modeling. We evaluate Metriplector across four domains, each using a task-specific architecture built from this shared primitive with progressively richer physics: F1=1.0 on maze pathfinding, generalizing from 15x15 training grids to unseen 39x39 grids; 97.2% exact Sudoku solve rate with zero structural injection; 81.03% on CIFAR-100 with 2.26M parameters; and 1.182 bits/byte on language modeling with 3.6x fewer training tokens than a GPT baseline.

AI.tldr: Metriplector是一种基于物理系统的神经架构原语，通过配置抽象物理系统（场、源、算子）进行计算，利用耦合的度量-普莱克蒂克动力学演化多个场，并通过诺特定理导出的应力-能量张量进行输出。
AI.motivation: 提出一种受物理启发的计算框架，将神经网络计算建模为物理系统的动力学演化，通过统一的物理原语支持多种任务，实现更好的泛化能力和计算效率。
AI.method: 使用度量-普莱克蒂克动力学框架，配置抽象物理系统（场、源、算子），通过耦合的场演化进行计算。该框架支持从纯耗散分支（求解屏蔽泊松方程）到完整结构（包括反对称泊松括号）的不同实例化。
AI.result: 在四个领域评估：1）迷宫路径规划：F1=1.0，从15×15训练网格泛化到未见过的39×39网格；2）数独求解：97.2%的精确求解率，无需结构注入；3）CIFAR-100：81.03%准确率，226万参数；4）语言建模：1.182比特/字节，比GPT基线少用3.6倍训练标记。
AI.conclusion: Metriplector作为一种统一的物理启发的神经架构原语，在多个领域表现出色，展示了基于物理系统动力学的计算框架在泛化能力、参数效率和训练效率方面的优势。

title: LightHarmony3D: Harmonizing Illumination and Shadows for Object Insertion in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity reconstruction of scene geometry and appearance. Building on this capability, inserting external mesh objects into reconstructed 3DGS scenes enables interactive editing and content augmentation for immersive applications such as AR/VR, virtual staging, and digital content creation. However, achieving physically consistent lighting and shadows for mesh insertion remains challenging, as it requires accurate scene illumination estimation and multi-view consistent rendering. To address this challenge, we present LightHarmony3D, a novel framework for illumination-consistent mesh insertion in 3DGS scenes. Central to our approach is our proposed generative module that predicts a full 360° HDR environment map at the insertion location via a single forward pass. By leveraging generative priors instead of iterative optimization, our method efficiently captures dominant scene illumination and enables physically grounded shading and shadows for inserted meshes while maintaining multi-view coherence. Furthermore, we introduce the first dedicated benchmark for mesh insertion in 3DGS, providing a standardized evaluation framework for assessing lighting consistency and photorealism. Extensive experiments across multiple real-world reconstruction datasets demonstrate that LightHarmony3D achieves state-of-the-art realism and multi-view consistency.

AI.tldr: LightHarmony3D：一种用于3D高斯泼溅场景中光照一致网格插入的新框架，通过生成式模块预测HDR环境图，实现物理一致的光照和阴影渲染
AI.motivation: 在3D高斯泼溅重建场景中插入外部网格对象时，实现物理一致的光照和阴影具有挑战性，需要准确的场景光照估计和多视角一致渲染
AI.method: 提出生成式模块，通过单次前向传播预测插入位置的360° HDR环境图，利用生成先验而非迭代优化，高效捕捉主导场景光照，实现物理基础的着色和阴影
AI.result: 在多个真实世界重建数据集上的实验表明，LightHarmony3D实现了最先进的真实感和多视角一致性
AI.conclusion: LightHarmony3D框架成功解决了3DGS场景中网格插入的光照一致性问题，并建立了首个专用基准测试，为AR/VR、虚拟布置等应用提供了有效的解决方案

title: Learning to Generate Formally Verifiable Step-by-Step Logic Reasoning via Structured Formal Intermediaries
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated impressive performance on complex, multi-step reasoning tasks, especially when post-trained with outcome-rewarded reinforcement learning Guo et al. 2025. However, it has been observed that outcome rewards often overlook flawed intermediate steps, leading to unreliable reasoning steps even when final answers are correct. To address this unreliable reasoning, we propose PRoSFI (Process Reward over Structured Formal Intermediates), a novel reward method that enhances reasoning reliability without compromising accuracy. Instead of generating formal proofs directly, which is rarely accomplishable for a modest-sized (7B) model, the model outputs structured intermediate steps aligned with its natural language reasoning. Each step is then verified by a formal prover. Only fully validated reasoning chains receive high rewards. The integration of formal verification guides the model towards generating step-by-step machine-checkable proofs, thereby yielding more credible final answers. PRoSFI offers a simple and effective approach to training trustworthy reasoning models.

AI.tldr: PRoSFI是一种新的奖励方法，通过结构化中间步骤的形式验证来提升大语言模型推理的可靠性，而不牺牲准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于结果奖励的强化学习虽然能提升大语言模型在复杂推理任务上的表现，但往往忽略了有缺陷的中间步骤，导致即使最终答案正确，推理过程也不可靠。
AI.method: 提出PRoSFI方法：模型输出与自然语言推理对齐的结构化中间步骤，每个步骤由形式验证器验证，只有完全验证通过的推理链才能获得高奖励，从而引导模型生成可机器验证的逐步证明。
AI.result: PRoSFI能够在不影响准确性的前提下，显著提升推理的可靠性，使模型生成更可信的最终答案。
AI.conclusion: PRoSFI提供了一种简单有效的方法来训练可信的推理模型，通过形式验证引导模型生成机器可检查的证明，解决了结果奖励方法忽略中间步骤可靠性的问题。

title: Impact of enriched meaning representations for language generation in dialogue tasks: A comprehensive exploration of the relevance of tasks, corpora and metrics
summary: Conversational systems should generate diverse language forms to interact fluently and accurately with users. In this context, Natural Language Generation (NLG) engines convert Meaning Representations (MRs) into sentences, directly influencing user perception. These MRs usually encode the communicative function (e.g., inform, request, confirm) via DAs and enumerate the semantic content with slot-value pairs. In this work, our objective is to analyse whether providing a task demonstrator to the generator enhances the generations of a fine-tuned model. This demonstrator is an MR-sentence pair extracted from the original dataset that enriches the input at training and inference time. The analysis involves five metrics that focus on different linguistic aspects, and four datasets that differ in multiple features, such as domain, size, lexicon, MR variability, and acquisition process. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first study on dialogue NLG implementing a comparative analysis of the impact of MRs on generation quality across domains, corpus characteristics, and the metrics used to evaluate these generations. Our key insight is that the proposed enriched inputs are effective for complex tasks and small datasets with high variability in MRs and sentences. They are also beneficial in zero-shot settings for any domain. Moreover, the analysis of the metrics shows that semantic metrics capture generation quality more accurately than lexical metrics. In addition, among these semantic metrics, those trained with human ratings can detect omissions and other subtle semantic issues that embedding-based metrics often miss. Finally, the evolution of the metric scores and the excellent results for Slot Accuracy and Dialogue Act Accuracy demonstrate that the generative models present fast adaptability to different tasks and robustness at semantic and communicative intention levels.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了在对话NLG任务中，为生成器提供任务示范（MR-句子对）是否能提升微调模型的生成质量，通过多数据集、多指标的实验发现示范对复杂任务和小数据集特别有效。
AI.motivation: 对话系统需要生成多样化的语言形式来流畅准确地与用户交互。NLG引擎将意义表示转换为句子直接影响用户体验，但现有研究缺乏对MRs影响生成质量的跨领域、跨语料特征的系统分析。
AI.method: 研究为生成器提供任务示范（从原始数据集中提取的MR-句子对）来丰富训练和推理时的输入。通过五个关注不同语言方面的指标，在四个具有不同特征（领域、大小、词汇、MR变异性、获取过程）的数据集上进行实验分析。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）提出的丰富输入对复杂任务和高MR/句子变异性的小数据集特别有效；2）在零样本设置中对任何领域都有益；3）语义指标比词汇指标更能准确捕捉生成质量；4）基于人工评分的语义指标能检测嵌入指标常遗漏的省略和细微语义问题；5）生成模型展现出快速适应不同任务的能力和在语义及交际意图层面的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个在对话NLG中系统分析MRs对生成质量影响的跨领域研究。任务示范能有效提升生成质量，特别是在复杂任务和小数据集场景下。语义指标比词汇指标更适合评估生成质量，而基于人工评分的语义指标能捕捉更细微的语义问题。

title: CCDNet: Learning to Detect Camouflage against Distractors in Infrared Small Target Detection
summary: Infrared target detection (IRSTD) tasks have critical applications in areas like wilderness rescue and maritime search. However, detecting infrared targets is challenging due to their low contrast and tendency to blend into complex backgrounds, effectively camouflaging themselves. Additionally, other objects with similar features (distractors) can cause false alarms, further degrading detection performance. To address these issues, we propose a novel \textbf{C}amouflage-aware \textbf{C}ounter-\textbf{D}istraction \textbf{Net}work (CCDNet) in this paper. We design a backbone with Weighted Multi-branch Perceptrons (WMPs), which aggregates self-conditioned multi-level features to accurately represent the target and background. Based on these rich features, we then propose a novel Aggregation-and-Refinement Fusion Neck (ARFN) to refine structures/semantics from shallow/deep features maps, and bidirectionally reconstruct the relations between the targets and the backgrounds, highlighting the targets while suppressing the complex backgrounds to improve detection accuracy. Furthermore, we present a new Contrastive-aided Distractor Discriminator (CaDD), enforcing adaptive similarity computation both locally and globally between the real targets and the backgrounds to more precisely discriminate distractors, so as to reduce the false alarm rate. Extensive experiments on infrared image datasets confirm that CCDNet outperforms other state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 提出CCDNet网络用于红外目标检测，通过加权多分支感知器、聚合细化融合颈和对比辅助干扰物鉴别器，解决红外目标低对比度、背景复杂和干扰物导致的误报问题。
AI.motivation: 红外目标检测在野外救援和海上搜索等应用中至关重要，但面临目标对比度低、易与复杂背景融合（伪装）以及相似特征干扰物导致误报的挑战。
AI.method: 1. 使用加权多分支感知器（WMPs）作为骨干网络，聚合自条件多级特征来准确表示目标和背景；2. 提出聚合细化融合颈（ARFN）从浅层/深层特征图中细化结构/语义，双向重建目标与背景关系；3. 设计对比辅助干扰物鉴别器（CaDD），在局部和全局进行自适应相似度计算，精确区分干扰物。
AI.result: 在红外图像数据集上的大量实验证实，CCDNet优于其他最先进的方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的CCDNet通过创新的网络架构设计，有效解决了红外目标检测中的伪装和干扰物问题，提高了检测精度并降低了误报率。

title: FlowPIE: Test-Time Scientific Idea Evolution with Flow-Guided Literature Exploration
summary: Scientific idea generation (SIG) is critical to AI-driven autonomous research, yet existing approaches are often constrained by a static retrieval-then-generation paradigm, leading to homogeneous and insufficiently divergent ideas. In this work, we propose FlowPIE, a tightly coupled retrieval-generation framework that treats literature exploration and idea generation as a co-evolving process. FlowPIE expands literature trajectories via a flow-guided Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) inspired by GFlowNets, using the quality of current ideas assessed by an LLM-based generative reward model (GRM) as a supervised signal to guide adaptive retrieval and construct a diverse, high-quality initial population. Based on this population, FlowPIE models idea generation as a test-time idea evolution process, applying selection, crossover, and mutation with the isolation island paradigm and GRM-based fitness computation to incorporate cross-domain knowledge. It effectively mitigates the information cocoons arising from over-reliance on parametric knowledge and static literature. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that FlowPIE consistently produces ideas with higher novelty, feasibility and diversity compared to strong LLM-based and agent-based frameworks, while enabling reward scaling during test time.

AI.tldr: FlowPIE是一个紧密耦合的检索-生成框架，将文献探索和想法生成视为共同进化的过程，通过流引导的MCTS和LLM奖励模型指导自适应检索，然后通过进化算法生成多样化高质量的科学想法。
AI.motivation: 现有的科学想法生成方法受限于静态的"检索-生成"范式，导致想法同质化且发散性不足，无法有效突破信息茧房和过度依赖参数化知识的局限。
AI.method: 1. 流引导的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）进行文献轨迹扩展；2. LLM生成奖励模型评估想法质量；3. 基于初始种群的进化算法（选择、交叉、变异）；4. 隔离岛范式结合跨领域知识。
AI.result: FlowPIE相比现有LLM和基于代理的框架，能够持续产生更高新颖性、可行性和多样性的想法，同时在测试时实现奖励缩放。
AI.conclusion: FlowPIE通过将文献探索和想法生成紧密耦合为共同进化过程，有效缓解了信息茧房问题，为AI驱动的自主研究提供了更有效的科学想法生成框架。

title: Baby Scale: Investigating Models Trained on Individual Children's Language Input
summary: Modern language models (LMs) must be trained on many orders of magnitude more words of training data than human children receive before they begin to produce useful behavior. Assessing the nature and origins of this "data gap" requires benchmarking LMs on human-scale datasets to understand how linguistic knowledge emerges from children's natural training data. Using transcripts from the BabyView dataset (videos from children ages 6-36 months), we investigate (1) scaling performance at child-scale data regimes, (2) variability in model performance across datasets from different children's experiences and linguistic predictors of dataset quality, and (3) relationships between model and child language learning outcomes. LMs trained on child data show acceptable scaling for grammar tasks, but lower scaling on semantic and world knowledge tasks than models trained on synthetic data; we also observe substantial variability on data from different children. Beyond dataset size, performance is most associated with a combination of distributional and interactional linguistic features, broadly consistent with what makes high-quality input for child language development. Finally, model likelihoods for individual words correlate with children's learning of those words, suggesting that properties of child-directed input may influence both model learning and human language development. Overall, understanding what properties make language data efficient for learning can enable more powerful small-scale language models while also shedding light on human language acquisition.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用儿童视频转录数据训练语言模型，探索在儿童规模数据下的模型表现、不同儿童数据间的差异，以及模型与儿童语言习得的关系
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型需要比儿童多得多的训练数据才能产生有用行为，研究旨在通过儿童规模的数据集来理解语言知识如何从儿童自然训练数据中涌现，缩小语言模型的"数据差距"
AI.method: 使用BabyView数据集（6-36个月儿童视频转录）训练语言模型，分析三个维度：1)儿童规模数据下的扩展性能；2)不同儿童数据间的变异性及语言特征对数据集质量的影响；3)模型与儿童语言学习结果的关系
AI.result: 在儿童数据上训练的模型在语法任务上表现良好，但在语义和世界知识任务上的扩展性不如合成数据训练的模型；不同儿童数据间存在显著变异性；性能与分布性和交互性语言特征的组合最相关；模型对单个词的似然性与儿童学习这些词的速度相关
AI.conclusion: 理解使语言数据高效学习的特性既能开发更强大的小规模语言模型，也能揭示人类语言习得的机制，儿童导向输入的特性可能同时影响模型学习和人类语言发展

title: ASI-Evolve: AI Accelerates AI
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures, 6 tables. Code available at https://github.com/GAIR-NLP/ASI-Evolve
summary: Can AI accelerate the development of AI itself? While recent agentic systems have shown strong performance on well-scoped tasks with rapid feedback, it remains unclear whether they can tackle the costly, long-horizon, and weakly supervised research loops that drive real AI progress. We present ASI-Evolve, an agentic framework for AI-for-AI research that closes this loop through a learn-design-experiment-analyze cycle. ASI-Evolve augments standard evolutionary agents with two key components: a cognition base that injects accumulated human priors into each round of exploration, and a dedicated analyzer that distills complex experimental outcomes into reusable insights for future iterations. To our knowledge, ASI-Evolve is the first unified framework to demonstrate AI-driven discovery across three central components of AI development: data, architectures, and learning algorithms. In neural architecture design, it discovered 105 SOTA linear attention architectures, with the best discovered model surpassing DeltaNet by +0.97 points, nearly 3x the gain of recent human-designed improvements. In pretraining data curation, the evolved pipeline improves average benchmark performance by +3.96 points, with gains exceeding 18 points on MMLU. In reinforcement learning algorithm design, discovered algorithms outperform GRPO by up to +12.5 points on AMC32, +11.67 points on AIME24, and +5.04 points on OlympiadBench. We further provide initial evidence that this AI-for-AI paradigm can transfer beyond the AI stack through experiments in mathematics and biomedicine. Together, these results suggest that ASI-Evolve represents a promising step toward enabling AI to accelerate AI across the foundational stages of development, offering early evidence for the feasibility of closed-loop AI research.

AI.tldr: ASI-Evolve是一个AI驱动AI研究的智能体框架，通过"学习-设计-实验-分析"闭环，在神经网络架构设计、预训练数据筛选和强化学习算法三个核心AI开发领域实现了自主发现，显著超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体系统在快速反馈的明确任务上表现良好，但难以应对成本高昂、周期长、监督弱的真实AI研究循环。需要开发能够自主进行AI-for-AI研究的框架，加速AI自身发展。
AI.method: 提出ASI-Evolve框架，基于进化算法智能体，增加两个关键组件：1) 认知基础，将积累的人类先验知识注入每轮探索；2) 专用分析器，将复杂实验结果提炼为可复用的见解。通过"学习-设计-实验-分析"闭环实现自主研究。
AI.result: 在三个核心AI开发领域取得突破：1) 神经网络架构设计：发现105个SOTA线性注意力架构，最佳模型超越DeltaNet +0.97分；2) 预训练数据筛选：提升平均基准性能+3.96分，MMLU上增益超18分；3) 强化学习算法设计：在AMC32上超越GRPO +12.5分，AIME24上+11.67分，OlympiadBench上+5.04分。初步证据显示该范式可扩展到数学和生物医学领域。
AI.conclusion: ASI-Evolve代表了AI加速AI发展的有前景的一步，为闭环AI研究的可行性提供了早期证据，表明AI能够在AI开发的基础阶段实现自主加速。

title: Diffusion Mental Averages
summary: Can a diffusion model produce its own "mental average" of a concept-one that is as sharp and realistic as a typical sample? We introduce Diffusion Mental Averages (DMA), a model-centric answer to this question. While prior methods aim to average image collections, they produce blurry results when applied to diffusion samples from the same prompt. These data-centric techniques operate outside the model, ignoring the generative process. In contrast, DMA averages within the diffusion model's semantic space, as discovered by recent studies. Since this space evolves across timesteps and lacks a direct decoder, we cast averaging as trajectory alignment: optimize multiple noise latents so their denoising trajectories progressively converge toward shared coarse-to-fine semantics, yielding a single sharp prototype. We extend our approach to multimodal concepts (e.g., dogs with many breeds) by clustering samples in semantically-rich spaces such as CLIP and applying Textual Inversion or LoRA to bridge CLIP clusters into diffusion space. This is, to our knowledge, the first approach that delivers consistent, realistic averages, even for abstract concepts, serving as a concrete visual summary and a lens into model biases and concept representation.

AI.tldr: 提出Diffusion Mental Averages (DMA)方法，在扩散模型的语义空间内进行概念平均，生成清晰逼真的原型图像，而非传统图像平均的模糊结果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法对同一提示词生成的扩散样本进行图像平均会产生模糊结果，因为它们是在模型外部操作，忽略了生成过程。需要一种能在扩散模型语义空间内进行概念平均的方法，生成清晰逼真的"心理平均"图像。
AI.method: 将平均问题转化为轨迹对齐：优化多个噪声潜在向量，使它们的去噪轨迹在时间步上逐步收敛到共享的从粗到细的语义，从而生成单个清晰原型。对于多模态概念，先在CLIP等语义丰富空间中对样本聚类，然后使用Textual Inversion或LoRA将CLIP聚类桥接到扩散空间。
AI.result: DMA能够生成一致、逼真的平均图像，即使是抽象概念也能处理，作为具体的视觉总结，并揭示模型偏见和概念表示。
AI.conclusion: DMA是第一个能够在扩散模型语义空间内进行概念平均的方法，生成清晰逼真的原型图像，为模型偏见和概念表示提供了新的分析视角。

title: Optimizing Donor Outreach for Blood Collection Sessions: A Scalable Decision Support Framework
comment: 16 pages, 9 figures, 4 supplementary figures, 2 supplementary tables
summary:
Blood donation centers face challenges in matching supply with demand while managing donor availability. Although targeted outreach is important, it can cause donor fatigue via over-solicitation. Effective recruitment requires targeting the right donors at the right time, balancing constraints with donor convenience and eligibility. Despite extensive work on blood supply chain optimization and growing interest in algorithmic donor recruitment, the operational problem of assigning donors to sessions across a multi-site network, taking into account eligibility, capacity, blood-type demand targets, geographic convenience, and donor safety, remains unaddressed.
  We address this gap with an optimization framework for donor invitation scheduling incorporating donor eligibility, travel convenience, blood-type demand targets, and penalties. We evaluate two strategies: (i) a binary integer linear programming (BILP) formulation and (ii) an efficient greedy heuristic. Evaluation uses the registry from Instituto Português do Sangue e da Transplantação (IPST) for invite planning in the Lisbon operational region using 4-month windows. A prospective pipeline integrates organic attendance forecasting, quantile-based demand targets, and residual capacity estimation for forward-looking invitation plans. Results reveal its key role in closing the supply-demand gap in the Lisbon operational region. A controlled comparison shows that the greedy heuristic achieves results comparable to the BILP, with 188x less peak memory and 115x faster runtime; trade-offs include 3.9 pp lower demand fulfillment (86.1% vs. 90.0%), larger donor-session distance, higher adverse-reaction donor exposure, and greater invitation burden per non-high-frequency donor, reflecting local versus global optimization. Experiments assess how constraint-aware scheduling can close gaps by mobilizing eligible inactive/lapsing donors.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个优化框架来解决多站点血液捐赠网络中捐赠者邀请调度问题，考虑了资格、容量、血型需求、地理便利性和捐赠者安全等因素，通过BILP和贪心启发式算法进行对比评估。
AI.motivation: 血液捐赠中心面临供需匹配和捐赠者可用性管理的挑战。虽然定向招募很重要，但过度招揽可能导致捐赠者疲劳。现有研究在血液供应链优化方面已有大量工作，但针对多站点网络中考虑捐赠者资格、容量、血型需求目标、地理便利性和捐赠者安全的捐赠者邀请调度操作问题尚未得到解决。
AI.method: 提出了一个捐赠者邀请调度优化框架，整合了捐赠者资格、旅行便利性、血型需求目标和惩罚机制。评估了两种策略：(1) 二元整数线性规划(BILP)公式；(2) 高效的贪心启发式算法。使用葡萄牙血液与移植研究所(IPST)的注册数据进行评估，采用4个月时间窗口进行邀请规划。前瞻性管道整合了有机出席预测、基于分位数的需求目标和剩余容量估计。
AI.result: 结果显示该框架在里斯本运营区域缩小供需差距方面发挥关键作用。贪心启发式算法与BILP相比，在结果上表现相当，但峰值内存减少188倍，运行时间快115倍；权衡包括需求满足率降低3.9个百分点（86.1% vs. 90.0%）、捐赠者-会话距离更大、不良反应捐赠者暴露更高、非高频捐赠者邀请负担更大，反映了局部优化与全局优化的差异。实验表明约束感知调度可以通过动员符合条件的非活跃/即将失效捐赠者来缩小差距。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了多站点血液捐赠网络中捐赠者邀请调度优化问题的空白，提出的贪心启发式算法在计算效率方面显著优于BILP，虽然在某些指标上略有妥协，但在实际运营中提供了可行的解决方案，能够有效动员符合条件的捐赠者并缩小供需差距。

title: Bringing Up a Bilingual BabyLM: Investigating Multilingual Language Acquisition Using Small-Scale Models
summary: Multilingualism is incredibly common around the world, leading to many important theoretical and practical questions about how children learn multiple languages at once. For example, does multilingual acquisition lead to delays in learning? Are there better and worse ways to structure multilingual input? Many correlational studies address these questions, but it is surprisingly difficult to get definitive answers because children cannot be randomly assigned to be multilingual and data are typically not matched between languages. We use language model training as a method for simulating a variety of highly controlled exposure conditions, and create matched 100M-word mono- and bilingual datasets using synthetic data and machine translation. We train GPT-2 models on monolingual and bilingual data organized to reflect a range of exposure regimes, and evaluate their performance on perplexity, grammaticality, and semantic knowledge. Across model scales and measures, bilingual models perform similarly to monolingual models in one language, but show strong performance in the second language as well. These results suggest that there are no strong differences between different bilingual exposure regimes, and that bilingual input poses no in-principle challenges for agnostic statistical learners.

AI.tldr: 使用语言模型模拟双语学习环境，发现双语模型在单语表现上与单语模型相当，同时在第二语言上也有良好表现，不同双语暴露模式间无显著差异。
AI.motivation: 研究多语言习得的理论问题，特别是双语学习是否会导致语言习得延迟，以及不同双语输入结构的效果差异。由于现实中无法随机分配儿童成为双语者且数据难以匹配，需要新的研究方法。
AI.method: 使用语言模型训练模拟高度控制的暴露条件，创建匹配的1亿词单语和双语数据集（使用合成数据和机器翻译）。训练GPT-2模型在不同暴露模式下，评估其在困惑度、语法性和语义知识方面的表现。
AI.result: 双语模型在单语表现上与单语模型相当，同时在第二语言上表现良好。不同双语暴露模式之间没有显著差异，双语输入对统计学习者不构成原则性挑战。
AI.conclusion: 双语学习不会导致语言习得延迟，不同双语暴露模式效果相似，双语输入对统计学习者来说是可行的，为理解多语言习得提供了新的实证支持。

title: View-oriented Conversation Compiler for Agent Trace Analysis
summary: Agent traces carry increasing analytical value in the era of context learning and harness-driven agentic cognition, yet most prior work treats conversation format as a trivial engineering detail. Modern agent conversations contain deeply structured content, including nested tool calls and results, chain-of-thought reasoning blocks, sub-agent invocations, context-window compaction boundaries, and harness-injected system directives, whose complexity far exceeds that of simple user-assistant exchanges. Feeding such traces to a reflector or other analytical mechanism in plain text, JSON, YAML, or via grep can materially degrade analysis quality. This paper presents VCC (View-oriented Conversation Compiler), a compiler (lex, parse, IR, lower, emit) that transforms raw agent JSONL logs into a family of structured views: a full view (lossless transcript serving as the canonical line-number coordinate system), a user-interface view (reconstructing the interaction as the user actually perceived it), and an adaptive view (a structure-preserving projection governed by a relevance predicate). In a context-learning experiment on AppWorld, replacing only the reflector's input format, from raw JSONL to VCC-compiled views, leads to higher pass rates across all three model configurations tested, while cutting reflector token consumption by half to two-thirds and producing more concise learned memory. These results suggest that message format functions as infrastructure for context learning, not as an incidental implementation choice.

AI.tldr: VCC是一个面向视图的对话编译器，将原始代理JSONL日志转换为结构化视图，提升上下文学习效果并减少令牌消耗
AI.motivation: 现代代理对话包含复杂的结构化内容（嵌套工具调用、思维链推理块、子代理调用等），传统处理方法（纯文本、JSON、YAML）会降低分析质量，需要更好的对话格式基础设施
AI.method: 提出VCC编译器（词法分析、语法分析、中间表示、降低、生成），将原始代理JSONL日志转换为三种结构化视图：完整视图（无损转录）、用户界面视图（重构用户实际感知的交互）、自适应视图（基于相关性谓词的结构保持投影）
AI.result: 在AppWorld的上下文学习实验中，仅将反射器输入格式从原始JSONL改为VCC编译视图，所有三种模型配置的通过率都提高，同时反射器令牌消耗减少50-67%，并产生更简洁的学习记忆
AI.conclusion: 消息格式是上下文学习的基础设施，而不仅仅是偶然的实现选择，结构化对话表示对代理分析至关重要

title: Scaling the Long Video Understanding of Multimodal Large Language Models via Visual Memory Mechanism
summary: Long video understanding is a key challenge that plagues the advancement of \emph{Multimodal Large language Models} (MLLMs). In this paper, we study this problem from the perspective of visual memory mechanism, and proposed a novel and training-free approach, termed \emph{Flexible Memory} (\textbf{FlexMem}). In principle, FlexMem aims to mimic human behavior of video watching, \emph{i.e.}, continually watching video content and recalling the most relevant memory fragments to answer the question. In this way, FlexMem can help MLLMs achieve video understanding of infinite lengths, unlike previous methods that process all video information at once and have input upper-limit. Concretely, FlexMem first consider the visual KV caches as the memory sources, and realize the effective memory transfer and writing via a dual-pathway compression design. Afterwards, FlexMem also explores different memory reading strategies for the diverse video understanding tasks, including the popular streaming one. To validate FlexMem, we apply it to two popular video-MLLMs, and conduct extensive experiments on five long video and one streaming video task.
