The experimental results show that on \textbf{a single 3090 GPU}, our FlexMem can achieve obvious improvements than existing efficient video understanding methods and process more than \textbf{1k frames}, which also helps the base MLLMs achieve comparable or even better performance than SOTA MLLMs on some benchmarks, \emph{e.g.} , GPT-4o and Gemini-1.5 Pro.

AI.tldr: FlexMem是一种无需训练的视频理解方法，通过模拟人类观看视频时的记忆机制，实现无限长度视频处理，在单张3090 GPU上可处理超过1000帧。
AI.motivation: 解决多模态大语言模型在长视频理解方面的挑战，特别是处理无限长度视频的能力，克服现有方法一次性处理所有视频信息且有输入上限的限制。
AI.method: FlexMem模仿人类观看视频行为，将视觉KV缓存作为记忆源，通过双路径压缩设计实现有效的记忆转移和写入，并针对不同视频理解任务探索不同的记忆读取策略。
AI.result: 在5个长视频和1个流视频任务上的实验表明，FlexMem在单张3090 GPU上比现有高效视频理解方法有明显提升，可处理超过1000帧，帮助基础MLLM在某些基准测试中达到甚至超过GPT-4o和Gemini-1.5 Pro的性能。
AI.conclusion: FlexMem是一种有效的训练免费方法，通过视觉记忆机制实现了无限长度视频理解，为多模态大语言模型的长视频处理提供了新思路。

title: Beyond the Steeper Curve: AI-Mediated Metacognitive Decoupling and the Limits of the Dunning-Kruger Metaphor
summary: The common claim that generative AI simply amplifies the Dunning-Kruger effect is too coarse to capture the available evidence. The clearest findings instead suggest that large language model (LLM) use can improve observable output and short-term task performance while degrading metacognitive accuracy and flattening the classic competence-confidence gradient across skill groups. This paper synthesizes evidence from human-AI interaction, learning research, and model evaluation, and proposes the working model of AI-mediated metacognitive decoupling: a widening gap among produced output, underlying understanding, calibration accuracy, and self-assessed ability. This four-variable account better explains overconfidence, over- and under-reliance, crutch effects, and weak transfer than the simpler metaphor of a uniformly steeper Dunning-Kruger curve. The paper concludes with implications for tool design, assessment, and knowledge work.

AI.tldr: AI使用并非简单放大邓宁-克鲁格效应，而是通过AI中介元认知解耦机制，在改善任务表现的同时降低元认知准确性，导致产出、理解、校准和自我评估之间的脱节。
AI.motivation: 挑战"生成式AI只是放大邓宁-克鲁格效应"的简单观点，需要更精细的理论框架来解释AI使用对任务表现和元认知能力的复杂影响。
AI.method: 综合人类-AI交互、学习研究和模型评估的证据，提出AI中介元认知解耦的四变量工作模型，分析产出、理解、校准准确性和自我评估能力之间的关系。
AI.result: LLM使用能改善可观察产出和短期任务表现，但会降低元认知准确性，使不同技能群体的能力-信心梯度扁平化，导致过度自信、过度/不足依赖、拐杖效应和弱迁移等问题。
AI.conclusion: AI中介元认知解耦模型比简单的邓宁-克鲁格曲线陡峭化隐喻更能解释复杂现象，对工具设计、评估和知识工作具有重要启示。

title: Omni-NegCLIP: Enhancing CLIP with Front-Layer Contrastive Fine-Tuning for Comprehensive Negation Understanding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, recent studies have shown that VLMs, such as CLIP, perform poorly in understanding negation expressions, which are common in natural language. In this work, we propose Omni-NegCLIP, a fine-tuned CLIP model that improves CLIP's understanding of two types of negation, namely presence-based negation and absence-based negation, which correspond to negated expressions of objects that are actually present in an image and those that may plausibly exist in an image but are in fact absent, respectively, by modifying CLIP's original InfoNCE contrastive loss. Specifically, we design a presence-based contrastive objective that pulls image embeddings closer to their original caption embeddings while pushing them away from the corresponding presence-based negated caption embeddings, and an absence-based contrastive objective that aligns image embeddings with both original and absence-based negated caption embeddings while maintaining a semantic distinction between the two text embeddings. Based on our observation that the front transformer layers of CLIP text encoder have stronger learning ability for negated text than the later layers, we fine-tune the front transformer layers of the CLIP text encoder at each training step using the combined contrastive objective. Experimental results show that, compared with pretrained CLIP, Omni-NegCLIP improves performance on presence-based negation and absence-based negation tasks by up to 52.65% and 12.50%, respectively, without sacrificing general capability in image-text retrieval and even improving it by up to 19.62%. Compared with prior works, Omni-NegCLIP demonstrates a more comprehensive ability to understand multiple types of negation tasks.

AI.tldr: Omni-NegCLIP通过改进CLIP的对比损失函数，专门针对存在性否定和缺席性否定两种否定表达进行微调，显著提升了视觉语言模型对否定表达的理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型（如CLIP）在处理自然语言中的否定表达时表现不佳，这限制了模型在真实场景中的应用。否定表达在自然语言中很常见，但现有模型难以准确理解。
AI.method: 1. 修改CLIP的InfoNCE对比损失函数，设计两种对比目标：存在性否定对比目标（将图像嵌入拉近原始描述嵌入，推离存在性否定描述嵌入）和缺席性否定对比目标（将图像嵌入同时对齐原始描述和缺席性否定描述，同时保持两种文本嵌入的语义区分）。2. 基于观察到CLIP文本编码器前端transformer层对否定文本学习能力更强，在训练时只微调文本编码器的前端transformer层。
AI.result: 相比预训练的CLIP，Omni-NegCLIP在处理存在性否定任务上性能提升高达52.65%，在缺席性否定任务上提升12.50%。同时，在图像-文本检索任务上不仅没有性能损失，反而提升了19.62%。相比先前工作，Omni-NegCLIP展现出更全面的否定理解能力。
AI.conclusion: Omni-NegCLIP通过专门设计的对比损失函数和有针对性的模型微调策略，有效提升了视觉语言模型对多种类型否定表达的理解能力，同时保持了甚至提升了模型的通用能力。

title: A First Step Towards Even More Sparse Encodings of Probability Distributions
comment: Published in ILP2021. The final authenticated publication is available online at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-030-97454-1_13
summary: Real world scenarios can be captured with lifted probability distributions. However, distributions are usually encoded in a table or list, requiring an exponential number of values. Hence, we propose a method for extracting first-order formulas from probability distributions that require significantly less values by reducing the number of values in a distribution and then extracting, for each value, a logical formula to be further minimized. This reduction and minimization allows for increasing the sparsity in the encoding while also generalizing a given distribution. Our evaluation shows that sparsity can increase immensely by extracting a small set of short formulas while preserving core information.

AI.tldr: 提出从概率分布中提取一阶逻辑公式的方法，通过减少分布中的数值并提取最小化公式，显著降低编码复杂度
AI.motivation: 现实世界场景可以用提升概率分布表示，但传统编码方式需要指数级数量的值，导致存储和计算效率低下
AI.method: 通过减少概率分布中的数值，为每个值提取逻辑公式并进一步最小化，从而增加编码稀疏性并泛化分布
AI.result: 评估显示，通过提取少量简短公式，稀疏性可以极大增加，同时保留核心信息
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法能够显著减少概率分布的编码复杂度，通过稀疏表示实现高效存储和泛化能力

title: Agenda-based Narrative Extraction: Steering Pathfinding Algorithms with Large Language Models
summary: Existing narrative extraction methods face a trade-off between coherence, interactivity, and multi-storyline support. Narrative Maps supports rich interaction and generates multiple storylines as a byproduct of its coverage constraints, though this comes at the cost of individual path coherence. Narrative Trails achieves high coherence through maximum capacity path optimization but provides no mechanism for user guidance or multiple perspectives. We introduce agenda-based narrative extraction, a method that bridges this gap by integrating large language models into the Narrative Trails pathfinding process to steer storyline construction toward user-specified perspectives. Our approach uses an LLM at each step to rank candidate documents based on their alignment with a given agenda while maintaining narrative coherence. Running the algorithm with different agendas yields different storylines through the same corpus. We evaluated our approach on a news article corpus using LLM judges with Claude Opus 4.5 and GPT 5.1, measuring both coherence and agenda alignment across 64 endpoint pairs and 6 agendas. LLM-driven steering achieves 9.9% higher alignment than keyword matching on semantic agendas (p=0.017), with 13.3% improvement on \textit{Regime Crackdown} specifically (p=0.037), while keyword matching remains competitive on agendas with literal keyword overlap. The coherence cost is minimal: LLM steering reduces coherence by only 2.2% compared to the agenda-agnostic baseline. Counter-agendas that contradict the source material score uniformly low (2.2-2.5) across all methods, confirming that steering cannot fabricate unsupported narratives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于议程的叙事提取方法，通过将大语言模型集成到Narrative Trails路径查找过程中，在保持叙事连贯性的同时引导故事线构建向用户指定视角，解决了现有方法在连贯性、交互性和多故事线支持之间的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 现有叙事提取方法面临连贯性、交互性和多故事线支持之间的权衡：Narrative Maps支持丰富交互并生成多故事线，但牺牲了单个路径的连贯性；Narrative Trails通过最大容量路径优化实现高连贯性，但缺乏用户引导或多视角机制。需要一种方法既能保持高连贯性，又能支持用户引导和多视角叙事。
AI.method: 提出基于议程的叙事提取方法，将大语言模型集成到Narrative Trails路径查找过程中。在每一步使用LLM根据候选文档与给定议程的对齐程度进行排名，同时保持叙事连贯性。通过不同议程运行算法可在同一语料库中生成不同的故事线。
AI.result: 在新闻文章语料库上使用Claude Opus 4.5和GPT 5.1作为LLM评判者进行评估，测量了64个端点对和6个议程的连贯性和议程对齐度。LLM驱动的引导在语义议程上比关键词匹配对齐度高9.9%（p=0.017），在"政权镇压"议程上特别提高13.3%（p=0.037）。连贯性成本最小：LLM引导仅比无议程基线降低2.2%的连贯性。与源材料相矛盾的对抗议程在所有方法中得分都很低（2.2-2.5），证实引导无法制造无支持的叙事。
AI.conclusion: 基于议程的叙事提取方法成功弥合了现有方法之间的差距，能够在保持高叙事连贯性的同时，通过LLM引导支持用户指定的多视角叙事。该方法在语义议程上显著优于关键词匹配，同时确保引导不会制造无事实支持的叙事。

title: Unbiased Model Prediction Without Using Protected Attribute Information
summary: The problem of bias persists in the deep learning community as models continue to provide disparate performance across different demographic subgroups. Therefore, several algorithms have been proposed to improve the fairness of deep models. However, a majority of these algorithms utilize the protected attribute information for bias mitigation, which severely limits their application in real-world scenarios. To address this concern, we have proposed a novel algorithm, termed as \textbf{Non-Protected Attribute-based Debiasing (NPAD)} algorithm for bias mitigation, that does not require the protected attribute information. The proposed NPAD algorithm utilizes the auxiliary information provided by the non-protected attributes to optimize the model for bias mitigation. Further, two different loss functions, \textbf{Debiasing via Attribute Cluster Loss (DACL)} and \textbf{Filter Redundancy Loss (FRL)} have been proposed to optimize the model for fairness goals. Multiple experiments are performed on the LFWA and CelebA datasets for facial attribute prediction, and a significant reduction in bias across different gender and age subgroups is observed.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需保护属性信息的去偏算法NPAD，利用非保护属性的辅助信息，通过DACL和FRL两种损失函数优化模型公平性，在LFWA和CelebA数据集上显著减少了性别和年龄子组的偏见。
AI.motivation: 深度学习模型在不同人口统计子组间存在性能差异的偏见问题持续存在。现有去偏算法大多需要保护属性信息，这在现实场景中应用受限。因此需要开发无需保护属性信息的去偏方法。
AI.method: 提出了NPAD（非保护属性去偏）算法，利用非保护属性的辅助信息进行偏见缓解。设计了两种损失函数：DACL（通过属性聚类损失去偏）和FRL（过滤冗余损失），共同优化模型以实现公平性目标。
AI.result: 在LFWA和CelebA数据集上进行面部属性预测实验，结果显示在不同性别和年龄子组中偏见显著减少，证明了NPAD算法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: NPAD算法能够在不需要保护属性信息的情况下有效缓解深度学习模型的偏见问题，为现实世界场景中的公平性应用提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Measuring the metacognition of AI
summary: A robust decision-making process must take into account uncertainty, especially when the choice involves inherent risks. Because artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are increasingly integrated into decision-making workflows, managing uncertainty relies more and more on the metacognitive capabilities of these systems; i.e, their ability to assess the reliability of and regulate their own decisions. Hence, it is crucial to employ robust methods to measure the metacognitive abilities of AI. This paper is primarily a methodological contribution arguing for the adoption of the meta-d' framework, or its model-free alternatives, as the gold standard for assessing the metacognitive sensitivity of AIs--the ability to generate confidence ratings that distinguish correct from incorrect responses. Moreover, we propose to leverage signal detection theory (SDT) to measure the ability of AIs to spontaneously regulate their decisions based on uncertainty and risk. To demonstrate the practical utility of these psychophysical frameworks, we conduct two series of experiments on three large language models (LLMs)--GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp, and Mistral-Medium-2508. In the first experiments, LLMs performed a primary judgment followed by a confidence rating. In the second, LLMs only performed the primary judgment, while we manipulated the risk associated with either response. On the one hand, applying the meta-d' framework allows us to conduct comparisons along three axes: comparing an LLM to optimality, comparing different LLMs on a given task, and comparing the same LLM across different tasks. On the other hand, SDT allows us to assess whether LLMs become more conservative when risks are high.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用meta-d'框架和信号检测理论作为评估AI系统元认知能力的黄金标准，并通过在三个大语言模型上的实验验证其实际效用。
AI.motivation: 随着AI系统越来越多地集成到决策流程中，管理不确定性越来越依赖于这些系统的元认知能力。因此，需要采用稳健的方法来测量AI的元认知能力，特别是其评估自身决策可靠性和调节决策的能力。
AI.method: 提出采用meta-d'框架或其无模型替代方案作为评估AI元认知敏感性的黄金标准，并利用信号检测理论测量AI基于不确定性和风险自发调节决策的能力。通过两个系列实验在三个大语言模型上进行验证：第一个实验要求LLMs进行主要判断后给出置信度评级；第二个实验只要求主要判断，同时操纵与响应相关的风险。
AI.result: 应用meta-d'框架可以在三个维度进行比较：将LLM与最优性比较、在不同LLM之间比较、在同一LLM的不同任务间比较。信号检测理论可以评估LLMs在高风险情况下是否变得更加保守。
AI.conclusion: meta-d'框架和信号检测理论为评估AI系统的元认知能力提供了稳健的方法论框架，能够有效测量AI的元认知敏感性和基于风险的决策调节能力，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: ENEIDE: A High Quality Silver Standard Dataset for Named Entity Recognition and Linking in Historical Italian
summary: This paper introduces ENEIDE (Extracting Named Entities from Italian Digital Editions), a silver standard dataset for Named Entity Recognition and Linking (NERL) in historical Italian texts. The corpus comprises 2,111 documents with over 8,000 entity annotations semi-automatically extracted from two scholarly digital editions: Digital Zibaldone, the philosophical diary of the Italian poet Giacomo Leopardi (1798--1837), and Aldo Moro Digitale, the complete works of the Italian politician Aldo Moro (1916--1978). Annotations cover multiple entity types (person, location, organization, literary work) linked to Wikidata identifiers, including NIL entities that cannot be mapped to the knowledge graph. To the best of our knowledge, ENEIDE represents the first multi-domain, publicly available NERL dataset for historical Italian with training, development, and test splits. We present a methodology for semi-automatic annotations extraction from manually curated scholarly digital editions, including quality control and annotation enhancement procedures. Baseline experiments using state-of-the-art models demonstrate the dataset's challenge for NERL and the gap between zero-shot approaches and fine-tuned models. The dataset's diachronic coverage spanning two centuries makes it particularly suitable for temporal entity disambiguation and cross-domain evaluation. ENEIDE is released under a CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license.

AI.tldr: ENEIDE是首个面向历史意大利文本的多领域公开NERL数据集，包含2111份文档和8000多个实体标注，涵盖人物、地点、组织、文学作品等类型，并链接到Wikidata标识符。
AI.motivation: 填补历史意大利文本命名实体识别与链接领域缺乏公开多领域数据集的空白，为研究历史文本的实体分析提供资源支持。
AI.method: 从两个学术数字版本（Digital Zibaldone和Aldo Moro Digitale）中半自动提取实体标注，包括质量控制和标注增强程序，涵盖训练、开发和测试集划分。
AI.result: 创建了包含2111份文档、8000多个实体标注的数据集，涵盖两个世纪的时间跨度，基线实验显示该数据集对NERL任务具有挑战性，零样本方法与微调模型之间存在明显差距。
AI.conclusion: ENEIDE是首个面向历史意大利文本的公开多领域NERL数据集，适用于时间实体消歧和跨领域评估，为历史文本分析研究提供了重要资源。

title: MaskAdapt: Learning Flexible Motion Adaptation via Mask-Invariant Prior for Physics-Based Characters
summary: We present MaskAdapt, a framework for flexible motion adaptation in physics-based humanoid control. The framework follows a two-stage residual learning paradigm. In the first stage, we train a mask-invariant base policy using stochastic body-part masking and a regularization term that enforces consistent action distributions across masking conditions. This yields a robust motion prior that remains stable under missing observations, anticipating later adaptation in those regions. In the second stage, a residual policy is trained atop the frozen base controller to modify only the targeted body parts while preserving the original behaviors elsewhere. We demonstrate the versatility of this design through two applications: (i) motion composition, where varying masks enable multi-part adaptation within a single sequence, and (ii) text-driven partial goal tracking, where designated body parts follow kinematic targets provided by a pre-trained text-conditioned autoregressive motion generator. Through experiments, MaskAdapt demonstrates strong robustness and adaptability, producing diverse behaviors under masked observations and delivering superior targeted motion adaptation compared to prior work.

AI.tldr: MaskAdapt是一个用于物理人形控制中灵活运动适应的框架，采用两阶段残差学习范式，通过身体部位掩码实现目标部位的运动修改，同时保持其他部位的原始行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的人形控制方法在针对特定身体部位进行运动适应时缺乏灵活性，难以在修改目标部位的同时保持其他部位的自然行为，需要一种能够实现局部运动适应的框架。
AI.method: 采用两阶段残差学习：第一阶段训练掩码不变的基础策略，通过随机身体部位掩码和正则化项确保不同掩码条件下的动作分布一致；第二阶段在冻结的基础控制器上训练残差策略，仅修改目标身体部位。
AI.result: MaskAdapt展示了强大的鲁棒性和适应性，在掩码观测下产生多样行为，在目标运动适应方面优于先前工作，成功实现了运动组合和文本驱动的部分目标跟踪。
AI.conclusion: MaskAdapt框架通过两阶段残差学习和身体部位掩码机制，实现了灵活且鲁棒的运动适应，为物理人形控制中的局部运动修改提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Reinforced Reasoning for End-to-End Retrosynthetic Planning
summary: Retrosynthetic planning is a fundamental task in organic chemistry, yet remains challenging due to its combinatorial complexity. To address this, conventional approaches typically rely on hybrid frameworks that combine single-step predictions with external search heuristics, inevitably fracturing the logical coherence between local molecular transformations and global planning objectives. To bridge this gap and embed sophisticated strategic foresight directly into the model's chemical reasoning, we introduce ReTriP, an end-to-end generative framework that reformulates retrosynthesis as a direct Chain-of-Thought reasoning task. We establish a path-coherent molecular representation and employ a progressive training curriculum that transitions from reasoning distillation to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, effectively aligning stepwise generation with practical route utility. Empirical evaluation on RetroBench demonstrates that ReTriP achieves state-of-the-art performance, exhibiting superior robustness in long-horizon planning compared to hybrid baselines.

AI.tldr: ReTriP是一个端到端的生成框架，将逆合成规划重新表述为直接的思维链推理任务，通过路径一致的分子表示和渐进式训练课程，在长程规划中实现最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统逆合成规划方法依赖单步预测与外部搜索启发式的混合框架，这不可避免地破坏了局部分子转化与全局规划目标之间的逻辑连贯性。需要将复杂的战略预见直接嵌入模型的化学推理中。
AI.method: 引入ReTriP端到端生成框架，将逆合成重新表述为思维链推理任务；建立路径一致的分子表示；采用渐进式训练课程，从推理蒸馏过渡到具有可验证奖励的强化学习，有效对齐逐步生成与实际路线效用。
AI.result: 在RetroBench上的实证评估表明，ReTriP实现了最先进的性能，与混合基线相比，在长程规划中表现出卓越的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: ReTriP通过将逆合成规划重新表述为端到端的思维链推理任务，成功地将战略预见嵌入化学推理，解决了传统混合框架中局部与全局规划脱节的问题，在长程规划中展现出优越性能。

title: SNEAK: Evaluating Strategic Communication and Information Leakage in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent settings where communication must balance informativeness and secrecy. In such settings, an agent may need to signal information to collaborators while preventing an adversary from inferring sensitive details. However, existing LLM benchmarks primarily evaluate capabilities such as reasoning, factual knowledge, or instruction following, and do not directly measure strategic communication under asymmetric information. We introduce SNEAK (Secret-aware Natural language Evaluation for Adversarial Knowledge), a benchmark for evaluating selective information sharing in language models. In SNEAK, a model is given a semantic category, a candidate set of words, and a secret word, and must generate a message that indicates knowledge of the secret without revealing it too clearly. We evaluate generated messages using two simulated agents with different information states: an ally, who knows the secret and must identify the intended message, and a chameleon, who does not know the secret and attempts to infer it from the message. This yields two complementary metrics: utility, measuring how well the message communicates to collaborators, and leakage, measuring how much information it reveals to an adversary. Using this framework, we analyze the trade-off between informativeness and secrecy in modern language models and show that strategic communication under asymmetric information remains a challenging capability for current systems. Notably, human participants outperform all evaluated models by a large margin, achieving up to four times higher scores.

AI.tldr: SNEAK是一个评估语言模型在非对称信息下选择性信息共享能力的基准测试，通过模拟盟友和变色龙两种代理来测量信息效用和泄露程度，发现人类表现远优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM基准主要评估推理、事实知识和指令遵循能力，缺乏对非对称信息下战略通信能力的直接测量。在多智能体环境中，需要在信息性和保密性之间取得平衡，向合作者传递信息同时防止对手推断敏感细节。
AI.method: 提出SNEAK基准：给定语义类别、候选词集和秘密词，模型必须生成能表明知道秘密但不过于明显泄露的消息。通过两种模拟代理评估：盟友（知道秘密，需识别意图）和变色龙（不知道秘密，尝试从消息推断）。产生两个互补指标：效用（向合作者传达效果）和泄露（向对手泄露信息程度）。
AI.result: 现代语言模型在信息性和保密性之间的权衡分析表明，非对称信息下的战略通信对当前系统仍具挑战性。人类参与者显著优于所有评估模型，得分高达四倍。
AI.conclusion: SNEAK基准填补了LLM评估在战略通信能力方面的空白，揭示了当前模型在选择性信息共享方面的局限性，为未来模型开发提供了重要评估工具。

title: PRISM: A Multi-View Multi-Capability Retail Video Dataset for Embodied Vision-Language Models
summary: A critical gap exists between the general-purpose visual understanding of state-of-the-art physical AI models and the specialized perceptual demands of structured real-world deployment environments. We present PRISM, a 270K-sample multi-view video supervised fine-tuning (SFT) corpus for embodied vision-language-models (VLMs) in real-world retail environments. PRISM is motivated by a simple observation - physical AI systems fail not because of poor visual recognition, but because they do not understand space, physical dynamics and embodied action well enough to operate reliably in the world. To this end, PRISM is grounded in a novel three-dimensional knowledge ontology that spans spatial knowledge, temporal and physical knowledge, and embodied action knowledge. It covers 20+ capability probes across four evaluation dimensions - Embodied Reasoning (ER), Common Sense (CS), Spatial Perception (SP), and Intuitive Physics (IP), and to our knowledge, PRISM is the first dataset to instantiate all three knowledge dimensions within a single real-world deployment domain. The corpus captures data from egocentric, exocentric and 360° viewpoints across five supermarket locations and includes open-ended, chain-of-thought, and multiple-choice supervision. At 4 fps, PRISM spans approximately 11.8M video frames and approximately 730M tokens, placing it among the largest domain-specific video SFT corpora. Fine-tuning on PRISM reduces the error rate across all 20+ probes by 66.6% over the pre-trained baseline, with significant gains in embodied action understanding where the accuracy improves by 36.4%. Our results suggest that ontology-structured, domain specific SFT can meaningfully strengthen embodied VLMs for real-world settings. The PRISM dataset and more details are available at https://dreamvu.ai/prism

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个包含27万样本的多视角视频监督微调数据集，专门用于增强具身视觉语言模型在零售环境中的感知能力，通过三维知识本体显著提升模型在空间、物理和动作理解方面的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有物理AI模型在通用视觉理解方面表现良好，但在结构化真实世界部署环境中的专门感知需求存在关键差距。模型失败不是因为视觉识别能力差，而是因为对空间、物理动态和具身动作的理解不足以在现实世界中可靠操作。
AI.method: 创建PRISM数据集，包含27万个多视角视频样本，基于三维知识本体（空间知识、时空物理知识、具身动作知识）。数据从第一人称、第三人称和360度视角采集于五个超市环境，包含开放式、思维链和多选监督。数据集包含约1180万视频帧和7.3亿标记。
AI.result: 在PRISM上微调后，所有20多个能力探针的错误率比预训练基线降低了66.6%，其中具身动作理解的准确率提高了36.4%。这表明基于本体结构化的领域特定微调能显著增强具身视觉语言模型在真实环境中的能力。
AI.conclusion: 本体结构化的领域特定监督微调能够有效增强具身视觉语言模型在真实世界环境中的能力，PRISM数据集为零售环境中的物理AI系统提供了重要的训练资源。

title: Spontaneous Functional Differentiation in Large Language Models: A Brain-Like Intelligence Economy
summary: The evolution of intelligence in artificial systems provides a unique opportunity to identify universal computational principles. Here we show that large language models spontaneously develop synergistic cores where information integration exceeds individual parts remarkably similar to the human brain. Using Integrated Information Decomposition across multiple architectures we find that middle layers exhibit synergistic processing while early and late layers rely on redundancy. This organization is dynamic and emerges as a physical phase transition as task difficulty increases. Crucially ablating synergistic components causes catastrophic performance loss confirming their role as the physical entity of abstract reasoning and bridging artificial and biological intelligence.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型自发形成协同核心，其信息整合能力超过各部分之和，与人类大脑类似。通过信息整合分解分析发现中间层呈现协同处理，而早期和晚期层依赖冗余，这种组织是动态的，随任务难度增加呈现物理相变。
AI.motivation: 研究人工智能系统智能演化为识别通用计算原理提供了独特机会。作者希望探索人工系统是否自发发展出类似人类大脑的协同信息处理结构，从而连接人工与生物智能。
AI.method: 使用集成信息分解（Integrated Information Decomposition）分析多种架构的大型语言模型，识别不同层的信息处理模式。通过消融实验验证协同组件的作用。
AI.result: 发现中间层表现出协同处理，而早期和晚期层依赖冗余处理。这种组织是动态的，随任务难度增加呈现物理相变。消融协同组件会导致灾难性性能损失，证实它们是抽象推理的物理实体。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型自发形成类似人类大脑的协同核心结构，这为理解智能的通用计算原理提供了桥梁，表明人工与生物智能在信息处理结构上存在深刻相似性。

title: Towards Empowering Consumers through Sentence-level Readability Scoring in German ESG Reports
comment: accepted to NLP4Ecology workshop at LREC 2026
summary: With the ever-growing urgency of sustainability in the economy and society, and the massive stream of information that comes with it, consumers need reliable access to that information. To address this need, companies began publishing so called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) reports, both voluntarily and forced by law. To serve the public, these reports must be addressed not only to financial experts but also to non-expert audiences. But are they written clearly enough? In this work, we extend an existing sentence-level dataset of German ESG reports with crowdsourced readability annotations. We find that, in general, native speakers perceive sentences in ESG reports as easy to read, but also that readability is subjective. We apply various readability scoring methods and evaluate them regarding their prediction error and correlation with human rankings. Our analysis shows that, while LLM prompting has potential for distinguishing clear from hard-to-read sentences, a small finetuned transformer predicts human readability with the lowest error. Averaging predictions of multiple models can slightly improve the performance at the cost of slower inference.

AI.tldr: 该研究扩展了德语ESG报告的可读性标注数据集，发现母语者通常认为ESG报告句子易读但主观性强，评估了多种可读性评分方法，发现微调的小型transformer模型预测人类可读性误差最低。
AI.motivation: 随着可持续发展在经济和社会中的重要性日益增长，消费者需要可靠获取相关信息。公司开始发布ESG报告，但这些报告不仅面向金融专家，也需要面向非专业受众，因此需要评估其可读性是否足够清晰。
AI.method: 扩展现有的德语ESG报告句子级数据集，通过众包添加可读性标注。应用多种可读性评分方法，评估其预测误差和与人类排名的相关性，包括LLM提示方法和微调transformer模型。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）母语者通常认为ESG报告句子易读，但可读性具有主观性；2）LLM提示在区分清晰与难读句子方面有潜力；3）微调的小型transformer模型预测人类可读性误差最低；4）多模型平均预测可略微提升性能，但会降低推理速度。
AI.conclusion: ESG报告整体可读性较好但存在主观差异，微调的小型transformer模型是预测人类可读性的有效方法，为评估和改进ESG报告的可读性提供了实用工具。

title: MELT: Improve Composed Image Retrieval via the Modification Frequentation-Rarity Balance Network
summary: Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) uses a reference image and a modification text as a query to retrieve a target image satisfying the requirement of ``modifying the reference image according to the text instructions''. However, existing CIR methods face two limitations: (1) frequency bias leading to ``Rare Sample Neglect'', and (2) susceptibility of similarity scores to interference from hard negative samples and noise. To address these limitations, we confront two key challenges: asymmetric rare semantic localization and robust similarity estimation under hard negative samples. To solve these challenges, we propose the Modification frEquentation-rarity baLance neTwork MELT. MELT assigns increased attention to rare modification semantics in multimodal contexts while applying diffusion-based denoising to hard negative samples with high similarity scores, enhancing multimodal fusion and matching. Extensive experiments on two CIR benchmarks validate the superior performance of MELT. Codes are available at https://github.com/luckylittlezhi/MELT.

AI.tldr: MELT网络通过关注罕见修改语义和扩散去噪处理硬负样本，解决了组合图像检索中的频率偏差和相似度干扰问题
AI.motivation: 现有组合图像检索方法面临两个主要限制：1）频率偏差导致"罕见样本忽视"问题；2）相似度分数容易受到硬负样本和噪声的干扰
AI.method: 提出MELT网络，通过不对称罕见语义定位增强对罕见修改语义的关注，同时使用基于扩散的去噪方法处理高相似度硬负样本，从而提升多模态融合和匹配能力
AI.result: 在两个组合图像检索基准测试上的广泛实验验证了MELT的优越性能
AI.conclusion: MELT通过解决频率偏差和硬负样本干扰问题，显著提升了组合图像检索的性能，代码已开源

title: CausalPulse: An Industrial-Grade Neurosymbolic Multi-Agent Copilot for Causal Diagnostics in Smart Manufacturing
comment: 10 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables, Accepted at AAAI-MAKE 2026 (AAAI Spring Symposium on Machine Learning and Knowledge Engineering for Knowledge-Grounded Semantic Agents)
summary: Modern manufacturing environments demand real-time, trustworthy, and interpretable root-cause insights to sustain productivity and quality. Traditional analytics pipelines often treat anomaly detection, causal inference, and root-cause analysis as isolated stages, limiting scalability and explainability. In this work, we present CausalPulse, an industry-grade multi-agent copilot that automates causal diagnostics in smart manufacturing. It unifies anomaly detection, causal discovery, and reasoning through a neurosymbolic architecture built on standardized agentic protocols. CausalPulse is being deployed in a Robert Bosch manufacturing plant, integrating seamlessly with existing monitoring workflows and supporting real-time operation at production scale. Evaluations on both public (Future Factories) and proprietary (Planar Sensor Element) datasets show high reliability, achieving overall success rates of 98.0% and 98.73%. Per-criterion success rates reached 98.75% for planning and tool use, 97.3% for self-reflection, and 99.2% for collaboration. Runtime experiments report end-to-end latency of 50-60s per diagnostic workflow with near-linear scalability (R^2=0.97), confirming real-time readiness. Comparison with existing industrial copilots highlights distinct advantages in modularity, extensibility, and deployment maturity. These results demonstrate how CausalPulse's modular, human-in-the-loop design enables reliable, interpretable, and production-ready automation for next-generation manufacturing.

AI.tldr: CausalPulse是一个用于智能制造因果诊断的多智能体协同系统，通过神经符号架构统一异常检测、因果发现和推理，在真实工厂部署中表现出高可靠性和实时性。
AI.motivation: 现代制造环境需要实时、可信、可解释的根本原因分析来维持生产力和质量。传统分析流程通常将异常检测、因果推断和根本原因分析作为孤立阶段处理，限制了可扩展性和可解释性。
AI.method: 开发了CausalPulse多智能体协同系统，采用基于标准化智能体协议的神经符号架构，统一异常检测、因果发现和推理。系统正在博世制造工厂部署，与现有监控工作流无缝集成。
AI.result: 在公共数据集（Future Factories）和专有数据集（Planar Sensor Element）上分别达到98.0%和98.73%的总体成功率。各标准成功率：规划和工具使用98.75%、自我反思97.3%、协作99.2%。端到端延迟50-60秒，具有近线性可扩展性（R^2=0.97）。
AI.conclusion: CausalPulse的模块化、人在回路设计为下一代制造提供了可靠、可解释且生产就绪的自动化解决方案，在模块化、可扩展性和部署成熟度方面优于现有工业协同系统。

title: GazeCLIP: Gaze-Guided CLIP with Adaptive-Enhanced Fine-Grained Language Prompt for Deepfake Attribution and Detection
summary: Current deepfake attribution or deepfake detection works tend to exhibit poor generalization to novel generative methods due to the limited exploration in visual modalities alone. They tend to assess the attribution or detection performance of models on unseen advanced generators, coarsely, and fail to consider the synergy of the two tasks. To this end, we propose a novel gaze-guided CLIP with adaptive-enhanced fine-grained language prompts for fine-grained deepfake attribution and detection (DFAD). Specifically, we conduct a novel and fine-grained benchmark to evaluate the DFAD performance of networks on novel generators like diffusion and flow models. Additionally, we introduce a gaze-aware model based on CLIP, which is devised to enhance the generalization to unseen face forgery attacks. Built upon the novel observation that there are significant distribution differences between pristine and forged gaze vectors, and the preservation of the target gaze in facial images generated by GAN and diffusion varies significantly, we design a visual perception encoder to employ the inherent gaze differences to mine global forgery embeddings across appearance and gaze domains. We propose a gaze-aware image encoder (GIE) that fuses forgery gaze prompts extracted via a gaze encoder with common forged image embeddings to capture general attribution patterns, allowing features to be transformed into a more stable and common DFAD feature space. We build a language refinement encoder (LRE) to generate dynamically enhanced language embeddings via an adaptive-enhanced word selector for precise vision-language matching. Extensive experiments on our benchmark show that our model outperforms the state-of-the-art by 6.56% ACC and 5.32% AUC in average performance under the attribution and detection settings, respectively. Codes will be available on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出基于CLIP的注视引导深度伪造检测与溯源框架，通过注视向量差异和自适应语言提示增强对新型生成方法的泛化能力
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测和溯源方法在视觉模态上探索有限，对新型生成方法（如扩散模型）泛化能力差，且未充分利用检测与溯源任务的协同效应
AI.method: 1) 建立细粒度基准评估模型在扩散和流模型等新型生成器上的性能；2) 提出注视感知CLIP模型，利用真实与伪造注视向量的分布差异；3) 设计注视感知图像编码器融合注视提示和图像嵌入；4) 构建语言精炼编码器生成自适应增强的语言嵌入
AI.result: 在提出的基准测试中，模型在溯源和检测设置下的平均性能分别超过现有最佳方法6.56% ACC和5.32% AUC
AI.conclusion: 注视引导的视觉-语言多模态方法能有效提升深度伪造检测与溯源的泛化能力，特别是对新型生成方法，为相关领域提供了新的研究方向

title: Tracking vs. Deciding: The Dual-Capability Bottleneck in Searchless Chess Transformers
summary:
A human-like chess engine should mimic the style, errors, and consistency of a strong human player rather than maximize playing strength. We show that training from move sequences alone forces a model to learn two capabilities: state tracking, which reconstructs the board from move history, and decision quality, which selects good moves from that reconstructed state. These impose contradictory data requirements: low-rated games provide the diversity needed for tracking, while high-rated games provide the quality signal for decision learning. Removing low-rated data degrades performance.
  We formalize this tension as a dual-capability bottleneck, P <= min(T,Q), where overall performance is limited by the weaker capability. Guided by this view, we scale the model from 28M to 120M parameters to improve tracking, then introduce Elo-weighted training to improve decisions while preserving diversity. A 2 x 2 factorial ablation shows that scaling improves tracking, weighting improves decisions, and their combination is superadditive. Linear weighting works best, while overly aggressive weighting harms tracking despite lower validation loss. We also introduce a coverage-decay formula, t* = log(N/kcrit)/log b, as a reliability horizon for intra-game degeneration risk.
  Our final 120M-parameter model, without search, reached Lichess bullet 2570 over 253 rated games. On human move prediction it achieves 55.2% Top-1 accuracy, exceeding Maia-2 rapid and Maia-2 blitz. Unlike position-based methods, sequence input naturally encodes full game history, enabling history-dependent decisions that single-position models cannot exhibit.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个类人国际象棋引擎，通过序列训练学习状态追踪和决策质量两种能力，使用参数扩展和Elo加权训练解决两种能力的数据需求矛盾，最终模型在无搜索情况下达到Lichess子弹棋2570等级分。
AI.motivation: 开发一个类人的国际象棋引擎，模仿人类棋手的风格、错误和一致性，而不是单纯追求最大化的棋力强度。现有方法通常基于单个棋盘位置进行训练，无法捕捉完整对局历史中的决策模式。
AI.method: 1. 使用纯走子序列训练模型，迫使模型学习状态追踪（从走子历史重建棋盘）和决策质量（从重建状态选择好棋）两种能力；2. 提出双能力瓶颈理论P ≤ min(T,Q)；3. 通过参数扩展（28M到120M）改进状态追踪能力；4. 引入Elo加权训练改进决策质量同时保持多样性；5. 使用2×2因子消融实验验证方法有效性；6. 提出覆盖衰减公式t* = log(N/kcrit)/log b作为可靠性边界。
AI.result: 1. 最终120M参数模型在无搜索情况下达到Lichess子弹棋2570等级分（253局对局）；2. 人类走子预测Top-1准确率达到55.2%，超过Maia-2快速棋和Maia-2闪电棋模型；3. 参数扩展和Elo加权训练的组合效果具有超加性；4. 线性加权效果最佳，过于激进的加权会损害状态追踪能力；5. 序列输入自然编码完整对局历史，使模型能够做出依赖历史的决策。
AI.conclusion: 通过序列训练可以开发出类人的国际象棋引擎，成功解决了状态追踪和决策质量两种能力的数据需求矛盾。模型能够模仿人类棋手的风格和一致性，在无搜索情况下达到高水平棋力，并在人类走子预测方面超越现有位置基准模型。序列输入方法为捕捉人类棋手的完整决策模式提供了新途径。

title: Rewrite the News: Tracing Editorial Reuse Across News Agencies
comment: The paper is accepted to SoCon-NLPSI 2026 : Social Context (SoCon) and Integrating NLP and Psychology to Study Social Interactions (NLPSI) workshop co-located with LREC 2026
summary: This paper investigates sentence-level text reuse in multilingual journalism, analyzing where reused content occurs within articles. We present a weakly supervised method for detecting sentence-level cross-lingual reuse without requiring full translations, designed to support automated pre-selection to reduce information overload for journalists (Holyst et al., 2024). The study compares English-language articles from the Slovenian Press Agency (STA) with reports from 15 foreign agencies (FA) in seven languages, using publication timestamps to retain the earliest likely foreign source for each reused sentence. We analyze 1,037 STA and 237,551 FA articles from two time windows (October 7-November 2, 2023; February 1-28, 2025) and identify 1,087 aligned sentence pairs after filtering to the earliest sources. Reuse occurs in 52% of STA articles and 1.6% of FA articles and is predominantly non-literal, involving paraphrase and compositional reuse from multiple sources. Reused content tends to appear in the middle and end of English articles, while leads are more often original, indicating that simple lexical matching overlooks substantial editorial reuse. Compared with prior work focused on monolingual overlap, we (i) detect reuse across languages without requiring full translation, (ii) use publication timing to identify likely sources, and (iii) analyze where reused material is situated within articles. Dataset and code: https://github.com/kunturs/lrec2026-rewrite-news.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种弱监督方法，用于检测多语言新闻报道中的句子级跨语言文本重用，无需完整翻译，通过发布时间戳识别可能的来源，并分析重用内容在文章中的位置分布。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是帮助记者应对信息过载问题，通过自动化预选减少需要处理的外国新闻内容。现有方法主要关注单语重叠，难以检测跨语言的改写和组合式重用。
AI.method: 采用弱监督方法检测句子级跨语言文本重用，无需完整翻译。比较斯洛文尼亚新闻社的英文文章与15个外国机构的7种语言报道，利用发布时间戳保留每个重用句子的最早可能来源。分析两个时间段（2023年10-11月和2025年2月）的1037篇STA文章和237,551篇FA文章。
AI.result: 识别出1087个对齐句子对，52%的STA文章和1.6%的FA文章存在重用现象。重用主要是非字面性的，涉及改写和来自多个来源的组合式重用。重用内容倾向于出现在英文文章的中间和结尾部分，而开头部分更多是原创内容。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明简单的词汇匹配会忽略大量编辑性重用。相比先前专注于单语重叠的研究，本工作实现了跨语言重用检测而无需完整翻译，利用发布时间识别来源，并分析了重用材料在文章中的位置分布。

title: Reasoning-Driven Synthetic Data Generation and Evaluation
summary: Although many AI applications of interest require specialized multi-modal models, relevant data to train such models is inherently scarce or inaccessible. Filling these gaps with human annotators is prohibitively expensive, error-prone, and time-consuming, leading model builders to increasingly consider synthetic data as a scalable alternative. However, existing synthetic data generation methods often rely on manual prompts, evolutionary algorithms, or extensive seed data from the target distribution - limiting their scalability, explainability, and control. In this paper, we introduce Simula: a novel reasoning-driven framework for data generation and evaluation. It employs a seedless, agentic approach to generate synthetic datasets at scale, allowing users to define desired dataset characteristics through an explainable and controllable process that enables fine-grained resource allocation. We show the efficacy of our approach on a variety of datasets, rigorously testing both intrinsic and downstream properties. Our work (1) offers guidelines for synthetic data mechanism design, (2) provides insights into generating and evaluating synthetic data at scale, and (3) unlocks new opportunities for developing and deploying AI in domains where data scarcity or privacy concerns are paramount.

AI.tldr: Simula是一个无种子、基于智能体的可扩展框架，通过可解释和可控的过程生成合成数据，解决多模态AI训练中的数据稀缺问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态AI模型需要大量专业数据，但现实数据稀缺或难以获取。人工标注成本高、易出错且耗时，现有合成数据生成方法依赖人工提示、进化算法或大量种子数据，限制了可扩展性、可解释性和控制性。
AI.method: 提出Simula框架，采用无种子、智能体驱动的方法，通过可解释和可控的过程生成大规模合成数据集，允许用户定义数据集特征并进行细粒度资源分配。
AI.result: 在多种数据集上验证了方法的有效性，严格测试了内在和下游特性，为合成数据机制设计提供了指导，并为大规模生成和评估合成数据提供了见解。
AI.conclusion: Simula框架为数据稀缺或隐私敏感领域的AI开发和部署开辟了新机会，提供了一种可扩展、可解释且可控的合成数据生成解决方案。

title: Structural Feature Engineering for Generative Engine Optimization: How Content Structure Shapes Citation Behavior
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. This paper proposes GEO-SFE, a structural feature engineering framework for generative engine optimization
summary:
The proliferation of AI-powered search engines has shifted information discovery from traditional link-based retrieval to direct answer generation with selective source citation, creating new challenges for content visibility. While existing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) approaches focus primarily on semantic content modification, the role of structural features in influencing citation behavior remains underexplored.
  In this paper, we propose GEO-SFE, a systematic framework for structural feature engineering in generative engine optimization. Our approach decomposes content structure into three hierarchical levels: macro-structure (document architecture), meso-structure (information chunking), and micro-structure (visual emphasis), and models their impact on citation probability across different generative engine architectures. We develop architecture-aware optimization strategies and predictive models that preserve semantic integrity while improving structural effectiveness.
  Experimental evaluation across six mainstream generative engines demonstrates consistent improvements in citation rate (17.3 percent) and subjective quality (18.5 percent), validating the effectiveness and generalizability of the proposed framework. This work establishes structural optimization as a foundational component of GEO, providing a data-driven methodology for enhancing content visibility in LLM-powered information ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GEO-SFE框架，通过结构特征工程优化生成式搜索引擎的引用行为，将内容结构分解为宏观、中观和微观三个层次，在不同生成引擎架构下提升引用率和内容质量。
AI.motivation: AI驱动的搜索引擎从传统链接检索转向直接答案生成和选择性来源引用，这给内容可见性带来了新挑战。现有的生成式引擎优化方法主要关注语义内容修改，而结构特征对引用行为的影响尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 提出GEO-SFE框架，将内容结构分解为三个层次：宏观结构（文档架构）、中观结构（信息分块）和微观结构（视觉强调）。开发架构感知的优化策略和预测模型，在保持语义完整性的同时提高结构有效性。
AI.result: 在六个主流生成式引擎上的实验评估显示，引用率提升了17.3%，主观质量提升了18.5%，验证了所提框架的有效性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作将结构优化确立为生成式引擎优化的基础组成部分，为增强LLM驱动的信息生态系统中内容可见性提供了数据驱动的方法论。

title: Self-Consistency for LLM-Based Motion Trajectory Generation and Verification
summary: Self-consistency has proven to be an effective technique for improving LLM performance on natural language reasoning tasks in a lightweight, unsupervised manner. In this work, we study how to adapt self-consistency to visual domains. Specifically, we consider the generation and verification of LLM-produced motion graphics trajectories. Given a prompt (e.g., "Move the circle in a spiral path"), we first sample diverse motion trajectories from an LLM, and then identify groups of consistent trajectories via clustering. Our key insight is to model the family of shapes associated with a prompt as a prototype trajectory paired with a group of geometric transformations (e.g., rigid, similarity, and affine). Two trajectories can then be considered consistent if one can be transformed into the other under the warps allowable by the transformation group. We propose an algorithm that automatically recovers a shape family, using hierarchical relationships between a set of candidate transformation groups. Our approach improves the accuracy of LLM-based trajectory generation by 4-6%. We further extend our method to support verification, observing 11% precision gains over VLM baselines. Our code and dataset are available at https://majiaju.io/trajectory-self-consistency .

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种将自一致性技术从自然语言领域扩展到视觉领域的方法，特别针对LLM生成的运动图形轨迹，通过聚类和几何变换组识别一致性轨迹，提高了轨迹生成的准确性。
AI.motivation: 自一致性技术已在自然语言推理任务中证明有效，但如何将其适应到视觉领域仍待探索。本研究旨在将自一致性应用于LLM生成的运动图形轨迹，通过验证和一致性检查来提高轨迹生成的质量。
AI.method: 首先从LLM中采样多样化的运动轨迹，然后通过聚类识别一致性轨迹组。核心洞察是将提示对应的形状族建模为原型轨迹加上一组几何变换（如刚性、相似性、仿射变换）。两个轨迹如果可以通过允许的变换相互转换，则视为一致。提出了一种算法，利用候选变换组之间的层次关系自动恢复形状族。
AI.result: 该方法将基于LLM的轨迹生成准确性提高了4-6%。在验证任务中，相比VLM基线获得了11%的精度提升。代码和数据集已公开。
AI.conclusion: 成功将自一致性技术扩展到视觉领域，通过几何变换组建模形状族并识别一致性轨迹，显著提高了LLM生成运动轨迹的准确性和验证精度。

title: Owl-AuraID 1.0: An Intelligent System for Autonomous Scientific Instrumentation and Scientific Data Analysis
summary: Scientific discovery increasingly depends on high-throughput characterization, yet automation is hindered by proprietary GUIs and the limited generalizability of existing API-based systems. We present Owl-AuraID, a software-hardware collaborative embodied agent system that adopts a GUI-native paradigm to operate instruments through the same interfaces as human experts. Its skill-centric framework integrates Type-1 (GUI operation) and Type-2 (data analysis) skills into end-to-end workflows, connecting physical sample handling with scientific interpretation. Owl-AuraID demonstrates broad coverage across ten categories of precision instruments and diverse workflows, including multimodal spectral analysis, microscopic imaging, and crystallographic analysis, supporting modalities such as FTIR, NMR, AFM, and TGA. Overall, Owl-AuraID provides a practical, extensible foundation for autonomous laboratories and illustrates a path toward evolving laboratory intelligence through reusable operational and analytical skills. The code are available at https://github.com/OpenOwlab/AuraID.

AI.tldr: Owl-AuraID是一个软硬件协同的具身代理系统，采用GUI原生范式通过人类专家使用的相同界面操作仪器，实现高通量科学发现的自动化。
AI.motivation: 科学发现越来越依赖高通量表征，但自动化受到专有GUI和现有API系统有限通用性的阻碍。需要一种更通用的方法来实现仪器操作的自动化。
AI.method: 采用GUI原生范式，通过技能中心框架集成Type-1（GUI操作）和Type-2（数据分析）技能，形成端到端工作流，连接物理样品处理与科学解释。
AI.result: Owl-AuraID覆盖了十类精密仪器和多样化工作流，包括多模态光谱分析、显微成像和晶体学分析，支持FTIR、NMR、AFM、TGA等多种模态。
AI.conclusion: Owl-AuraID为自主实验室提供了实用、可扩展的基础，并通过可重复使用的操作和分析技能展示了实验室智能演化的路径。

title: Enhancing Structural Mapping with LLM-derived Abstractions for Analogical Reasoning in Narratives
summary: Analogical reasoning is a key driver of human generalization in problem-solving and argumentation. Yet, analogies between narrative structures remain challenging for machines. Cognitive engines for structural mapping are not directly applicable, as they assume pre-extracted entities, whereas LLMs' performance is sensitive to prompt format and the degree of surface similarity between narratives. This gap motivates a key question: What is the impact of enhancing structural mapping with LLM-derived abstractions on their analogical reasoning ability in narratives? To that end, we propose a modular framework named YARN (Yielding Abstractions for Reasoning in Narratives), which uses LLMs to decompose narratives into units, abstract these units, and then passes them to a mapping component that aligns elements across stories to perform analogical reasoning. We define and operationalize four levels of abstraction that capture both the general meaning of units and their roles in the story, grounded in prior work on framing. Our experiments reveal that abstractions consistently improve model performance, resulting in competitive or better performance than end-to-end LLM baselines. Closer error analysis reveals the remaining challenges in abstraction at the right level, in incorporating implicit causality, and an emerging categorization of analogical patterns in narratives. YARN enables systematic variation of experimental settings to analyze component contributions, and to support future work, we make the code for YARN openly available.

AI.tldr: YARN框架通过LLM生成叙事抽象来增强类比推理，相比端到端LLM基线表现更优
AI.motivation: 叙事结构间的类比推理对机器具有挑战性，现有认知引擎需要预提取实体，而LLM性能受提示格式和表面相似性影响。需要研究通过LLM生成的抽象来增强结构映射对叙事类比推理能力的影响。
AI.method: 提出模块化框架YARN：使用LLM将叙事分解为单元，抽象这些单元，然后传递给映射组件进行跨故事元素对齐以执行类比推理。定义了四个抽象层级，捕捉单元的一般含义及其在故事中的角色。
AI.result: 抽象一致地提高了模型性能，达到或优于端到端LLM基线。错误分析揭示了在适当抽象层级、整合隐式因果关系以及叙事类比模式分类方面的挑战。
AI.conclusion: YARN框架支持系统性地分析组件贡献，为未来研究提供了开放代码。抽象增强的结构映射能有效提升叙事类比推理能力。

title: HSFM: Hard-Set-Guided Feature-Space Meta-Learning for Robust Classification under Spurious Correlations
summary: Deep neural networks often rely on spurious features to make predictions, which makes them brittle under distribution shift and on samples where the spurious correlation does not hold (e.g., minority-group examples). Recent studies have shown that, even in such settings, the feature extractor of an Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM)-trained model can learn rich and informative representations, and that much of the failure may be attributed to the classifier head. In particular, retraining a lightweight head while keeping the backbone frozen can substantially improve performance on shifted distributions and minority groups. Motivated by this observation, we propose a bilevel meta-learning method that performs augmentation directly in feature space to improve spurious correlation handling in the classifier head. Our method learns support-side feature edits such that, after a small number of inner-loop updates on the edited features, the classifier achieves lower loss on hard examples and improved worst-group performance. By operating at the backbone output rather than in pixel space or through end-to-end optimization, the method is highly efficient and stable, requiring only a few minutes of training on a single GPU. We further validate our method with CLIP-based visualizations, showing that the learned feature-space updates induce semantically meaningful shifts aligned with spurious attributes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种双层元学习方法，在特征空间进行数据增强，改善分类器对虚假相关性的处理能力，提高少数群体和分布偏移下的性能
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络常依赖虚假特征进行预测，导致在分布偏移和少数群体样本上表现脆弱。研究发现ERM训练的特征提取器能学习丰富信息表示，问题主要在于分类器头部。重新训练轻量级头部可显著改善性能，但需要更好的方法来增强分类器对虚假相关性的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出双层元学习方法，在特征空间直接进行增强。方法学习支持侧的特征编辑，使得经过少量内环更新后，分类器在困难样本上损失更低、最差群体性能更好。该方法在骨干网络输出端操作，而非像素空间或端到端优化，因此高效稳定。
AI.result: 方法高度高效稳定，仅需单GPU几分钟训练。通过CLIP可视化验证，显示学习的特征空间更新能诱导语义上有意义的偏移，与虚假属性对齐。
AI.conclusion: 通过在特征空间进行元学习增强，能够有效改善分类器对虚假相关性的处理能力，提高模型在分布偏移和少数群体上的鲁棒性，同时保持训练效率。

title: AgentFixer: From Failure Detection to Fix Recommendations in LLM Agentic Systems
summary: We introduce a comprehensive validation framework for LLM-based agentic systems that provides systematic diagnosis and improvement of reliability failures. The framework includes fifteen failure-detection tools and two root-cause analysis modules that jointly uncover weaknesses across input handling, prompt design, and output generation. It integrates lightweight rule-based checks with LLM-as-a-judge assessments to support structured incident detection, classification, and repair. We applied the framework to IBM CUGA, evaluating its performance on the AppWorld and WebArena benchmarks. The analysis revealed recurrent planner misalignments, schema violations, brittle prompt dependencies, and more. Based on these insights, we refined both prompting and coding strategies, maintaining CUGA's benchmark results while enabling mid-sized models such as Llama 4 and Mistral Medium to achieve notable accuracy gains, substantially narrowing the gap with frontier models. Beyond quantitative validation, we conducted an exploratory study that fed the framework's diagnostic outputs and agent description into an LLM for self-reflection and prioritization. This interactive analysis produced actionable insights on recurring failure patterns and focus areas for improvement, demonstrating how validation itself can evolve into an agentic, dialogue-driven process. These results show a path toward scalable, quality assurance, and adaptive validation in production agentic systems, offering a foundation for more robust, interpretable, and self-improving agentic architectures.

AI.tldr: 提出了一个用于LLM智能体系统的综合验证框架，包含15个故障检测工具和2个根因分析模块，能系统性诊断和改进可靠性问题，支持从检测到修复的全流程。
AI.motivation: 为了解决LLM智能体系统在生产环境中存在的可靠性问题，需要系统性的验证框架来诊断和改进各种故障模式，确保智能体系统的稳健性和可解释性。
AI.method: 开发了一个包含15个故障检测工具和2个根因分析模块的综合验证框架，结合轻量级规则检查和LLM-as-a-judge评估，支持结构化的事件检测、分类和修复。框架应用于IBM CUGA系统，并在AppWorld和WebArena基准测试上进行评估。
AI.result: 分析揭示了规划器错位、模式违规、脆弱的提示依赖等常见问题。基于这些洞察改进了提示和编码策略，使Llama 4和Mistral Medium等中等规模模型实现了显著的准确率提升，大幅缩小了与前沿模型的差距。探索性研究还展示了如何将诊断输出用于LLM自我反思和优先级排序。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为生产智能体系统提供了可扩展的质量保证和自适应验证路径，为构建更稳健、可解释和自我改进的智能体架构奠定了基础，展示了验证本身如何演变为对话驱动的智能过程。

title: ContextClaim: A Context-Driven Paradigm for Verifiable Claim Detection
summary: Verifiable claim detection asks whether a claim expresses a factual statement that can, in principle, be assessed against external evidence. As an early filtering stage in automated fact-checking, it plays an important role in reducing the burden on downstream verification components. However, existing approaches to claim detection, whether based on check-worthiness or verifiability, rely solely on the claim text itself. This is a notable limitation for verifiable claim detection in particular, where determining whether a claim is checkable may benefit from knowing what entities and events it refers to and whether relevant information exists to support verification. Inspired by the established role of evidence retrieval in later-stage claim verification, we propose Context-Driven Claim Detection (ContextClaim), a paradigm that advances retrieval to the detection stage. ContextClaim extracts entity mentions from the input claim, retrieves relevant information from Wikipedia as a structured knowledge source, and employs large language models to produce concise contextual summaries for downstream classification. We evaluate ContextClaim on two datasets covering different topics and text genres, the CheckThat! 2022 COVID-19 Twitter dataset and the PoliClaim political debate dataset, across encoder-only and decoder-only models under fine-tuning, zero-shot, and few-shot settings. Results show that context augmentation can improve verifiable claim detection, although its effectiveness varies across domains, model architectures, and learning settings. Through component analysis, human evaluation, and error analysis, we further examine when and why the retrieved context contributes to more reliable verifiability judgments.

AI.tldr: 提出ContextClaim方法，通过检索维基百科上下文信息来增强可验证声明检测，在多个数据集和设置下验证了上下文增强的有效性
AI.motivation: 现有声明检测方法仅依赖声明文本本身，而确定声明是否可验证可能需要了解其引用的实体和事件，以及是否存在相关信息支持验证。受证据检索在后续验证阶段作用的启发，将检索提前到检测阶段
AI.method: 提出ContextClaim范式：从输入声明中提取实体提及，从维基百科检索相关信息作为结构化知识源，使用大语言模型生成简洁的上下文摘要，用于下游分类
AI.result: 在CheckThat! 2022 COVID-19 Twitter数据集和PoliClaim政治辩论数据集上评估，涵盖编码器-解码器模型、微调、零样本和少样本设置。结果显示上下文增强可以改进可验证声明检测，但其有效性因领域、模型架构和学习设置而异
AI.conclusion: 上下文增强可以提高可验证声明检测性能，通过组件分析、人工评估和错误分析进一步研究了检索上下文何时以及为何有助于更可靠的可验证性判断

title: CIPHER: Counterfeit Image Pattern High-level Examination via Representation
summary: The rapid progress of generative adversarial networks (GANs) and diffusion models has enabled the creation of synthetic faces that are increasingly difficult to distinguish from real images. This progress, however, has also amplified the risks of misinformation, fraud, and identity abuse, underscoring the urgent need for detectors that remain robust across diverse generative models. In this work, we introduce Counterfeit Image Pattern High-level Examination via Representation(CIPHER), a deepfake detection framework that systematically reuses and fine-tunes discriminators originally trained for image generation. By extracting scale-adaptive features from ProGAN discriminators and temporal-consistency features from diffusion models, CIPHER captures generation-agnostic artifacts that conventional detectors often overlook. Through extensive experiments across nine state-of-the-art generative models, CIPHER demonstrates superior cross-model detection performance, achieving up to 74.33% F1-score and outperforming existing ViT-based detectors by over 30% in F1-score on average. Notably, our approach maintains robust performance on challenging datasets where baseline methods fail, with up to 88% F1-score on CIFAKE compared to near-zero performance from conventional detectors. These results validate the effectiveness of discriminator reuse and cross-model fine-tuning, establishing CIPHER as a promising approach toward building more generalizable and robust deepfake detection systems in an era of rapidly evolving generative technologies.

AI.tldr: CIPHER是一个深度伪造检测框架，通过重用和微调图像生成判别器来提取跨模型的生成痕迹，在多种生成模型上实现卓越的跨模型检测性能。
AI.motivation: 随着GAN和扩散模型的快速发展，生成的合成人脸越来越难以与真实图像区分，这增加了错误信息、欺诈和身份滥用的风险，迫切需要能够跨多种生成模型保持鲁棒性的检测器。
AI.method: CIPHER框架系统性地重用和微调原本用于图像生成的判别器，从ProGAN判别器中提取尺度自适应特征，从扩散模型中提取时间一致性特征，捕捉传统检测器常常忽略的与生成模型无关的痕迹。
AI.result: 在9个最先进的生成模型上进行广泛实验，CIPHER展示了卓越的跨模型检测性能，达到最高74.33%的F1分数，平均比现有ViT-based检测器高出30%以上。在具有挑战性的数据集上保持鲁棒性能，在CIFAKE上达到88%的F1分数，而传统检测器性能接近零。
AI.conclusion: 结果验证了判别器重用和跨模型微调的有效性，确立了CIPHER作为在快速发展的生成技术时代构建更通用和鲁棒的深度伪造检测系统的有前景方法。

title: ShapE-GRPO: Shapley-Enhanced Reward Allocation for Multi-Candidate LLM Training
summary: In user-agent interaction scenarios such as recommendation, brainstorming, and code suggestion, Large Language Models (LLMs) often generate sets of candidate recommendations where the objective is to maximize the collective utility of the entire set rather than individual candidates independently. However, existing reinforcement learning post-training paradigms, such as Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), typically assign the same set-level scalar reward to every candidate in the set. This leads to noisy training signals where poor candidates free-ride on the high reward produced by a single strong peer, resulting in suboptimal exploration. To address this, we propose Shapley-Enhanced GRPO (ShapE-GRPO). By leveraging the permutation-invariant nature of set-level utility, we derive a Shapley-enhanced formulation from cooperative game theory to decompose set-level rewards into granular, candidate-specific signals. We show that our formulation preserves the fundamental axioms of the Shapley value while remaining computationally efficient with polynomial-time complexity. Empirically, ShapE-GRPO consistently outperforms standard GRPO across diverse datasets with accelerated convergence during training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ShapE-GRPO方法，使用Shapley值分解集合级奖励，解决LLM在多候选推荐场景中训练信号噪声问题，相比传统GRPO获得更好性能。
AI.motivation: 在推荐、头脑风暴、代码建议等用户-代理交互场景中，LLM需要生成候选推荐集合，目标是最大化整个集合的集体效用而非单个候选。现有强化学习后训练范式（如GRPO）通常为集合中每个候选分配相同的集合级标量奖励，这导致训练信号噪声大，差的候选可以"搭便车"享受单个强候选产生的高奖励，造成次优探索。
AI.method: 提出Shapley-Enhanced GRPO (ShapE-GRPO)，利用集合级效用的置换不变性，从合作博弈论中推导出Shapley增强公式，将集合级奖励分解为细粒度的候选特定信号。该方法保留了Shapley值的基本公理，同时保持多项式时间复杂度的计算效率。
AI.result: ShapE-GRPO在多样化数据集上持续优于标准GRPO，训练过程中收敛速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 通过Shapley值分解集合级奖励，ShapE-GRPO解决了传统GRPO中的训练信号噪声问题，为LLM在多候选推荐场景中的强化学习后训练提供了更有效的解决方案。

title: Uncertainty-Aware Trajectory Prediction: A Unified Framework Harnessing Positional and Semantic Uncertainties
summary: Trajectory prediction seeks to forecast the future motion of dynamic entities, such as vehicles and pedestrians, given a temporal horizon of historical movement data and environmental context. A central challenge in this domain is the inherent uncertainty in real-time maps, arising from two primary sources: (1) positional inaccuracies due to sensor limitations or environmental occlusions, and (2) semantic errors stemming from misinterpretations of scene context. To address these challenges, we propose a novel unified framework that jointly models positional and semantic uncertainties and explicitly integrates them into the trajectory prediction pipeline. Our approach employs a dual-head architecture to independently estimate semantic and positional predictions in a dual-pass manner, deriving prediction variances as uncertainty indicators in an end-to-end fashion. These uncertainties are subsequently fused with the semantic and positional predictions to enhance the robustness of trajectory forecasts. We evaluate our uncertainty-aware framework on the nuScenes real-world driving dataset, conducting extensive experiments across four map estimation methods and two trajectory prediction baselines. Results verify that our method (1) effectively quantifies map uncertainties through both positional and semantic dimensions, and (2) consistently improves the performance of existing trajectory prediction models across multiple metrics, including minimum Average Displacement Error (minADE), minimum Final Displacement Error (minFDE), and Miss Rate (MR). Code will available at https://github.com/JT-Sun/UATP.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种联合建模位置和语义不确定性的统一框架，通过双头架构独立估计语义和位置预测，将不确定性指标融入轨迹预测流程，在nuScenes数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 轨迹预测领域面临实时地图不确定性的核心挑战，包括传感器限制或环境遮挡导致的位置不准确性，以及场景上下文误解导致的语义错误。现有方法未能充分建模这些不确定性并将其整合到预测流程中。
AI.method: 提出统一框架联合建模位置和语义不确定性，采用双头架构以双通道方式独立估计语义和位置预测，以端到端方式推导预测方差作为不确定性指标，然后将这些不确定性融合到语义和位置预测中以增强轨迹预测的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在nuScenes真实世界驾驶数据集上进行评估，通过四种地图估计方法和两种轨迹预测基线的广泛实验验证：1）方法能有效通过位置和语义维度量化地图不确定性；2）在多个指标上持续改进现有轨迹预测模型性能，包括最小平均位移误差(minADE)、最小最终位移误差(minFDE)和漏检率(MR)。
AI.conclusion: 提出的不确定性感知框架成功解决了轨迹预测中地图不确定性的挑战，通过联合建模位置和语义不确定性并明确整合到预测流程中，显著提升了现有轨迹预测模型的性能。

title: A Rational Account of Categorization Based on Information Theory
summary: We present a new theory of categorization based on an information-theoretic rational analysis. To evaluate this theory, we investigate how well it can account for key findings from classic categorization experiments conducted by Hayes-Roth and Hayes-Roth (1977), Medin and Schaffer (1978), and Smith and Minda (1998). We find that it explains the human categorization behavior at least as well (or better) than the independent cue and context models (Medin & Schaffer, 1978), the rational model of categorization (Anderson, 1991), and a hierarchical Dirichlet process model (Griffiths et al., 2007).

AI.tldr: 提出基于信息论理性分析的新分类理论，验证其在经典分类实验中的表现优于现有模型
AI.motivation: 开发一个基于信息论原理的理性分析框架来解释人类分类行为，旨在超越现有分类模型的解释能力
AI.method: 采用信息论理性分析方法构建新分类理论，通过对比经典实验数据（Hayes-Roth & Hayes-Roth, 1977; Medin & Schaffer, 1978; Smith & Minda, 1998）来评估模型性能
AI.result: 新理论在解释人类分类行为方面至少与独立线索和上下文模型、理性分类模型、分层狄利克雷过程模型相当或更好
AI.conclusion: 基于信息论的理性分析为理解人类分类行为提供了强有力的理论框架，其解释能力优于多个现有主流模型

title: ATP-Bench: Towards Agentic Tool Planning for MLLM Interleaved Generation
summary: Interleaved text-and-image generation represents a significant frontier for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), offering a more intuitive way to convey complex information. Current paradigms rely on either image generation or retrieval augmentation, yet they typically treat the two as mutually exclusive paths, failing to unify factuality with creativity. We argue that the next milestone in this field is Agentic Tool Planning, where the model serves as a central controller that autonomously determines when, where, and which tools to invoke to produce interleaved responses for visual-critical queries. To systematically evaluate this paradigm, we introduce ATP-Bench, a novel benchmark comprising 7,702 QA pairs (including 1,592 VQA pairs) across eight categories and 25 visual-critical intents, featuring human-verified queries and ground truths. Furthermore, to evaluate agentic planning independent of end-to-end execution and changing tool backends, we propose a Multi-Agent MLLM-as-a-Judge (MAM) system. MAM evaluates tool-call precision, identifies missed opportunities for tool use, and assesses overall response quality without requiring ground-truth references. Our extensive experiments on 10 state-of-the-art MLLMs reveal that models struggle with coherent interleaved planning and exhibit significant variations in tool-use behavior, highlighting substantial room for improvement and providing actionable guidance for advancing interleaved generation. Dataset and code are available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/ATP-Bench.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了ATP-Bench基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型在交错文本-图像生成中的工具规划能力，并引入多代理MLLM-as-a-Judge系统进行自动评估。
AI.motivation: 当前交错文本-图像生成方法通常将图像生成和检索增强视为互斥路径，无法统一事实性与创造性。论文认为该领域的下一个里程碑是代理工具规划，让模型作为中央控制器自主决定何时、何地、使用何种工具来生成视觉关键查询的交错响应。
AI.method: 1. 提出ATP-Bench基准测试，包含7,702个QA对（包括1,592个VQA对），涵盖8个类别和25种视觉关键意图；2. 提出多代理MLLM-as-a-Judge系统，独立于端到端执行和变化工具后端评估代理规划能力，评估工具调用精度、识别工具使用遗漏机会并评估整体响应质量。
AI.result: 对10个最先进的MLLM进行广泛实验发现：模型在连贯的交错规划方面存在困难，工具使用行为存在显著差异，表明有大量改进空间，并为推进交错生成提供了可操作的指导。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过ATP-Bench基准测试和多代理评估系统，为评估和改进多模态大语言模型在交错文本-图像生成中的工具规划能力提供了系统框架，揭示了当前模型的局限性并指明了改进方向。

title: PromptForge-350k: A Large-Scale Dataset and Contrastive Framework for Prompt-Based AI Image Forgery Localization
summary: The rapid democratization of prompt-based AI image editing has recently exacerbated the risks associated with malicious content fabrication and misinformation. However, forgery localization methods targeting these emerging editing techniques remain significantly under-explored. To bridge this gap, we first introduce a fully automated mask annotating framework that leverages keypoint alignment and semantic space similarity to generate precise ground-truth masks for edited regions. Based on this framework, we construct PromptForge-350k, a large-scale forgery localization dataset covering four state-of-the-art prompt-based AI image editing models, thereby mitigating the data scarcity in this domain. Furthermore, we propose ICL-Net, an effective forgery localization network featuring a triple-stream backbone and intra-image contrastive learning. This design enables the model to capture highly robust and generalizable forensic features. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves an IoU of 62.5% on PromptForge-350k, outperforming SOTA methods by 5.1%. Additionally, it exhibits strong robustness against common degradations with an IoU drop of less than 1%, and shows promising generalization capabilities on unseen editing models, achieving an average IoU of 41.5%.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对基于提示的AI图像编辑技术带来的伪造风险，提出了一个自动化的伪造区域定位方法，包括构建大规模数据集PromptForge-350k和开发ICL-Net网络模型。
AI.motivation: 基于提示的AI图像编辑技术的快速普及加剧了恶意内容伪造和虚假信息的风险，但针对这些新兴编辑技术的伪造定位方法研究严重不足，需要解决这一领域的数据稀缺和技术挑战。
AI.method: 1. 开发了全自动的掩码标注框架，利用关键点对齐和语义空间相似性生成精确的编辑区域真值掩码；2. 构建了PromptForge-350k大规模伪造定位数据集，涵盖四种最先进的基于提示的AI图像编辑模型；3. 提出了ICL-Net伪造定位网络，采用三流主干网络和图像内对比学习设计。
AI.result: 1. 在PromptForge-350k数据集上达到62.5%的IoU，比现有最佳方法提升5.1%；2. 对常见退化具有强鲁棒性，IoU下降小于1%；3. 在未见过的编辑模型上表现出良好的泛化能力，平均IoU达到41.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过构建大规模数据集和开发有效的ICL-Net网络，成功解决了基于提示的AI图像编辑伪造定位问题，为防范恶意内容伪造提供了有效的技术解决方案。

title: Uncertainty Gating for Cost-Aware Explainable Artificial Intelligence
summary: Post-hoc explanation methods are widely used to interpret black-box predictions, but their generation is often computationally expensive and their reliability is not guaranteed. We propose epistemic uncertainty as a low-cost proxy for explanation reliability: high epistemic uncertainty identifies regions where the decision boundary is poorly defined and where explanations become unstable and unfaithful. This insight enables two complementary use cases: `improving worst-case explanations' (routing samples to cheap or expensive XAI methods based on expected explanation reliability), and `recalling high-quality explanations' (deferring explanation generation for uncertain samples under constrained budget). Across four tabular datasets, five diverse architectures, and four XAI methods, we observe a strong negative correlation between epistemic uncertainty and explanation stability. Further analysis shows that epistemic uncertainty distinguishes not only stable from unstable explanations, but also faithful from unfaithful ones. Experiments on image classification confirm that our findings generalize beyond tabular data.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出使用认知不确定性作为解释可靠性的低成本代理指标，高认知不确定性表明决策边界不明确，导致解释不稳定、不可信。这支持两种应用：基于预期可靠性将样本路由到不同成本的XAI方法，以及在预算约束下推迟对不确定样本的解释生成。
AI.motivation: 后验解释方法常用于解释黑盒预测，但生成成本高且可靠性无法保证。需要一种低成本的方法来评估解释的可靠性，以优化解释资源的分配。
AI.method: 提出使用认知不确定性作为解释可靠性的代理指标。通过四个表格数据集、五种不同架构和四种XAI方法进行验证，分析认知不确定性与解释稳定性之间的相关性。并在图像分类任务上验证方法的泛化能力。
AI.result: 实验显示认知不确定性与解释稳定性存在强负相关关系。认知不确定性不仅能区分稳定与不稳定的解释，还能区分可信与不可信的解释。图像分类实验证实这一发现在非表格数据上同样适用。
AI.conclusion: 认知不确定性是评估解释可靠性的有效低成本代理指标，支持两种实用应用场景：优化解释资源分配和基于预算约束的智能解释生成策略。

title: AA-Splat: Anti-Aliased Feed-forward Gaussian Splatting
comment: Please visit our project page at https://kaist-viclab.github.io/aasplat-site/
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF-3DGS) emerges as a fast and robust solution for sparse-view 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis (NVS). However, existing FF-3DGS methods are built on incorrect screen-space dilation filters, causing severe rendering artifacts when rendering at out-of-distribution sampling rates. We firstly propose an FF-3DGS model, called AA-Splat, to enable robust anti-aliased rendering at any resolution. AA-Splat utilizes an opacity-balanced band-limiting (OBBL) design, which combines two components: a 3D band-limiting post-filter integrates multi-view maximal frequency bounds into the feed-forward reconstruction pipeline, effectively band-limiting the resulting 3D scene representations and eliminating degenerate Gaussians; an Opacity Balancing (OB) to seamlessly integrate all pixel-aligned Gaussian primitives into the rendering process, compensating for the increased overlap between expanded Gaussian primitives. AA-Splat demonstrates drastic improvements with average 5.4$\sim$7.5dB PSNR gains on NVS performance over a state-of-the-art (SOTA) baseline, DepthSplat, at all resolutions, between $4\times$ and $1/4\times$. Code will be made available.

AI.tldr: AA-Splat是一种改进的FF-3DGS模型，通过不透明度平衡的带限设计解决了现有方法在非分布采样率下的渲染伪影问题，实现了任意分辨率下的抗锯齿渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有FF-3DGS方法基于错误的屏幕空间扩张滤波器，在非分布采样率下渲染时会产生严重伪影。需要开发能够在任意分辨率下进行稳健抗锯齿渲染的3D高斯泼溅模型。
AI.method: 提出AA-Splat模型，采用不透明度平衡带限设计：1）3D带限后滤波器将多视图最大频率边界集成到前馈重建流程中，有效带限3D场景表示并消除退化高斯；2）不透明度平衡技术将所有像素对齐的高斯基元无缝集成到渲染过程中，补偿扩展高斯基元之间增加的重叠。
AI.result: AA-Splat在所有分辨率下（4倍到1/4倍之间）相比最先进的DepthSplat基线，在新视角合成性能上平均获得5.4~7.5dB的PSNR提升，显示出显著改进。
AI.conclusion: AA-Splat通过创新的不透明度平衡带限设计，成功解决了FF-3DGS方法在非分布采样率下的渲染伪影问题，实现了任意分辨率下的稳健抗锯齿渲染，显著提升了新视角合成性能。

title: Hallucination-aware intermediate representation edit in large vision-language models
summary: Large Vision-Language Models have demonstrated exceptional performance in multimodal reasoning and complex scene understanding. However, these models still face significant hallucination issues, where outputs contradict visual facts. Recent research on hallucination mitigation has focused on retraining methods and Contrastive Decoding (CD) methods. While both methods perform well, retraining methods require substantial training resources, and CD methods introduce dual inference overhead. These factors hinder their practical applicability. To address the above issue, we propose a framework for dynamically detecting hallucination representations and performing hallucination-eliminating edits on these representations. With minimal additional computational cost, we achieve state-of-the-art performance on existing benchmarks. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, highlighting its efficient and robust hallucination elimination capability and its powerful controllability over hallucinations. Code is available at https://github.com/ASGO-MM/HIRE

AI.tldr: 提出HIRE框架，通过动态检测幻觉表示并进行编辑，以最小计算成本实现最先进的幻觉消除性能
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型在多模态推理和复杂场景理解方面表现出色，但仍面临严重的幻觉问题。现有方法如重新训练需要大量资源，对比解码方法引入双重推理开销，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出HIRE框架，动态检测幻觉表示并对这些表示进行幻觉消除编辑，以最小额外计算成本实现高效幻觉消除
AI.result: 在现有基准测试中达到最先进性能，实验证明该方法具有高效稳健的幻觉消除能力和强大的可控性
AI.conclusion: HIRE框架以最小计算成本有效解决了视觉语言模型的幻觉问题，具有实际应用价值

title: Structured Intent as a Protocol-Like Communication Layer: Cross-Model Robustness, Framework Comparison, and the Weak-Model Compensation Effect
comment: 25 pages, figures, tables, and appendix. Third paper in a cumulative research series on PPS and 5W3H structured intent representation, extending prior work to cross-model robustness, framework comparison, and user-study validation
summary: How reliably can structured intent representations preserve user goals across different AI models, languages, and prompting frameworks? Prior work showed that PPS (Prompt Protocol Specification), a 5W3H-based structured intent framework, improves goal alignment in Chinese and generalizes to English and Japanese. This paper extends that line of inquiry in three directions: cross-model robustness across Claude, GPT-4o, and Gemini 2.5 Pro; controlled comparison with CO-STAR and RISEN; and a user study (N=50) of AI-assisted intent expansion in ecologically valid settings. Across 3,240 model outputs (3 languages x 6 conditions x 3 models x 3 domains x 20 tasks), evaluated by an independent judge (DeepSeek-V3), we find that structured prompting substantially reduces cross-language score variance relative to unstructured baselines. The strongest structured conditions reduce cross-language sigma from 0.470 to about 0.020. We also observe a weak-model compensation pattern: the lowest-baseline model (Gemini) shows a much larger D-A gain (+1.006) than the strongest model (Claude, +0.217). Under the current evaluation resolution, 5W3H, CO-STAR, and RISEN achieve similarly high goal-alignment scores, suggesting that dimensional decomposition itself is an important active ingredient. In the user study, AI-expanded 5W3H prompts reduce interaction rounds by 60 percent and increase user satisfaction from 3.16 to 4.04. These findings support the practical value of structured intent representation as a robust, protocol-like communication layer for human-AI interaction.

AI.tldr: 结构化意图表示（5W3H、CO-STAR、RISEN）能显著提升AI模型跨语言、跨模型的意图对齐稳定性，降低方差，并在用户研究中减少交互轮次、提升满意度。
AI.motivation: 探究结构化意图表示在不同AI模型、语言和提示框架下能否可靠地保持用户目标，验证其作为人机交互通信层的实用价值。
AI.method: 1) 跨模型鲁棒性测试：在Claude、GPT-4o、Gemini 2.5 Pro上评估；2) 与CO-STAR和RISEN的对照比较；3) 用户研究（N=50）在生态有效环境中测试AI辅助意图扩展。共3240个模型输出（3语言×6条件×3模型×3领域×20任务），由DeepSeek-V3独立评估。
AI.result: 结构化提示显著降低跨语言得分方差（从0.470降至约0.020）；弱模型补偿效应明显（Gemini提升+1.006 vs Claude +0.217）；5W3H、CO-STAR、RISEN在目标对齐得分上表现相似；用户研究中，AI扩展的5W3H提示减少60%交互轮次，用户满意度从3.16提升至4.04。
AI.conclusion: 结构化意图表示作为人机交互的协议式通信层具有实用价值，能提高跨模型、跨语言的鲁棒性，维度分解本身是关键因素，能显著改善用户体验。

title: AGFT: Alignment-Guided Fine-Tuning for Zero-Shot Adversarial Robustness of Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026; Code is available at \url{https://github.com/YuboCui/AGFT}
summary: Pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong zero-shot generalization but remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations. Existing classification-guided adversarial fine-tuning methods often disrupt pre-trained cross-modal alignment, weakening visual-textual correspondence and degrading zero-shot performance. In this paper, we propose an Alignment-Guided Fine-Tuning (AGFT) framework that enhances zero-shot adversarial robustness while preserving the cross-modal semantic structure. Unlike label-based methods that rely on hard labels and fail to maintain the relative relationships between image and text, AGFT leverages the probabilistic predictions of the original model for text-guided adversarial training, which aligns adversarial visual features with textual embeddings via soft alignment distributions, improving zero-shot adversarial robustness. To address structural discrepancies introduced by fine-tuning, we introduce a distribution consistency calibration mechanism that adjusts the robust model output to match a temperature-scaled version of the pre-trained model predictions. Extensive experiments across multiple zero-shot benchmarks demonstrate that AGFT outperforms state-of-the-art methods while significantly improving zero-shot adversarial robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出AGFT框架，通过对齐引导的微调增强视觉语言模型的零样本对抗鲁棒性，同时保持跨模态语义对齐
AI.motivation: 现有的基于分类的对抗微调方法会破坏预训练模型的跨模态对齐，削弱视觉-文本对应关系并降低零样本性能。需要一种既能增强对抗鲁棒性又能保持跨模态语义结构的方法。
AI.method: 提出对齐引导微调(AGFT)框架：1) 利用原始模型的概率预测进行文本引导的对抗训练，通过软对齐分布将对抗视觉特征与文本嵌入对齐；2) 引入分布一致性校准机制，调整鲁棒模型输出以匹配预训练模型的温度缩放版本预测。
AI.result: 在多个零样本基准测试上的广泛实验表明，AGFT优于现有最先进方法，同时显著提高了零样本对抗鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: AGFT框架通过保持跨模态对齐的同时增强对抗鲁棒性，解决了现有对抗微调方法破坏预训练模型语义结构的问题，为视觉语言模型的零样本对抗鲁棒性提供了有效解决方案。

title: Extending MONA in Camera Dropbox: Reproduction, Learned Approval, and Design Implications for Reward-Hacking Mitigation
summary: Myopic Optimization with Non-myopic Approval (MONA) mitigates multi-step reward hacking by restricting the agent's planning horizon while supplying far-sighted approval as a training signal~\cite{farquhar2025mona}. The original paper identifies a critical open question: how the method of constructing approval -- particularly the degree to which approval depends on achieved outcomes -- affects whether MONA's safety guarantees hold. We present a reproduction-first extension of the public MONA Camera Dropbox environment that (i)~repackages the released codebase as a standard Python project with scripted PPO training, (ii)~confirms the published contrast between ordinary RL (91.5\% reward-hacking rate) and oracle MONA (0.0\% hacking rate) using the released reference arrays, and (iii)~introduces a modular learned-approval suite spanning oracle, noisy, misspecified, learned, and calibrated approval mechanisms. In reduced-budget pilot sweeps across approval methods, horizons, dataset sizes, and calibration strategies, the best calibrated learned-overseer run achieves zero observed reward hacking but substantially lower intended-behavior rates than oracle MONA (11.9\% vs.\ 99.9\%), consistent with under-optimization rather than re-emergent hacking. These results operationalize the MONA paper's approval-spectrum conjecture as a runnable experimental object and suggest that the central engineering challenge shifts from proving MONA's concept to building learned approval models that preserve sufficient foresight without reopening reward-hacking channels. Code, configurations, and reproduction commands are publicly available. https://github.com/codernate92/mona-camera-dropbox-repro

AI.tldr: 该研究对MONA方法进行复现和扩展，通过构建模块化的学习型批准机制套件，验证了批准机制设计对MONA安全保证的影响，发现校准学习型监督器能避免奖励攻击但可能导致优化不足。
AI.motivation: 原MONA论文提出了一个关键开放性问题：批准机制的构建方法（特别是批准对已实现结果的依赖程度）如何影响MONA的安全保证。本研究旨在通过复现和扩展来实证探索这一问题。
AI.method: 1) 将发布的代码库重新打包为标准Python项目，使用脚本化PPO训练；2) 使用发布的参考数组验证普通RL（91.5%奖励攻击率）与oracle MONA（0.0%攻击率）的对比；3) 引入模块化的学习型批准套件，涵盖oracle、噪声、错误指定、学习和校准批准机制；4) 在批准方法、规划视野、数据集大小和校准策略上进行预算有限的试点扫描。
AI.result: 1) 成功复现了原论文结果；2) 最佳校准学习型监督器运行实现了零奖励攻击，但预期行为率远低于oracle MONA（11.9% vs. 99.9%），表现为优化不足而非重新出现的奖励攻击；3) 结果支持MONA论文的批准谱猜想，并将其实验操作化。
AI.conclusion: 研究将MONA论文的批准谱猜想转化为可运行的实验对象，表明核心工程挑战从证明MONA概念转向构建既能保持足够远见又不重新开放奖励攻击通道的学习型批准模型。校准学习型监督器能避免奖励攻击，但可能导致严重的优化不足问题。

title: Native-Domain Cross-Attention for Camera-LiDAR Extrinsic Calibration Under Large Initial Perturbations
summary: Accurate camera-LiDAR fusion relies on precise extrinsic calibration, which fundamentally depends on establishing reliable cross-modal correspondences under potentially large misalignments. Existing learning-based methods typically project LiDAR points into depth maps for feature fusion, which distorts 3D geometry and degrades performance when the extrinsic initialization is far from the ground truth. To address this issue, we propose an extrinsic-aware cross-attention framework that directly aligns image patches and LiDAR point groups in their native domains. The proposed attention mechanism explicitly injects extrinsic parameter hypotheses into the correspondence modeling process, enabling geometry-consistent cross-modal interaction without relying on projected 2D depth maps. Extensive experiments on the KITTI and nuScenes benchmarks demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in both accuracy and robustness. Under large extrinsic perturbations, our approach achieves accurate calibration in 88% of KITTI cases and 99% of nuScenes cases, substantially surpassing the second-best baseline. We have open sourced our code on https://github.com/gitouni/ProjFusion to benefit the community.

AI.tldr: 提出一种外参感知的跨模态注意力框架，直接在图像块和LiDAR点群之间进行对齐，避免将3D点投影到2D深度图导致的几何失真问题
AI.motivation: 现有的相机-LiDAR融合方法通常将LiDAR点投影到深度图进行特征融合，当外参初始化远离真实值时，这种投影会扭曲3D几何结构并降低性能
AI.method: 提出外参感知的跨注意力框架，在图像块和LiDAR点群的原生域中直接对齐，将外参假设显式注入到对应关系建模过程中，实现几何一致的跨模态交互
AI.result: 在KITTI和nuScenes基准测试中，方法在准确性和鲁棒性上均优于现有技术。在大外参扰动下，在88%的KITTI案例和99%的nuScenes案例中实现准确校准
AI.conclusion: 提出的外参感知跨注意力框架能够有效解决相机-LiDAR外参校准问题，特别是在大外参扰动情况下表现优异，代码已开源

title: Adversarial Prompt Injection Attack on Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, their instruction-following behavior leaves them vulnerable to prompt injection attacks. Existing prompt injection methods predominantly rely on textual prompts or perceptible visual prompts that are observable by human users. In this work, we study imperceptible visual prompt injection against powerful closed-source MLLMs, where adversarial instructions are embedded in the visual modality. Our method adaptively embeds the malicious prompt into the input image via a bounded text overlay to provide semantic guidance. Meanwhile, the imperceptible visual perturbation is iteratively optimized to align the feature representation of the attacked image with those of the malicious visual and textual targets at both coarse- and fine-grained levels. Specifically, the visual target is instantiated as a text-rendered image and progressively refined during optimization to more faithfully represent the desired semantics and improve transferability. Extensive experiments on two multimodal understanding tasks across multiple closed-source MLLMs demonstrate the superior performance of our approach compared to existing methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对闭源多模态大语言模型的不可感知视觉提示注入攻击方法，通过文本覆盖提供语义指导，并迭代优化视觉扰动，在多个闭源MLLMs上表现出优越性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管多模态大语言模型在实际应用中越来越广泛，但其指令跟随行为使其容易受到提示注入攻击。现有方法主要依赖文本提示或人类可感知的视觉提示，本文研究针对强大闭源MLLMs的不可感知视觉提示注入攻击。
