Our analysis reveals strong relationships between enumeration accuracy, temporal grounding, and counting performance. These results highlight fundamental limitations of current MLLMs and establish EC-Bench as a challenging benchmark for long-form quantitative video reasoning.

AI.tldr: EC-Bench是一个针对长视频计数任务的新基准测试，包含超过30分钟的长视频和1699个查询，评估枚举、计数和时间证据定位能力。现有MLLMs表现不佳（最佳模型准确率约30%），远低于人类水平（约80%）。
AI.motivation: 当前视频计数研究主要关注短片段，仅评估最终数值答案，缺乏对长视频中稀疏、多样事件的计数能力评估，以及对模型是否能够持续识别相关实例的深入分析。
AI.method: 提出了EC-Bench基准测试，包含152个时长超过30分钟的长视频和1699个查询，每个查询都配有明确的时间证据跨度。该基准联合评估枚举、计数和时间证据定位三个维度，并在22个多模态大语言模型上进行测试。
AI.result: 最佳模型在枚举任务上仅达到29.98%准确率，在计数任务上为23.74%，而人类表现分别为78.57%和82.97%。分析显示枚举准确率、时间定位和计数性能之间存在强相关性。
AI.conclusion: EC-Bench揭示了当前MLLMs在长视频定量推理方面的根本局限性，为长视频理解研究提供了一个具有挑战性的基准测试，强调了需要改进模型的长程时间推理能力。

title: NeuroBRIDGE: Behavior-Conditioned Koopman Dynamics with Riemannian Alignment for Early Substance Use Initiation Prediction from Longitudinal Functional Connectome
comment: Preprint version of the paper accepted to the IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026). This is the author's accepted manuscript. The final published version will appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Early identification of adolescents at risk for substance use initiation (SUI) is vital yet difficult, as most predictors treat connectivity as static or cross-sectional and miss how brain networks change over time and with behavior. We proposed NeuroBRIDGE (Behavior conditioned RIemannian Koopman Dynamics on lonGitudinal connEctomes), a novel graph neural network-based framework that aligns longitudinal functional connectome in a Riemannian tangent space and couples dual-time attention with behavioral-conditioned Koopman dynamics to capture temporal change. Evaluated on ABCD, NeuroBRIDGE improved future SUI prediction over relevant baselines while offering interpretable insights into neural pathways, refining our understanding of neurodevelopmental risk and informing targeted prevention.

AI.tldr: NeuroBRIDGE框架通过Riemannian几何和Koopman动力学改进青少年物质使用起始的早期预测
AI.motivation: 现有方法大多将脑连接视为静态或横断面数据，忽略了脑网络随时间变化以及与行为的关系，难以准确预测青少年物质使用起始风险
AI.method: 提出NeuroBRIDGE框架：1）在Riemannian切空间中对齐纵向功能连接组；2）结合双时间注意力机制；3）使用行为条件化的Koopman动力学捕捉时间变化
AI.result: 在ABCD数据集上评估，NeuroBRIDGE相比相关基线方法显著提高了未来物质使用起始的预测性能，同时提供了可解释的神经通路洞察
AI.conclusion: 该框架改进了对神经发育风险的理解，为针对性预防提供了信息，实现了更准确的青少年物质使用起始风险预测

title: Learning Structural-Functional Brain Representations through Multi-Scale Adaptive Graph Attention for Cognitive Insight
comment: Preprint version of the paper accepted to the IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026). This is the author's accepted manuscript. The final published version will appear in IEEE Xplore
summary: Understanding how brain structure and function interact is key to explaining intelligence yet modeling them jointly is challenging as the structural and functional connectome capture complementary aspects of organization. We introduced Multi-scale Adaptive Graph Network (MAGNet), a Transformer-style graph neural network framework that adaptively learns structure-function interactions. MAGNet leverages source-based morphometry from structural MRI to extract inter-regional morphological features and fuses them with functional network connectivity from resting-state fMRI. A hybrid graph integrates direct and indirect pathways, while local-global attention refines connectivity importance and a joint loss simultaneously enforces cross-modal coherence and optimizes the prediction objective end-to-end. On the ABCD dataset, MAGNet outperformed relevant baselines, demonstrating effective multimodal integration for advancing our understanding of cognitive function.

AI.tldr: MAGNet是一个Transformer风格的图神经网络框架，通过自适应学习结构-功能相互作用，将结构MRI的形态特征与静息态fMRI的功能连接融合，在ABCD数据集上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 理解大脑结构和功能如何相互作用是解释智力的关键，但联合建模具有挑战性，因为结构和功能连接组捕捉了互补的组织方面。
AI.method: 提出多尺度自适应图网络（MAGNet），利用结构MRI的基于源形态测量提取区域间形态特征，与静息态fMRI的功能网络连接融合。采用混合图整合直接和间接通路，局部-全局注意力机制细化连接重要性，联合损失函数同时强制跨模态一致性和优化预测目标。
AI.result: 在ABCD数据集上，MAGNet优于相关基线方法，展示了有效的多模态整合能力。
AI.conclusion: MAGNet通过自适应学习结构-功能相互作用，为推进对认知功能的理解提供了有效的多模态整合框架。

title: SurgNavAR: An Augmented Reality Surgical Navigation Framework for Optical See-Through Head Mounted Displays
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Augmented reality (AR) devices with head mounted displays (HMDs) facilitate the direct superimposition of 3D preoperative imaging data onto the patient during surgery. To use an HMD-AR device as a stand-alone surgical navigation system, the device should be able to locate the patient and surgical instruments, align preoperative imaging data with the patient, and visualize navigation data in real time during surgery. Whereas some of the technologies required for this are known, integration in such devices is cumbersome and requires specific knowledge and expertise, hampering scientific progress in this field. This work therefore aims to present and evaluate an integrated HMD-based AR surgical navigation framework that is adaptable to diverse surgical applications. The framework tracks 2D patterns as reference markers attached to the patient and surgical instruments. It allows for the calibration of surgical tools using pivot and reference-based calibration techniques. It enables image-to-patient registration using point-based matching and manual positioning. The integrated functionalities of the framework are evaluated on two HMD devices, the HoloLens 2 and Magic Leap 2, with two surgical use cases being evaluated in a phantom setup: AR-guided needle insertion and rib fracture localization. The framework was able to achieve a mean tooltip calibration accuracy of 1 mm, a registration accuracy of 3 mm, and a targeting accuracy below 5 mm on the two surgical use cases. The framework presents an easy-to-use configurable tool for HMD-based AR surgical navigation, which can be extended and adapted to many surgical applications. The framework is publicly available at https://github.com/abdullahthabit/SurgNavAR.

AI.tldr: 提出并评估了一个集成化的头戴式AR手术导航框架，能够实现患者定位、术前影像配准和实时导航可视化，适用于多种外科应用场景。
AI.motivation: 现有的头戴式AR设备作为独立手术导航系统需要整合多种技术，但集成过程复杂且需要专业知识，阻碍了该领域的科研进展。因此需要开发一个易于使用、可配置的集成框架。
AI.method: 开发了一个集成化HMD-AR手术导航框架，使用2D图案作为参考标记跟踪患者和手术器械，支持工具校准（枢轴和参考基准校准技术）、图像-患者配准（点匹配和手动定位），并在HoloLens 2和Magic Leap 2设备上评估。
AI.result: 框架在两种AR设备上实现了平均工具尖端校准精度1mm、配准精度3mm，在AR引导针插入和肋骨骨折定位两个手术用例中靶向精度低于5mm。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一个易于使用、可配置的头戴式AR手术导航工具，可扩展和适应多种外科应用，框架已在GitHub上公开。

title: Benchmarking PhD-Level Coding in 3D Geometric Computer Vision
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026; Project page: https://geocodebench.github.io/
summary: AI-assisted coding has rapidly reshaped software practice and research workflows, yet today's models still struggle to produce correct code for complex 3D geometric vision. If models could reliably write such code, the research of our community would change substantially. To measure progress toward that goal, we introduce GeoCodeBench, a PhD-level benchmark that evaluates coding for 3D vision. Each problem is a fill-in-the-function implementation task curated from representative papers at recent venues: we first let a tool propose candidate functions from official repositories, then perform careful human screening to select core 3D geometric components. For every target, we generate diverse, edge-case unit tests, enabling fully automatic, reproducible scoring. We evaluate eight representative open- and closed-source models to reflect the current ecosystem. The best model, GPT-5, attains only 36.6% pass rate, revealing a large gap between current capabilities and dependable 3D scientific coding. GeoCodeBench organizes tasks into a two-level hierarchy: General 3D capability (geometric transformations and mechanics/optics formulation) and Research capability (novel algorithm implementation and geometric logic routing). Scores are positively correlated across these axes, but research-oriented tasks are markedly harder. Context ablations further show that "more paper text" is not always better: cutting off at the Method section statistically outperforms full-paper inputs, highlighting unresolved challenges in long-context scientific comprehension. Together, these findings position GeoCodeBench as a rigorous testbed for advancing from generic coding to trustworthy 3D geometric vision coding.

AI.tldr: GeoCodeBench是一个评估3D几何视觉编程能力的博士级基准测试，最佳模型GPT-5仅达到36.6%通过率，显示当前AI在复杂3D科学编码方面仍有巨大差距。
AI.motivation: 当前AI辅助编码模型在复杂3D几何视觉任务上表现不佳，如果模型能可靠编写此类代码，将显著改变研究社区的工作流程。需要建立一个严谨的基准来测量这方面的进展。
AI.method: 从近期代表性论文的官方代码库中提取候选函数，经过人工筛选选择核心3D几何组件，为每个目标生成多样化的边缘情况单元测试，实现全自动、可复现的评分。任务分为两个层次：通用3D能力（几何变换和力学/光学公式）和研究能力（新算法实现和几何逻辑路由）。
AI.result: 评估了8个代表性的开源和闭源模型，最佳模型GPT-5仅达到36.6%通过率。研究导向任务明显更难，且上下文消融实验显示"更多论文文本"并不总是更好，在方法部分截断的输入统计上优于完整论文输入。
AI.conclusion: GeoCodeBench为从通用编码向可信赖的3D几何视觉编码的进步提供了一个严谨的测试平台，揭示了当前能力与可靠3D科学编码之间的巨大差距，特别是在长上下文科学理解方面仍存在未解决的挑战。

title: Video Models Reason Early: Exploiting Plan Commitment for Maze Solving
summary: Video diffusion models exhibit emergent reasoning capabilities like solving mazes and puzzles, yet little is understood about how they reason during generation. We take a first step towards understanding this and study the internal planning dynamics of video models using 2D maze solving as a controlled testbed. Our investigations reveal two findings. Our first finding is early plan commitment: video diffusion models commit to a high-level motion plan within the first few denoising steps, after which further denoising alters visual details but not the underlying trajectory. Our second finding is that path length, not obstacle density, is the dominant predictor of maze difficulty, with a sharp failure threshold at 12 steps. This means video models can only reason over long mazes by chaining together multiple sequential generations. To demonstrate the practical benefits of our findings, we introduce Chaining with Early Planning, or ChEaP, which only spends compute on seeds with promising early plans and chains them together to tackle complex mazes. This improves accuracy from 7% to 67% on long-horizon mazes and by 2.5x overall on hard tasks in Frozen Lake and VR-Bench across Wan2.2-14B and HunyuanVideo-1.5. Our analysis reveals that current video models possess deeper reasoning capabilities than previously recognized, which can be elicited more reliably with better inference-time scaling.

AI.tldr: 视频扩散模型在解决迷宫问题时表现出早期计划承诺特性，路径长度而非障碍密度是迷宫难度的主要预测因素，通过早期计划链式生成可显著提升长序列推理能力。
AI.motivation: 虽然视频扩散模型展现出解决迷宫和谜题等推理能力，但对其在生成过程中的推理机制了解甚少。本研究旨在通过2D迷宫解决作为受控测试平台，深入理解视频模型的内部规划动态。
AI.method: 使用2D迷宫解决作为测试平台，分析视频扩散模型的内部规划动态。研究发现两个关键现象：早期计划承诺和路径长度主导的难度预测。基于这些发现，提出了ChEaP（早期计划链式生成）方法，该方法只对有前景的早期计划种子进行计算，并通过链式连接处理复杂迷宫。
AI.result: 研究揭示了两个重要发现：1）视频扩散模型在前几个去噪步骤中就承诺了高层运动计划；2）路径长度（而非障碍密度）是迷宫难度的主要预测因素，存在12步的失败阈值。ChEaP方法将长序列迷宫的准确率从7%提升到67%，在Frozen Lake和VR-Bench等困难任务上整体提升2.5倍。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频模型拥有比先前认知更深的推理能力，通过更好的推理时缩放可以更可靠地激发这些能力。早期计划承诺和路径长度主导的难度特性为理解视频模型的推理机制提供了新视角，ChEaP方法展示了利用这些特性提升复杂任务性能的实用价值。

title: OmniRoam: World Wandering via Long-Horizon Panoramic Video Generation
summary: Modeling scenes using video generation models has garnered growing research interest in recent years. However, most existing approaches rely on perspective video models that synthesize only limited observations of a scene, leading to issues of completeness and global consistency. We propose OmniRoam, a controllable panoramic video generation framework that exploits the rich per-frame scene coverage and inherent long-term spatial and temporal consistency of panoramic representation, enabling long-horizon scene wandering. Our framework begins with a preview stage, where a trajectory-controlled video generation model creates a quick overview of the scene from a given input image or video. Then, in the refine stage, this video is temporally extended and spatially upsampled to produce long-range, high-resolution videos, thus enabling high-fidelity world wandering. To train our model, we introduce two panoramic video datasets that incorporate both synthetic and real-world captured videos. Experiments show that our framework consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in terms of visual quality, controllability, and long-term scene consistency, both qualitatively and quantitatively. We further showcase several extensions of this framework, including real-time video generation and 3D reconstruction. Code is available at https://github.com/yuhengliu02/OmniRoam.

AI.tldr: OmniRoam是一个可控的全景视频生成框架，利用全景表示实现长时场景漫游，通过预览和细化两阶段生成高质量、长时程、高分辨率的场景视频。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型大多基于透视视频，只能合成场景的有限观察视角，导致完整性和全局一致性问题。需要一种能够生成全景覆盖、保持长期时空一致性的视频生成方法。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架：1) 预览阶段：使用轨迹控制视频生成模型从输入图像/视频创建场景概览；2) 细化阶段：将视频进行时间扩展和空间上采样，生成长时程高分辨率视频。使用合成和真实世界捕获的全景视频数据集进行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，OmniRoam在视觉质量、可控性和长期场景一致性方面均优于现有方法，支持实时视频生成和3D重建等扩展应用。
AI.conclusion: OmniRoam通过全景表示实现了高质量的场景漫游，解决了传统透视视频模型的局限性，为可控视频生成提供了新思路。
